A Fourier baseline achieves 0.944 cycles at 1.5 m under moderate motion, showing that the neural model is not uniformly best. We report exact-count accuracy and temporally matched cycle F1 alongside count error. These findings support motion-aware training in this small synthetic benchmark, while exposing limits of simple event-background stabilization. They do not establish real-sensor performance, aerodynamic flight, or generalization to unseen vehicle types.

</details>


### [158] [Label Less, Learn More: Resource-Efficient Active Semi-Supervised Learning for Onboard Satellite Image Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37481)
*Ahmed Abdelnaby,Mohamed Elmahallawy,Marius Bernahrndt,Tobias Hecking*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SatLabel是一个资源感知学习框架，通过自适应样本采集与半监督模型适配，将有限卫星标签转化为渐进精炼的星上模型，在11个遥感数据集上以更小模型和更低算力超越RemoteCLIP零样本推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模普适感知依赖高分辨率卫星影像，但星上视觉任务受限于昂贵的标注成本以及有限的计算、内存、能量和通信资源。现有方法要么依赖数据饥渴的监督学习，要么依赖大型视觉-语言基础模型，难以在这些约束下高效适配与部署。

Method: 提出SatLabel：不再对均匀采样标签反复训练，而是闭环耦合模型不确定性、类别不平衡与伪标签质量，选择性采集信息量大的样本，同时利用大量无标注影像，使紧凑学生模型适配目标感知域；并引入可选的混合专家（MoE）学生模型与基于图的特征精炼，在保持轻量化的同时提升表示能力。

Result: 在涵盖核心、扩展和未见域的11个遥感数据集上，相比RemoteCLIP零样本推理，SatLabel在多数核心与扩展数据集上提升Macro-F1，并保持较强的跨数据集迁移能力。Balanced学生模型仅11.2M参数、约42.8MB，而RemoteCLIP为151.3M参数、577MB；计算量为3.65 vs 5.89 GFLOPs。在四个效率基准上GPU前向吞吐约提升2倍，并降低单图能耗。

Conclusion: SatLabel以资源感知的方式有效利用有限标签，实现轻量星上模型的高效适配，在精度与效率上均优于大型视觉-语言基础模型，适合资源受限的卫星遥感部署场景。

Abstract: Large-scale pervasive sensing increasingly relies on high-resolution satellite imagery, yet task-specific onboard vision is constrained by costly annotation and limited computation, memory, energy, and communication resources. Existing approaches largely rely on either data-hungry supervised learning or large vision-language foundation models, limiting efficient adaptation and deployment under these constraints. We present SatLabel, a resource-aware learning framework that transforms limited satellite labels into progressively refined onboard models through adaptive sample acquisition and semi-supervised model adaptation. Rather than repeatedly training on uniformly sampled labels, SatLabel closes the loop between model uncertainty, class imbalance, and pseudo-label quality to selectively acquire informative samples while exploiting abundant unlabeled imagery. This enables a compact student to adapt to target sensing domains with reduced annotation and inference costs. We further introduce an optional Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) student with graph-based feature refinement to enhance representation capacity while retaining a lightweight footprint. We evaluate SatLabel on 11 remote-sensing datasets spanning core, extended, and unseen domains against RemoteCLIP zero-shot inference. SatLabel improves Macro-F1 on most core and extended datasets while maintaining strong cross-dataset transfer to unseen domains. More importantly, the Balanced student contains only 11.2 M parameters and occupies approximately 42.8 MB, compared with 151.3M parameters and 577 MB for RemoteCLIP, while requiring 3.65 versus 5.89 GFLOPs. Across four efficiency benchmarks, it achieves approximately 2x higher GPU-forward throughput and reduces energy per image on datasets.

</details>


### [159] [PoE-Fuse: Precision-Weighted Expert Fusion for Bi-Temporal Change Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37485)
*Haruki Watase,Shunya Nagashima,Takayuki Nishimura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PoE-Fuse，一种参数高效框架，通过融合冻结的几何、定位与语言基础专家来解决双时相变化理解任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双时相变化理解对灾害响应和环境监测至关重要，但现有视觉语言模型适配需全量微调或强化学习，成本高且不稳定。

Method: 将冻结基础专家的特征重采样到共享空间网格，仅训练轻量融合主干；把对齐特征视为潜在场景状态的高斯观测，按学习到的逐单元精度进行乘积专家融合，可严格泛化均匀求和与标量门控，并通过组合两时相精度扩展到变化场。

Result: 单一共享主干同时解决三个任务，平均F1达59.2%，而指令微调的时序视觉语言助手为40.7%，并超过同协议、同训练预算下重新训练的专用变化检测模型。

Conclusion: PoE-Fuse以参数高效的方式有效融合多专家，统一解决变化检测、建筑定位和损毁评估，性能优于强基线。

Abstract: Bi-temporal change understanding, which localizes and characterizes what changed between two satellite images, is central to disaster response and environmental monitoring, spanning change detection, building localization, and damage assessment. Strong vision-language models address these tasks, but adapting them typically requires full fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, which is costly and unstable. We propose PoE-Fuse, a parameter-efficient framework that instead composes frozen foundation experts for geometry, grounding, and language, resampling their features onto a shared spatial grid and training only a lightweight fusion trunk. PoE-Fuse treats the aligned features as Gaussian observations of a latent scene state and fuses them by learned per-cell precision. This product-of-experts estimator strictly generalizes uniform summation and scalar gating, and extends to change fields by composing the precisions of the two timestamps. A single shared trunk solves the three tasks at once, reaching a mean F1 of 59.2%, compared with 40.7% for an instruction-tuned temporal vision-language assistant, and surpassing dedicated change-detection models retrained under the same protocol and training budget.

</details>


### [160] [Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching for Precipitation Nowcasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37487)
*Shunya Nagashima,Takumi Bannai,Makoto Misaizu,Keisuke Maeda,Takahiro Ogawa,Miki Haseyama*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PG-FMM，用条件流映射模型解耦可预测平流与不确定细节，实现降水临近预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降水临近预报对洪水预警重要，但混沌动力学、重尾强度和稀有高强度结构使其成为困难的时空生成建模基准。确定性模型最小化像素损失趋近条件均值，模糊关键结构；在确定性骨干上加随机残差的生成模型也继承了同样的模糊问题。

Method: PG-FMM是一种条件流映射模型：冻结的拉格朗日平流先验传输雷达场并提供显式运动预报；流映射生成头以过去帧和先验展开为条件（而非简单叠加），在四步采样内生成锐利的随机细节。先验仅作引导，因此生成头替换而非继承模糊结构。

Result: 在四个雷达基准上，PG-FMM在24项指标中的18项优于最先进方法；在强降雨阈值上增益最大，关键成功指数最多提升58.9%。

Conclusion: PG-FMM通过解耦可预测平流与不确定细节的条件流映射建模，有效克服确定性均值模糊问题，在强降雨等关键场景显著超越现有方法。

Abstract: Precipitation nowcasting, generating future radar fields from past observations, is critical for flood warning and disaster response. It is also a demanding benchmark for spatiotemporal generative modeling, with chaotic dynamics, heavy-tailed intensities, and rare high-intensity structures that matter most. Deterministic models minimize a pixel loss and are driven toward the conditional mean, which blurs exactly those structures, while generative models that add a stochastic residual on top of a deterministic backbone inherit the same blur. We propose Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching (PG-FMM), a conditional flow-map model that decouples predictable advection from uncertain small-scale detail. A frozen Lagrangian advection prior transports the radar field and supplies an explicit motion forecast, and a flow-map generative head, conditioned on the past frames and the prior rollout rather than summed onto it, produces sharp stochastic detail in four sampling steps. The prior serves only as guidance, so the head replaces blurred structure instead of inheriting it. Extensive experiments on four radar benchmarks show that PG-FMM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on 18 of 24 metrics, with the largest gains at heavy-rain thresholds, where the critical success index improves by up to 58.9%. The project page can be found at https://neurogica.github.io/PG-FMM.

</details>


### [161] [FORUM: Frozen Outputs Reconciled Using Model Agreement for Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37488)
*Taiyo Sato,Takamasa Sanda,Keisuke Maeda,Takahiro Ogawa,Miki Haseyama,Shunya Nagashima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FORUM 提出一种无需训练的测试时融合方法，利用多个冻结 MLLM 的一致性作为无标签信号，在对抗性指代表达理解任务上显著超越大型参考模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准指代表达理解已被单个 MLLM 解决，但在含同类干扰物和否定的对抗基准上，即使最大模型也自信出错，且重采样无法纠正。不同数据与架构的模型很少犯同样错误，因此它们的一致性可作为正确目标的强无标签信号。

Method: FORUM 对冻结 MLLM 进行无需训练的测试时融合，采用两条固定几何规则：基于一致性的选择保留被最多不同模型支持的区域；medoid 定位返回真实成员框而非坐标平均，避免单个松散预测偏移结果。

Result: 融合三个开源 MLLM，在对抗性 Ref-Adv-s 基准上平均准确率相对 397B 参数公开参考模型提升 5%，比普通平均集成提升 15%；增益可迁移到标准 RefCOCO+，无主导成员的均衡组合仍超越 397B 模型 5%。

Conclusion: 基于模型一致性的测试时融合能有效提升对抗性指代表达理解性能，且无需训练、可迁移至标准基准。

Abstract: Frozen multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now solve standard referring expression comprehension with a single prompted call, yet on adversarial benchmarks with same-category distractors and negation, even the largest models are confidently wrong, and resampling repeats the error. Models built from different data and architectures rarely fall for the same confounder, so their agreement is a strong label-free signal of the correct target. We present FORUM, a training-free test-time fusion of frozen MLLMs guided by two fixed geometric rules: agreement-based selection keeps the region supported by the most distinct models, and medoid localization returns an actual member box instead of a coordinate average, so one loose prediction cannot shift the answer. Fusing three open MLLMs, FORUM surpasses the 397B-parameter published reference by a relative 5% in mean accuracy on the adversarial Ref-Adv-s benchmark, and a plain averaging ensemble by 15%. The gains transfer to standard RefCOCO+, and a balanced lineup with no dominant member still surpasses the 397B model by 5%.

</details>


### [162] [Attention-Scoped Guidance: Training-Free Spatial Control for Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37492)
*Zeyan Li,Wei Zhou,Hadi Amirpour,Minghao Zou,Panqi Yang,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG)，一种无需训练的采样器包装，将双 CFG 的全局权重变为空间自适应权重，用指令注意力生成软支持图，在低支持区弱化文本引导、在高支持区加强图像锚定，从而在编辑同时更好地保留原图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令引导图像编辑应在按指令修改目标区域的同时保持其余图像不变，但现有双 CFG 在每个去噪步都用全局权重组合"编辑方向"和"原图回拉方向"，无法区分空间位置，导致非目标区域被过度修改。

Method: ASG 读取编辑器已计算的指令注意力得到软支持图，据此在低支持区域弱化文本引导、在高支持区域加强图像锚定，使 CFG 权重空间化；无需训练、无需外部掩码、无需额外网络前向。

Result: 在 MagicBrush 与 PIE-Bench++ 全量测试集上，ASG 提升了面向保真的指标，在 MagicBrush 四项指标中领先三项，并提升 PIE-Bench++ 背景 PSNR；剂量匹配的对照实验（去除空间分配）在 PIE-Bench++ 上最多损失 0.73 CLIP，证明增益来自空间分配本身。

Conclusion: ASG 用现成注意力实现免训练的空间化引导，有效改善编辑中的非目标区域保留；消融表明空间分配是关键因素。

Abstract: Instruction-guided image editing should change what the instruction names and leave the rest of the image untouched. In dual classifier-free guidance (CFG), an editor combines two directions at every denoising step, one that pushes toward the instructed edit and one that pulls back toward the source image, using global weights. We introduce Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG), a sampler wrapper that makes these weights spatial. It reads a soft support map from the instruction attention that the editor already computes, then weakens text guidance where support is low and strengthens image anchoring where support is high. The wrapper requires no training, no external mask, and no additional network evaluation. On the full MagicBrush and PIE-Bench++ splits, ASG improves preservation-oriented metrics, leading three of four MagicBrush metrics and PIE-Bench++ background PSNR. A dose-matched control that removes the spatial placement loses up to 0.73 CLIP on PIE-Bench++, confirming that the spatial allocation itself carries the gain.

</details>


### [163] [MotionMaestro: Masked Tokenization for Unified Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37495)
*Yun Chen,Munchurl Kim,Jeonghyeok Do*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MotionMaestro统一运动生成框架，通过掩码运动token化学习共享表示，支持多种条件生成任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动生成方法多针对单一任务（如文本生成、姿态条件、轨迹控制），缺乏统一框架。作者观察到不同任务可自然表述为运动序列上的不同观测模式，即特定掩码策略。

Method: 引入MotionMaestro，通过掩码运动tokenization学习完整运动与异构部分观测的共享表示；采用三阶段训练：先学掩码tokenizer，再在干净运动上精炼重建，最后在潜空间训练条件流匹配生成器；并引入观测图与观测损失以保留给定条件。

Result: 在大规模RoMo与MotionMillion数据集上，跨多种运动生成任务取得SOTA表现，支持文本引导与无条件合成、姿态条件与部分补全、时序插值、轨迹控制及运动续接等任务。

Conclusion: 统一的表示与条件机制可高效处理多样化运动生成任务，验证了掩码建模统一范式的有效性。

Abstract: Human motion generation plays an important role in applications such as character animation, virtual environments, and embodied interaction. While existing approaches have achieved remarkable progress, many of them are developed for individual tasks, including text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, and trajectory control. Although these tasks involve different types of conditions, a unified framework capable of handling them within a common representation would greatly simplify motion generation systems. We observe that diverse motion conditions can be naturally formulated as different observation patterns over motion sequences, where each task corresponds to a specific masking strategy. Based on this insight, we introduce MotionMaestro, a unified motion generation framework that learns a shared representation for complete motions and heterogeneous partial observations through masked motion tokenization. MotionMaestro employs a three-stage training strategy that first learns a masked motion tokenizer, then refines its reconstruction ability on clean motions, and finally trains a conditional flow-matching generator in the learned latent space. Furthermore, we introduce an observation map and an observation loss to explicitly preserve provided motion conditions during generation. With this unified representation and conditioning mechanism, MotionMaestro supports text-guided and unconditional synthesis, pose conditioning and partial completion, temporal interpolation, trajectory control, and motion continuation. Experiments on the large-scale RoMo and MotionMillion datasets show state-of-the-art performance across diverse motion generation tasks.

</details>


### [164] [GeoSET: Generalist Foundation Model for SAR-to-EO Image Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37496)
*Jeonghyeok Do,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoSET是首个通用SAR到EO图像翻译模型，基于千万级SAR观测构建的300万高质量配对数据集预训练，通过LoRA高效适配下游任务，在六个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SAR-to-EO翻译方法通常在单一、规模有限的数据集上训练，导致模型仅适用于特定传感条件，缺乏跨传感器、分辨率和地理区域的泛化能力。

Method: 构建GeoSET通用模型：从超1000万SAR观测中整理300万+高质量SAR-EO配对；设计抗斑点噪声的SAR编码器，并在异构语料上预训练条件生成器得到父模型；下游适配采用LoRA，仅更新0.60%生成器参数，每个数据集约1小时。

Result: 在六个下游基准上，无论全量微调还是LoRA，GeoSET在FID和DISTS指标上均取得SOTA，证明跨异构SAR-EO域的有效迁移。

Conclusion: GeoSET验证了通用化SAR-EO翻译的可行性，通过大规模异构预训练加高效LoRA适配，实现跨域强泛化与高效迁移。

Abstract: Paired synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) imagery is increasingly available across sensors, resolutions, and geographic regions. Yet existing SAR-to-EO image translation (SET) methods are typically trained on a single, limited-scale dataset, producing models specialized to particular sensing conditions. We introduce GeoSET, the first generalist model for SET, built around a single pretrained parent that is adapted to downstream datasets under a common protocol. We curate over 3 million high-quality SAR--EO pairs from a collection of more than 10 million SAR observations, spanning diverse sensors, spatial resolutions, and ground sampling distances. To bridge the modality gap between SAR observations and a pretrained image generator, we develop a speckle-robust SAR encoder and pretrain the conditional generator on this heterogeneous corpus. The resulting parent supports efficient adaptation across downstream datasets through low-rank adaptation (LoRA), updating only 0.60% of the generator parameters and requiring approximately one hour per dataset. Across six downstream benchmarks, GeoSET achieves state-of-the-art results in FID and DISTS with full fine-tuning or LoRA, demonstrating effective transfer across heterogeneous SAR-EO domains.

</details>


### [165] [Principled MAP estimation for inverse problems: bridging the gap between convergence and performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37529)
*Alexandre Lagier,Valentine Tosel,Anne Gagneux,Mathurin Massias,Ségolène Martin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种结合逐级降低噪声水平去噪器的算法，并设计收敛调度，从贝叶斯角度证明其收敛到MAP估计，在严重病态逆问题上性能优于已有收敛方法且媲美最优经验方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Plug-and-Play和RED方法虽有收敛保证，但使用固定噪声水平去噪器，在严重病态逆问题上重建质量不足；而基于flow/diffusion生成模型的去噪器方法（沿递减噪声水平）经验性能强，却缺乏收敛理论。本文旨在弥合这一理论与实践的差距。

Method: 设计一种算法，将递减噪声水平的去噪器与专门设计的调度相结合以确保收敛；从贝叶斯视角，在适当假设下证明算法收敛到最大后验（MAP）估计。

Result: 在多种病态逆问题上验证，方法超越已有的收敛方法，同时与当前最优经验方法性能相当。

Conclusion: 为结合递减噪声去噪器的算法提供了收敛理论保证，实现了收敛性与经验性能的良好平衡。

Abstract: Pretrained denoisers provide a powerful way to incorporate image priors into restoration algorithms. Plug-and-Play and RED approaches exploit fixed-noise-level denoisers within first-order optimization schemes, with convergence guarantees, but often struggle to achieve high-quality reconstruction on severely ill-posed inverse problems. In contrast, recent state-of-the-art approaches leverage denoisers derived from flow- or diffusion-based generative models and evaluate them along a sequence of decreasing noise levels. While these methods achieve strong empirical performance, their convergence theory remains limited. In this paper, we bridge this gap by specifically designing an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a schedule tailored to ensure convergence. From a Bayesian perspective, we prove that our method converges to a $\textit{Maximum a Posteriori}$ (MAP) estimate, under suitable assumptions. Subsequently, we apply our method to various ill-posed inverse problems and show that it surpasses convergent methods while competing with state-of-the-art empirical ones.

</details>


### [166] [Weeding Out Bad Seeds: Initial-Noise-Robust Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37537)
*Arian Komaei Koma,Seyed Amir Kasaei,Aida Aryafar,Matin Ghiasi,Ali Aghayari,Amirhossein Souri,Mohammad Mosayyebi,AmirMahdi Sadeghzadeh,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有T2I模型机器遗忘方法对噪声初始化缺乏鲁棒性，会"概率性遗忘"——被抑制概念在特定随机初始噪声下重新出现；作者提出自适应、概念条件化的采样策略，将梯度更新集中在目标概念出现的噪声区域，显著提升遗忘鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前SOTA机器遗忘方法脆弱，存在"概率性遗忘"现象：被抑制的概念在特定随机初始噪声条件下会重新出现，尽管在其他初始化下看似已被遗忘。作者将失败归因于标准高斯采样与遗忘目标之间的错位——目标概念仅在特定初始噪声区域内显现，均匀随机采样导致梯度更新稀疏且信息量不足，无法实现稳健擦除。

Method: 提出自适应、概念条件化的采样策略，动态将梯度更新集中于目标概念显现的噪声区域，并降低无信息区域的权重。

Result: 将框架集成到6种SOTA遗忘方法、4个扩散骨干上，评估安全、物体、艺术风格遗忘及黑盒白盒对抗攻击。方法在四个基线上平均将条件裸体再出现率降低67.2%，并降低两种对抗评估下的攻击成功率；跨概念域增强了对抗鲁棒性和非目标保留，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量与目标擦除性能。

Conclusion: 自适应噪声采样作为一种通用策略，能有效克服概率性遗忘，提升T2I机器遗忘在随机初始化与对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization. We call this phenomenon ``probabilistic forgetting'': suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.

</details>


### [167] [APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37559)
*Jianguo Huang,Jinming Liu,Qiyao Wang,Liang Xu,Jianhang Li,Zhimian Wen,Mingda Li,Shule Lu,Zhicheng Wang,Yuhan Guo,Xin Jin,Wenjun Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 APM-Bench，将真实世界流式交互重构为多会话生活轨迹，用以评测持久记忆系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频基准多聚焦单段连续视频或短视频片段，忽略真实交互的间歇性，以及记忆需跨中断持久保存的需求。

Method: 构建 APM-Bench：含 549 个会话、104 条轨迹、2719 个候选，覆盖客观与开放问题；每会话为带细粒度标注的视频，轨迹内会话围绕相关活动。系统评测通用视频模型在不同记忆协议及多种专用流式记忆系统下，能否存储、选择性保留、适时注入并高效利用持久记忆，以及能否识别证据不足。

Result: 评测揭示明显的效用—延迟—存储权衡：现有方法难以同时实现可靠长期回忆、低开销与跨会话有效主动辅助。

Conclusion: APM-Bench 为真实流式条件下持久记忆系统的开发与比较提供综合测试平台，推动兼顾效用、延迟与存储的后续研究。

Abstract: To serve as real-world personal assistants, streaming video models need persistent memory that retains past experiences for later use. Yet existing streaming benchmarks and methods often focus on individual continuous videos or short clips, overlooking that real-world interactions are often intermittent and require memory to persist across interruptions. To fill this gap, we introduce APM-Bench, which reformulates real-world streaming interaction as multi-session life trajectories. It contains 549 sessions, 104 trajectories, and 2,719 candidates, spanning both objective and open-ended questions. Each session is a video with fine-grained annotations, and sessions within a trajectory revolve around related activities. Models then use persistent memory to answer questions about past sessions and provide proactive responses while maintaining real-time interaction. This raises challenges: persistent memory must be storable, selectively retain information, be injected at the right time, and remain efficient. Moreover, finite storage may leave required evidence unavailable, so assistants should recognize missing evidence. Therefore, we systematically evaluate general video models under different memory protocols and diverse specialized streaming memory systems, and test whether models acknowledge insufficient evidence. Our evaluation reveals a clear utility--latency--storage trade-off: existing methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve reliable long-term recall, low overhead, and effective proactive assistance across sessions. APM-Bench provides a comprehensive testbed for developing and comparing persistent memory systems under realistic streaming conditions. We hope it encourages future work that jointly considers utility, latency, and storage toward more practical persistent memory for real-world streaming assistants.

</details>


### [168] [Decompose Radicals, Then Reward: Fine-Grained Inspection for Accurate Chinese Text Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37569)
*Yazhen Xie,Xingsong Ye,Zhineng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IDEspect通过IDS（表意文字描述序列）细粒度奖励改进中文文本渲染，在Qwen-Image的GRPO后训练中实现领先的结构质量与语义对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于OCR的强化学习奖励将汉字视为原子整体与目标字符串比较，忽略汉字由可复用部件及空间关系组合而成的特性，导致部件级视觉错误得到粗糙反馈，模型只追求形似而非忠实还原内部结构。

Method: 训练专家IDS识别器将渲染中文转录为IDS表示；提出IDSpect，确定性分解目标文本为IDS token，并对齐裁剪级视觉IDS预测与目标序列。全局唯一token信用使比较对检测文本区域顺序稳健，并结合整字语义奖励，在不改变生成器、不增加推理成本下提供部件与空间关系的细粒度信用。

Result: 在Qwen-Image的GRPO后训练实验中，IDSpect在LongText与GenTextEval上取得领先的结构质量和语义对齐表现。

Conclusion: 利用IDS表示的细粒度奖励可有效提升中文文本渲染的结构保真度与语义对齐，且不增加推理开销，为文本到图像模型的中文生成提供新思路。

Abstract: Rendering accurate Chinese text remains challenging for text-to-image models. Existing OCR-based reinforcement-learning rewards compare decoded transcripts with target strings. Such rewards overlook the compositional nature of Chinese writing: an ideograph consists of reusable components arranged through explicit spatial relations, yet OCR evaluates it as an atomic character. Consequently, visually different radical-level errors may receive equally coarse feedback, encouraging glyphs that merely resemble the target instead of faithfully reproducing its internal structure. We employ Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS), which comprise spatial operators and character components, and train an expert IDS recognizer to transcribe rendered Chinese text into this representation. Building on this recognizer, we introduce IDSpect, which deterministically decomposes the target text into IDS tokens and aligns crop-level visual IDS predictions with the target sequence. Globally unique token credit makes this comparison robust to the order of detected text regions. Combined with a whole-character semantic reward, IDSpect supplies fine-grained credit with component and spatial-relation without changing the image generator or adding inference-time cost. Experiments with GRPO post-training of Qwen-Image demonstrate that IDSpect achieves leading structural quality and semantic alignment on LongText and GenTextEval.

</details>


### [169] [Evaluating the Evaluators: Diagnosing Large Multimodal Models for AI-Generated Image Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37576)
*Yu Zhao,Jiarui Wang,Huiyu Duan,Ye Zhao,Jutao Tang,Juntong Wang,Guangtao Zhai,Xiongkuo Min*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SQUARE-Bench是一个综合基准，从语义、质量、真实性、责任四方面评估LMM作为AI生成图像评估器的能力，涵盖38个子维度、近10K生成图与3K真实图，测试23个LMM并探索迭代编辑应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2I生成快速发展，传统指标难以捕捉细粒度对齐与生成伪影；现有LMM评估基准将语义、质量、真实性孤立研究，忽视责任检测，缺乏统一全面的验证。

Method: 构建SQUARE-Bench，包含语义、质量、真实性、责任四方面及38个子维度的细粒度分类体系；采样22个模型（从传统到SOTA）的近10K生成图和3K+真实图，配以人工标注的问答对；对23个LMM进行大量实验，并开展LMM引导迭代编辑的概念验证研究。

Result: 顶尖闭源模型（如Gemini-3-Pro）已超越个体人类专家基线，但模型间性能差距仍显著，细粒度推理与领域鲁棒性差异明显；LMM引导的迭代编辑在语义、真实性、责任上有选择性提升，但存在一致的视觉质量权衡。

Conclusion: SQUARE-Bench既可作为刻画LMM评估器能力的诊断工具，也可用于研究T2I生成精炼；基准与数据集将在发表后公开。

Abstract: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, robust evaluation becomes critical yet challenging, as traditional metrics fail to capture fine-grained alignment and generative artifacts. While large multimodal models (LMMs) are increasingly adopted as evaluators, existing benchmarks typically study semantic understanding, quality perception, and authenticity identification in isolation, while largely neglecting responsibility detection. This leaves a gap in unified and comprehensive validation. To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates LMM capabilities as evaluators of AI-generated images across four aspects: Semantics, Quality, Authenticity, and Responsibility. SQUARE-Bench introduces a granular taxonomy of 38 sub-dimensions to evaluate nearly 10K AI-generated images sampled from 22 diverse models, ranging from legacy to state-of-the-art generators, complemented by over 3K real-world images. The images are annotated with curated question-answering pairs. Extensive experiments on 23 LMMs reveal that top proprietary models, such as Gemini-3-Pro, already outperform the individual human expert baseline. However, the performance gap between models remains significant, exhibiting notable disparities in fine-grained inference and domain-specific robustness. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct a proof-of-concept study of LMM-guided iterative editing, in which dimension-specific LMMs provide diagnostic feedback to fixed image editors. The resulting guided system yields selective improvements in semantics, authenticity, and responsibility, while exhibiting a consistent visual-quality trade-off. SQUARE-Bench can serve as both a diagnostic tool for characterizing LMM evaluator capabilities and studying their use in T2I generation refinement. The benchmark and dataset will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [170] [TReVS: Integrating Textual Relevance and Visual Saliency for Efficient Vision-Language Model Token Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37581)
*Jing Wang,Zhiping Wu,Dongdong Ren,Youfang Han,Wei Zhao,Wenbin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TReVS是一个免训练框架，在第一阶段融合文本相关性与视觉编码器显著性进行预LLM剪枝，并利用高方差注意力头在LLM浅中层去除无关token，实现94.4%剪枝率下保留92.8%性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有两阶段视觉token剪枝方法中，第一阶段仅依赖视觉编码器显著性，可能过早删除与查询相关的token，使后续文本引导阶段缺失关键视觉证据，从而损害性能。

Method: 提出TReVS框架：(1)将文本相关性与视觉编码器显著性结合用于预LLM剪枝；(2)利用对文本查询更敏感的高方差注意力头，在LLM浅至中层去除任务无关token。整个过程无需训练。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，剪除94.4%视觉token的同时保留92.8%未剪枝基线性能，优于先前最先进方法。实证分析表明，引入查询引导的第一阶段剪枝比仅用视觉显著性剪枝更有效。

Conclusion: TReVS通过在第一阶段引入文本引导并利用高方差注意力头进行第二阶段剪枝，有效缓解了过早删除查询相关token的问题，在大幅剪枝的同时保持了性能，为VLM推理加速提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding and reasoning but often incur substantial inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent visual token pruning methods increasingly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first remove visually redundant tokens after the vision encoder and then discard tokens irrelevant to the textual query within the Large Language Model (LLM). However, since the first stage typically relies solely on vision-encoder saliency, it may prematurely eliminate query-relevant tokens, depriving the subsequent text-guided stage of critical visual evidence. Our empirical analysis shows that incorporating query guidance into first-stage pruning better preserves task-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance over vision-only saliency-based pruning. We further find that high-variance attention heads are more sensitive to the textual query and yield more discriminative text-to-vision attention signals for second-stage pruning. Motivated by these findings, we propose TReVS, a training-free framework that combines textual relevance with vision-encoder saliency for pre-LLM pruning and leverages high-variance attention heads to remove task-irrelevant tokens at shallow-to-intermediate layers of the LLM. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TReVS retains 92.8% of the unpruned baseline performance while pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [171] [FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37582)
*Xinyuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FedSocket，将"接收方可执行"作为联邦交换模型的设计要求，通过共享 Q 连接异构私有模型，实现跨模态、跨架构、跨任务的联邦知识复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦知识需被不同模态、私有架构和任务的接收方使用，但现有交换模型往往无法被接收方直接执行。

Method: 设计共享 Q：结合接收方可计算输入、任务自有输出与所有权感知聚合，形成公共预测接口。私有模型训练本地 Q 副本，仅交换 Q 参数与计数；返回的 Q 支持本地学习与 Joint 推理。

Result: 六个数据集上，FedSocket 较 Local 在 MELD 与 UCF-51 的缺失模态接收方准确率分别提升 14.44 和 15.51 个百分点；同等推理容量下 Joint 超过独立集成，UCF-51 高 11.06 点，Flickr30k 双向 R@1 平均高 4.87 点；Joint 在四个异构端点上均优于单独 Q。

Conclusion: 教师控制、共享路径干预与组件因子实验验证了监督、共享与部署的作用，证明 FedSocket 使交换知识从联邦训练到接收方推理均可直接使用。

Abstract: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.

</details>


### [172] [TomoTransformer: Towards a Foundation Model for CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37605)
*AmirEhsan Khorashadizadeh,Benjamín Béjar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TomoTransformer 是一个基于 Transformer 的稀疏视图断层重建基础模型，通过局部滤波投影作为 token 并在反投影空间中预测缺失视角，实现无需重训练即可适应任意投影数量和角度的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督深度学习模型通常将 FBP 图像或 sinogram 映射到干净重建，对分布偏移脆弱；当投影数量/角度、探测器分辨率或数据分布变化时需重新训练，限制了实际部署。

Method: 提出 TomoTransformer：将每个局部滤波投影视为独立 token，通过自注意力预测缺失视角。关键在于在反投影空间中操作，该空间将投影按空间位置分离，使视角插值在几何上良定义且对探测器尺寸不变。在涵盖多种医学 CT 解剖和自然图像的大规模数据集上训练。

Result: 在多个基准稀疏视图数据集上显著优于 ViewTrans 等多用途模型，匹配或超越强协议特定基线；对输入和目标投影数量完全不可知。在 X 射线同步加速器采集的真实纳米级大脑数据上展现出稳健的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: TomoTransformer 提供了单一基础模型，可处理任意数量输入投影、任意角度位置和探测器尺寸，并查询任意目标角度而无需重训练，展示了实际应用价值。

Abstract: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each \textit{local} filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a \emph{back-projection space} that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.

</details>


### [173] [Targeted Visual Counterfactual Explanations for Contrastive Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37638)
*Van Bach Nguyen,Jörg Schlötterer,Christin Seifer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MACE，一种针对CLIP零样本分类的目标性视觉反事实解释方法，通过自适应掩码引导扩散模型编辑图像以到达指定目标类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CLIP解释方法仅识别重要区域，无法说明如何修改输入以得到目标预测，缺乏目标性反事实能力。

Method: 从源归因或源-目标归因差异构建可编辑区域，必要时扩展掩码以达到目标类；用潜在扩散修复模型修改选定区域，冻结CLIP提供修改引导并将剩余内容锚定原图。

Result: 在ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets、CUB-200上评估：源掩码变体目标top-1成功率最高，差异掩码变体像素和感知变化最小、真实感最佳；两种变体均优于仅用Stable Diffusion的基线。

Conclusion: 自适应掩码引导编辑能产生有效的CLIP反事实，并揭示反事实有效性与源图保持之间的权衡。

Abstract: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision--language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce \textbf{M}ask-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{C}ounterfactual \textbf{E}xplanations (\mace), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. \mace constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source--target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate \mace on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel-level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation.

</details>


### [174] [VoxelSage: Tool-Augmented 3D CT Analysis and Simulator-Shielded Sequential Resection Planning for Liver Tumors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37648)
*Binghong Qian,Xuanhe Liu,Yifan Xing,Wenjie Deng,Jian Wu,Haochao Ying*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VoxelSage是一个多模态系统，集成肝脏肿瘤术前评估的可视化、测量与切除规划，通过双端口架构分离语言模型编排与图像计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具将分割、测量、视觉证据与切除规划分离处理，而语言模型无法可靠地从CT计算物理测量值，缺乏统一工作流。

Method: 采用双端口架构：Port A解析请求并选择技能，Port B将技能应用于CT体数据与分割掩码并返回结构化结果；内置八项技能，并用行为克隆神经排序器排序候选切除目标，配合模拟器盾牌检查约束。

Result: 在256个未见模拟场景中，相比确定性基线，平均模拟时间从34.274降至33.388分钟（2.59%），平均模拟失血量从300.847降至183.852毫升（38.89%）。

Conclusion: 结果展示了系统集成与模拟器级性能，而非临床有效性或安全性；实现已开源。

Abstract: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires segmentation, physical-space measurement, visual evidence, and resection planning from the same three-dimensional CT volume. Existing tools often handle these steps separately, while language models cannot reliably compute physical measurements from CT. To provide an integrated workflow, we present VoxelSage, a multi-modal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection planning. Its dual-port architecture separates language-model orchestration from image computation: Port A interprets requests and selects skills, while Port B applies them to CT volumes and segmentation masks and returns structured results. Keeping physical measurements in Port B prevents the LLM from computing them directly and reduces the risk of fabricated numerical results. Eight built-in skills support quantitative analysis, visual evidence generation, three-dimensional reconstruction, segmentation refinement, and sequential resection planning; user-defined skills can extend these functions. For sequence planning, a behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate resection targets, while a simulator-based shield checks them against predefined constraints. Across 256 unseen simulator scenes, this approach reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min (0.886 min, 2.59%) and mean simulated blood loss from 300.847 to 183.852 mL (116.995 mL, 38.89%) relative to a deterministic baseline. These results demonstrate system integration and simulator-level performance, not clinical efficacy or safety. The public implementation is available at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage.

</details>


### [175] [Texture Space Material Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37654)
*Jacob Munkberg,Peter Kocsis,Jon Hasselgren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种完全在纹理空间生成3D物体高质量材质的方法，通过微调视频扩散Transformer实现文本引导、多视角材质生成和材质超分，在材质生成与重建上达到SOTA，并支持8K分辨率和100+输入视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频与多视角扩散模型存在视角一致性问题，且难以泛化到任意几何和纹理参数化。作者希望利用图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，规避这些问题并复用预训练视频扩散模型的强先验。

Method: 微调视频扩散Transformer进行文本引导材质生成、多视角材质生成与材质超分；核心是利用图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，使扩散过程能跨任意几何与纹理参数化泛化。由于纹理空间是二维的，可复用预训练视频扩散模型先验。

Result: 应用于未知光照下已定位照片的高质量材质重建，以及文本和图像引导的材质生成；可扩展至8K分辨率、100+输入视角和神经材质表示；定量与定性评估显示材质生成与重建达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 在纹理空间中进行扩散生成是一种有效策略，既避免视角一致性问题，又能借助视频扩散先验，实现高质量、可扩展的3D材质生成与重建。

Abstract: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.

</details>


### [176] [Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37655)
*Jiayu Ying,Qijian Tian,Ruijie Xu,Xinnan Zhu,Daoguo Dong,Jiachen Xu,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Exemplar2VQA：一个以示例驱动、多智能体编码生成大规模3D空间VQA数据的框架，通过确定性代码执行规避LLM空间推理缺陷，提升MLLM空间智能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM空间智能发展受限于复杂、可扩展的3D问答数据稀缺；人工标注成本高，直接用LLM合成又因空间几何计算能力不足而失败。

Method: 提出Exemplar2VQA框架，采用多智能体编码方式，在仿真环境中以静态物体为中心的多种空间查询模板作为示例，为协作智能体配备精心设计的几何工具库，通过确定性代码执行自动、可扩展地合成大规模高保真空间QA数据。

Result: 仅用其生成的合成室内数据微调Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B），在多个基准上取得显著提升；效果不仅限于室内场景，还稳健扩展到室外及混合场景基准。

Conclusion: Exemplar2VQA是可扩展且有效的范式，可弥合具身AI中的sim-to-real差距，助力MLLM空间智能发展。

Abstract: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA

</details>


### [177] [Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37656)
*Bowen Yuan,Danny Wang,Ruihong Qiu,Zijian Wang,Zi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VTrace是一个多模态token归因框架，通过追踪中间推理路径并校准跨模态归因分数，提升LVLM响应归因的忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有token归因方法主要针对文本语言模型，处理多模态时存在两问题：图文联合归因低估视觉证据；视觉证据通过多条中间推理路径影响响应，而现有方法只追踪部分路径，低估视觉贡献。

Method: VTrace构建成对归因以突出token特定贡献，以闭式解聚合所有前向归因路径（涵盖直接与间接贡献）；再通过跨模态校准，利用基于响应似然变化的模态贡献估计，重新缩放图像与文本归因分数，实现统一排名。

Result: 在六个视觉推理基准上对比七种基线方法，VTrace展现出更优的归因忠实度。

Conclusion: VTrace有效解决多模态token归因中视觉证据被低估的问题，为LVLM响应提供更忠实、统一的输入token归因。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed mainly for text-based language models, and our empirical study reveals two challenges when complex multimodal sources are involved. First, the joint image-text attribution can underrepresent visual evidence relative to text, obscuring the image regions supporting the response. Second, visual evidence may influence the generated response through multiple intermediate reasoning paths, while existing methods trace only a limited subset of these paths, causing important visual contributions to be underestimated. Motivated by these insights, we introduce VTrace, a multimodal token-attribution framework that traces input contributions through intermediate reasoning and calibrates attribution scores across modalities. VTrace constructs pairwise attributions that highlight token-specific contributions and aggregates all forward attribution paths in closed form to account for both direct and indirect contributions. Cross-modal calibration then rescales image and text attribution scores using modality contributions estimated from response-likelihood changes, enabling a unified ranking of input tokens. Evaluations against seven baselines across six visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the superior attribution faithfulness. Project page: https://vtrace-attribution.github.io/.

</details>


### [178] [Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37659)
*Adhemar de Senneville,Xavier Bou,Jérémy Anger,Rafael Grompone,Gabriele Facciolo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)中存在一个跨任务共享的低维判别几何空间(SDG)，上下文图像被压缩为线性可分的表示以完成分类，其成因是早期层执行的降维。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于上下文学习(ICL)的研究多聚焦于归纳电路如何利用线性表示，但很少探究这些线性表示最初是如何构建的。作者借助视觉模态比文本更强的表达性来揭示这一机制。

Method: (1) 分析性地证明线性自注意力可通过将上下文数据投影到其主成分上实现降维，每一层相当于朝该目标执行一步梯度下降；(2) 通过实验提供证据表明训练后的LVLMs在早期层以类似机制降低视觉表示的维度。

Result: 发现LVLMs内部存在共享判别几何(SDG)：一个跨所有图像分类任务共享的低维空间，上下文图像被压缩为线性可分表示，用于后续分类，且该现象源于早期层的视觉表示降维。

Conclusion: LVLMs通过早期层的主成分式降维构建线性表示，形成了跨任务共享的低维判别几何空间，从而支撑上下文学习中的分类能力。

Abstract: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) inside Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). It is a low-dimensional space, shared across all image classification tasks, in which in-context images are compressed into linearly separable representations later used to perform classification. We observe that this is the result of the model performing a dimensionality reduction of vision representations in early layers. In order to explain this phenomenon: (1) We show analytically that linear self-attention can perform a dimensionality reduction by projecting in-context data onto its principal components, with each layer implementing one gradient descent step toward this objective. (2) We provide evidence that trained LVLMs reduce the dimensionality of vision representations in early layers via a similar mechanism.

</details>


### [179] [Med-RADIO: Reducing All Medical Domains Into One via Multi-Teacher Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37682)
*Chu Zhang,Haoyu Jiang,Hongyuan Zhang,Hongbin Liu,Dong Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Med-RADIO是一个医学多教师蒸馏框架，将多个领域专家教师的互补知识压缩进统一的医学视觉基础模型，从而提升通用模型的跨模态性能基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学通用模型相比自然图像通用模型训练数据规模不足，相比医学专家模型领域深度不够；通用模型只能建立跨模态性能基线，而专家模型定义各领域性能上限，需将基线提升至上限。

Method: 提出Med-RADIO多教师蒸馏框架：整合通用与专家教师；分配模态对齐的蒸馏流，重组通用预训练数据以匹配专家领域；采用平衡损失防止单一教师主导蒸馏过程。

Result: 在涵盖五种模态的内部与外部分类基准上，Med-RADIO在线性探测下优于强医学通用模型，并在多数模态上与代表性专家模型具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 多教师蒸馏是将医学通用与专家模型优势结合的有效途径，可在统一基础模型中实现跨模态性能提升。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models. Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research mainly follows two paths: specialized models optimized for specific modalities, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models suffer from both insufficient training data scale relative to natural image generalists and inadequate domain-specific depth relative to medical specialists. Empirically, generalist models establish a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains. To elevate this baseline toward these ceilings, we propose Med-RADIO, a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our method curates both generalist and specialist teachers, allocates modality-aligned distillation streams to reorganize generalist pretraining data so it matches specialist domains, and uses a balanced loss to prevent any single teacher from dominating the distillation process. On internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five modalities, Med-RADIO improves over strong medical generalists under linear probing and remains competitive with representative specialists on most evaluated modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO.

</details>


### [180] [PAIQ: Patch-Aligned Semantic Injection via Residual Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37685)
*Pinze Ren,Yuwei Zhang,Hao Chen,Linghao Meng,Chang Li,Qiankun Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAIQ是一个patch对齐的语义注入框架，将DINOv3空间特征与SigLIP语义特征结合，通过正交约束的残差更新实现互补融合，在两个Qwen骨干上平均超过最强基线约2.9分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言对齐与自监督视觉编码器在语义抽象和空间细节上各有优势，但如何利用二者互补性、在丰富局部特征的同时保留语义相关patch之间的区分度，是核心挑战。

Method: 以DINOv3 patch特征为空间基，通过基于内容的跨编码器匹配聚合SigLIP特征（联合源分配），并通过共享正交变换Q注入聚合与基的差异；该旋转保持残差范数和成对夹角。仅训练投影与融合参数，两个视觉编码器和语言模型冻结，保留196个视觉token。

Result: 推导出相似语义聚合下patch可分离性条件，证明在聚合共享时旋转比直接插值增加非负分离项。在多种语言骨干上，图像描述与VQA任务的正确性提升、幻觉严重度降低；在2B和9B Qwen上平均超最强融合或token压缩基线约2.9正确性分。

Conclusion: PAIQ用紧凑接口有效融合互补视觉编码器，兼具理论保障与实证增益，是单编码器接口的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Language-aligned and self-supervised visual encoders offer complementary strengths in semantic abstraction and spatial detail. Harnessing this complementarity requires enriching local features while retaining distinctions between semantically related patches. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-aligned semantic injection framework that combines content-based cross-encoder matching with orthogonally constrained residual updates. Using DINOv3 patch features as the spatial base, PAIQ aggregates complementary SigLIP features through joint source allocation and injects the aggregate--base differences through a shared orthogonal transformation Q. This rotation adapts update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, we derive conditions for patch separability under similar semantic aggregates and show that rotation adds a nonnegative separation term over direct interpolation when the aggregate is shared. Only the projection and fusion parameters are trained; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and fusion retains 196 visual tokens. Across diverse language backbones, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over single-encoder interfaces on image description and visual question answering. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, this compact interface outperforms the strongest evaluated fusion or token-compression baselines by about 2.9 correctness points on average.

</details>


### [181] [Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37690)
*Jack Wei Lun Shi,Kaichen Zhou,Haoyu Chen,Yufeng Weng,Keane Ong,Ruojin Cai,Hang Hua,Justin K. W. Yeoh,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Honeycomb 提出基于 HexMemory（固定大小六平面低秩表示）的视频世界模型，实现恒定存储下的长时程一致性生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间记忆系统累积 RGB 观测或潜在特征，存储随生成过程增长，长时程视频生成成本高。

Method: 构建 HexMemory：由六个空间/时空平面组成的固定大小低秩表示。前馈写入器将最新视频块映射为平面特征；随覆盖范围扩展，通过 warp 保留维度并利用置信度加权池化与学习残差修正整合新特征。读取器检索特征以条件化后续生成。因仅处理最新块，避免逐场景优化和全历史重复处理。

Result: 在 WorldScore 和 RealEstate10K 上展现强生成质量与重访区域的稳健一致性，且特征存储全程恒定。

Conclusion: Honeycomb 通过固定大小记忆表示解决了长时程视频生成的存储增长问题，兼顾质量与一致性。

Abstract: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memory systems accumulate RGB observations or latent features, causing storage requirements to grow as generation proceeds. We introduce **Honeycomb**, a video world model built on **HexMemory**, a compact low-rank representation that stores scene features in a fixed-size memory comprising six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each newly generated video chunk to plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, HexMemory warps the existing planes while preserving their dimensions, then integrates new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latent features from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. Because the writer processes only observations from the latest chunk, Honeycomb avoids per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full generation history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust consistency when revisiting previously observed regions, while maintaining constant feature-storage requirements throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.

</details>


### [182] [VIF-Bench: Evaluating Visual Instruction Following in Multi-Reference Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37709)
*Yuta Oshima,Masakazu Yoshimura,Masahiro Suzuki,Yutaka Matsuo,Hiroki Furuta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VIF-Bench基准（1241任务），评估多参考图与异构视觉指令联合约束下的生成能力，揭示三条关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态生成基准未评估"多参考图 + 多异构视觉指令"的联合设定，缺乏公平比较的基础。

Method: 构建VIF-Bench，含1241个任务，覆盖：最多7个参考图×最多6个异构视觉指令；参考图与控制属性竞争的冲突场景；视觉指令与不同详细度文本的受控对比。

Result: 发现三点：(1) 存在"遵循度—伪影"权衡：视觉指令遵循越强，生成伪影越多；(2) 参考图携带显著受控属性时（尤其光照、风）遵循度下降；(3) 对能理解视觉指令的模型，直接给视觉约束优于文本描述，文本以中等细节为佳。

Conclusion: VIF-Bench作为开放基准发布，为可控多参考图像生成提供公平比较基础。

Abstract: Recent multimodal image generation models can take multiple images and textual instructions as input, enabling reference-based generation guided not only by text but also by visual instructions such as layouts, arrows, and pose cues. However, existing benchmarks do not evaluate the joint setting in which multiple references must be composed under multiple and heterogeneous visual-instruction images. To address this gap, we introduce VIF-Bench, a benchmark of 1,241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity. Using these capabilities, we uncover three findings: (1) models face an adherence-artifact trade-off: once models reach stronger visual instruction adherence, stronger adherence tends to coincide with more instruction artifacts in generated images, (2) visual instruction adherence tends to be lower on tasks whose reference images carry a salient state of the controlled attribute (e.g., a neon-lit subject under a light-direction instruction), most consistently for light and wind, and (3) for models that can understand visual instructions, it is often better to provide visual constraints directly rather than describe them in text; when using text, a moderate level of detail works better than an exhaustive description. VIF-Bench is released as an open benchmark to establish a basis for fair comparison in controllable multi-reference image generation.

</details>


### [183] [PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37712)
*GuangJian Team,Kaili Huang,Yongshuo Zhang,Bingtao Fu,Changjiang Jiang,Chenfan Qu,Chenfeng Zhang,Fangming Cui,Gaoyang Zhang,Jiangwei Xie,Jianshu Li,Jing Huang,Jingwen Bai,Mingqi Fang,Tao Fang,Weihong Zhang,Wenbo Du,Xiongfei Bai,Xuekang Zhu,Yinan Xia,Zhenming Wang,Jian Liu,Jingjing Liu,Xiang Qi,Weiqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PolyOCR是一系列统一OCR基础模型，结合指令微调框架、数据引擎与Competence-Guided Policy Optimization，在多基准上达到SOTA或极具竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OCR正从纯文本转录向通用视觉智能演进，需识别、定位、推理复杂视觉环境中的文本信息；但现有系统往往只擅长部分任务，难以在识别、解析、推理间取得平衡。

Method: 提出PolyOCR统一OCR基础模型家族：共享的指令跟随框架 + 大规模数据引擎（将异构视觉资源转为质检验证的OCR监督）；引入Competence-Guided Policy Optimization，结合基于验证器的GRPO与在线策略蒸馏（依据教师可靠性和师生能力差距进行样本级路由）；并发布修订版OCRBench v2.1（人工校正标注与任务对齐评分）。

Result: 在OCRBench v2.1、CC-OCR、内部KIE Benchmark、OmniDocBench v1.6、MDPBench等实验显示，PolyOCR达到SOTA或极具竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: PolyOCR通过统一框架、数据引擎与能力引导优化，有效平衡OCR的识别、解析与推理能力，标志OCR向通用视觉智能的推进。

Abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics. Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.

</details>


### [184] [The Camera Inside the Editor: Reading the Implicit Camera of Image Editors with Painted Calibration Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37732)
*Sebastian Rückerl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 指令式图像编辑器在绘制照片时会隐含一个相机模型，可通过令其绘制棋盘格地板并用灭点几何反推出该相机参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究指令式图像编辑器在向照片中绘制内容时假设的是什么相机，而非估计输入图像的相机。

Method: 让编辑器把地板铺满棋盘格，利用经典灭点几何从中读取pitch、roll、焦距、yaw及主点，无需训练；在120个有精确真值的渲染相机上测试，并与GeoCalib对比。

Result: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511绘制的瓦片边缘灭点误差在0.26度内，隐含相机pitch误差0.8度、焦距6%，除roll外优于GeoCalib；显式画地平线或标灭点任务失败。隐含相机有roll趋向水平（斜率0.71）和长焦约30mm默认值两个先验，模糊下先验不增强，真实照片上更强；24–240mm变焦上透视增长斜率仅0.62，而GeoCalib和MoGe-2在约52和42mm饱和；FLUX.1 Kontext和LongCat-Image-Edit偏移更强。相机控制LoRA姿态执行强度仅50–70%。

Conclusion: 编辑器通过绘制而非显式任务暴露出隐含相机知识，该相机带有系统性先验，且不同模型对透视的响应程度差异明显。

Abstract: Instruction-based image editors insert objects, restyle scenes and render new viewpoints, but it is unknown which camera they assume when they paint into a photograph. Asked to cover the floor with a checkerboard, an editor paints projective structure from which classical vanishing-point geometry reads pitch, roll, focal length, yaw and, on renders, the principal point, without any training. Unlike a calibrator such as GeoCalib, which estimates the camera of an image, this isolates the camera under which the editor paints. On 120 rendered cameras with exact ground truth, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 paints tile edges that meet their vanishing points within 0.26 degrees, and its implicit camera matches the true one to 0.8 degrees in pitch and 6% in focal length, more accurately than GeoCalib except in roll. Asked to draw the horizon or mark a vanishing point instead, the editor fails, so this knowledge is revealed by painting and not by the explicit tasks we tried. The implicit camera has two priors: roll is pulled towards level (slope 0.71), and telephoto perspective towards a default of about 30 mm, which roughly matches the camera the models paint without any scene. For Qwen, the priors do not grow when blur removes four fifths of the line evidence. They are stronger on real photographs, and on NYUv2 a shorter wording of the task removes the difference for roll. On photographs from a 24--240 mm zoom lens the painted perspective grows with only 0.62 of the lens's slope, while GeoCalib and MoGe-2 saturate at about 52 and 42 mm. FLUX.1 Kontext and LongCat-Image-Edit are pulled much harder. Finally, from a level camera a camera-control LoRA executes pose commands at only 50--70% of their strength, and a board painted into its output agrees with the camera it produced.

</details>


### [185] [Multi-Site Real-World Performance of Commercial AI for Pulmonary and Incidental Pulmonary Embolism Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37750)
*Aawez Mansuri,Mohammadreza Chavoshi,Theodorus Dapamede,Wasif Bala,Beatrice Brown-Mulry,Rohan Isaac,Bardia Khosravi,Hanzhou Li,Frank Li,John T. Moon,Chad Robichaux,Dan I. G. Cohen-Addad,Ninad V. Salastekar,Janice Newsome,Judy W. Gichoya,Hari Trivedi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文回顾性评估了两种FDA认证的AI肺栓塞检测模型在17家机构真实世界数据中的表现，发现敏感性低于审批基准而特异性超过基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺栓塞是心血管死亡的主要原因，但FDA认证的AI检测模型在真实世界中的表现尚未被充分刻画。

Method: 回顾性评估单一商业平台（Aidoc Medical BriefCase）的两个FDA认证AI算法：一个用于专用CTPA上的PE分诊（n=30,678），另一个用于常规增强CT上的偶发PE检测（n=37,191），覆盖17家机构的学术健康系统。参考标准标签通过经验证的LLM流程从放射报告中提取（准确率97%，kappa=0.94）。

Result: PE模型敏感性86.8%、特异性99.1%，敏感性从鞍状栓塞的99.3%降至亚段PE的72.9%，从急性PE的89.7%降至非急性PE的65.3%。iPE模型敏感性73.5%、特异性99.8%。

Conclusion: 两模型敏感性均低于FDA审批基准但特异性超过基准，对周围性和非急性栓塞表现下降，反映已知的人类阅片局限，凸显了对AI医疗设备进行标准化上市后监测的必要性。

Abstract: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet the real-world performance of FDA-cleared AI detection models remains incompletely characterized. We retrospectively evaluated two FDA-cleared AI algorithms from a single commercial platform (Aidoc Medical BriefCase), one for PE triage on dedicated CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA; n = 30,678) and one for incidental PE (iPE) detection on routine contrast-enhanced CTs (n = 37,191), across a 17-facility academic health system. Reference-standard labels were extracted from radiology reports using a validated LLM pipeline (97% accuracy, kappa = 0.94). The PE model achieved 86.8% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity, with sensitivity declining from 99.3% for saddle emboli to 72.9% for subsegmental PE, and from 89.7% for acute to 65.3% for non-acute PE. The iPE model achieved 73.5% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity. Both models demonstrated lower sensitivity than FDA-clearance benchmarks while exceeding cleared specificity, with diminishing performance for peripheral and non-acute emboli mirroring known human reader limitations and underscoring the need for standardized post-market surveillance of AI-enabled medical devices.

</details>


### [186] [HiRAE: Hierarchical Representation Autoencoding with Residual Budgets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37775)
*Xuanyu Zhu,Yan Bai,Yang Shi,Yihang Lou,Yuanxing Zhang,Tengfei Liu,Jing Jin,Yuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiRAE 提出对各编码器层按深度分组并对最深表示学习残差修正的分层融合框架，通过组内 norm 上限约束修正幅度，在不改变 latent token 数与通道维度的前提下提升重建保真度并保持生成兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练视觉表示虽支持图像生成，但难以完整保留忠实重建所需的细粒度细节；中间编码器层含有互补细节，但直接学习融合会产生难以建模的 latent 分布。现有融合方法需经验性选择层或分阶段优化融合与解码，增加配置成本与训练复杂度。

Method: HiRAE 在全编码器层级上学习分层融合框架：按深度对编码器层分组，对最深表示学习残差修正；用组级 norm cap 相对深锚约束修正幅度，越浅的组预算越紧；HiRAE-24 保持 latent token 数与通道维度不变。

Result: ImageNet-256 上，HiRAE-24 相比 RAEv2 将重建 FID 从 0.299 降至 0.209，并保持有竞争力的引导生成质量。文生图任务中，无论监督微调前后，HiRAE-24 在 GenEval、DPG-Bench、GenAI-Bench 上均优于 RAEv2；相同训练评估协议下，微调后 GenEval 从 84.86 提升至 87.70。

Conclusion: HiRAE 通过分层残差融合与分级 norm 约束，在保持 latent 结构与生成兼容性的同时显著提升重建保真度与文生图对齐质量，无需经验性层选择或分阶段优化。

Abstract: Pretrained visual representations support image generation, but may not fully preserve the fine-grained details needed for faithful reconstruction. Meanwhile, intermediate encoder layers contain complementary visual details, but learning to fuse them for reconstruction can produce a latent distribution that is difficult to model. Existing fusion methods require empirical tuning of layer selection or staged optimization of fusion and decoding, increasing configuration effort or training complexity. We introduce HiRAE (Hierarchical Representation Autoencoder), which learns a hierarchical fusion framework over the full encoder hierarchy to improve reconstruction fidelity while maintaining compatibility with generative modeling. HiRAE groups encoder layers by depth and learns residual corrections to the deepest representation. Group-wise norm caps bound these corrections relative to the deep anchor, with tighter budgets for shallower groups. Our HiRAE-24 preserves the latent token count and channel dimension. On ImageNet-256, HiRAE-24 reduces reconstruction FID from 0.299 to 0.209 relative to RAEv2 while maintaining competitive guided generation quality. For text-to-image generation, HiRAE-24 improves alignment over RAEv2 on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench both before and after supervised fine-tuning. Under the same generator-training and evaluation protocol, post-fine-tuning GenEval increases from 84.86 to 87.70.

</details>


### [187] [A Benchmark & Dataset for Detecting AI-Manipulated Visual Evidence in the Court System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37783)
*Kelly McConvey,Sajad Ebrahimi,Nima Jamali,Jalehsadat Mahdavimoghaddam,Matina Mahdizadeh Sani,Maksym Taranukhin,Wentao Zhang,Jacquelyn Burkell,Yuntian Deng,Karen Eltis,Maura R. Grossman,Vered Shwartz,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CIFAR合成证据语料库，用于检测法庭语境下的AI操纵图像，包含1505张图片及结构化元数据与基线评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 照片证据易被生成式AI篡改，现有取证基准未针对法庭提交的证据形式、可改变证明力的局部编辑及消费级工具威胁模型。

Method: 构建含720张真实控制图与785张操纵/伪造图的语料库，涵盖监控、行车记录仪和手机照片，操纵分为场景条件编辑、局部元素编辑和完全伪造三类，并附来源、层级、子类型、生成器、提示模板等元数据。

Result: 用公开图像操纵检测器建立基线，发现现有系统的错误模式在证据用途上仍存在问题。

Conclusion: 公开数据集、提示、元数据、代码和评测脚本，支持视觉证据认证、信息完整性与司法可信AI研究。

Abstract: Photographic evidence is becoming increasingly vulnerable to forms of alteration and fabrication that existing legal and technical workflows are not well equipped to evaluate. Surveillance frames, dashcam stills, and phone photographs may be used to establish presence, sequence, causation, damage, or identity, yet contemporary generative systems allow non-experts to alter or fabricate such images through ordinary prompt-based interfaces. Existing image-forensics benchmarks provide important resources for face manipulation, classical tampering, and general synthetic-image detection, but they are not organized around the forms of visual evidence submitted in courts, the localized edits that can change what an exhibit appears to prove, or the consumer-tool threat model now facing the justice system. We introduce the CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus for Detecting AI-Manipulated Images, a benchmark for evidentiary image authentication in court and justice-system contexts. The corpus contains 1,505 photographic items, including 720 authentic controls and 785 manipulated or fabricated images, spanning surveillance, dashcam, and consumer-photo imagery. Manipulations are organized into scene-condition edits, localized element edits, and full fabrications produced with contemporary generative systems. Each item is released with structured metadata covering source provenance, manipulation tier, subtype, generator, prompt template, and scene attributes, enabling controlled evaluation beyond aggregate binary detection. We also establish baselines with publicly available image-manipulation detectors, showing that current systems exhibit error profiles that remain problematic for evidentiary use. The dataset, prompts, metadata, code, and baseline evaluation scripts are released to support research on visual evidence authentication, information integrity, and trustworthy AI for the justice system.

</details>


### [188] [Planetary Feature Fields are Scalable Earth Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37784)
*Arjun Rao,Sebastian Loeschcke,Anthony Fuller,Isaac Corley,Nico Lang,Evan Shelhamer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Planetary Feature Fields (PFFs)，将多个遥感数据产品联合建模为时空连续函数，实现高压缩比下保留多产品细节的紧凑表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星观测、预计算嵌入和地图产品描述同一演化中的地球，却被存储为独立、PB级的数据产品，且持续增长，需要能保留时空细节的多产品紧凑表示。

Method: PFFs是空间局部显式-隐式混合神经场：每个场跨产品共享分解特征体积（显式3D网格的因式分解），用轻量隐式解码器跨多时间步重建各产品；支持扩展特征体积加时间步、附加解码器加产品。

Result: 在匹配压缩率下比单产品场重建更准确；相对未压缩源数据1800倍压缩时，重建特征在像素级分割、变化检测、块级分类任务上保留约90%以上性能；端到端特征访问延迟比API和云存储管线降低一个数量级。

Conclusion: PFFs通过利用跨产品冗余，为行星尺度多产品数据提供高压缩、可扩展的紧凑表示，同时保持时空细节与高效访问。

Abstract: Satellite observations, precomputed embeddings, and map products describe the same evolving Earth, yet are stored as independent, petabyte-scale data products. Their continued growth calls for compact representations of multiple products while preserving spatial and temporal detail. We introduce Planetary Feature Fields (PFFs), which exploit redundancy across data products by modeling them jointly as continuous functions of space and time at planetary scale. PFFs are spatially local explicit-implicit (hybrid) neural fields. Each field shares a factored feature volume---a decomposition of an explicit 3D grid with smaller factors---across products, while lightweight implicit decoders reconstruct individual products across multiple timesteps. PFFs reconstruct EO products over space and time more accurately than single-product fields at matched compression rates. At $1800\times$ compression relative to the uncompressed source data, reconstructed features retain approximately $90\%$ or more of the performance achieved with the original features on pixel-level segmentation, change detection, and patch-level classification tasks. PFFs can add new timesteps by extending their factored feature volumes and add new products by attaching new decoders, while leaving existing outputs unchanged. PFFs reduce end-to-end feature access latency by an order of magnitude relative to evaluated API and cloud-storage pipelines.

</details>


### [189] [CHOQOLATE: Organizing Concept Bottleneck Latent Spaces with Choquet Integrals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37786)
*Rémi Kazmierczak,Johanne Cohen,Marianne Clausel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CHOQOLATE，一个基于2-可加Choquet积分的可解释层，用于解决CLIP类概念瓶颈模型中概念纠缠、表征不忠实的问题。它把相关概念合并为紧凑节点，在准确率-可解释性权衡上表现良好，并通过闭合梯度推导解释其机制，还可用Choquet权重映射为Shapley值实现测试时干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于CLIP等视觉语言模型构建的概念瓶颈模型(CBM)用人类可理解的概念表示潜在空间，但这些表示不忠实：相关概念相互纠缠，导致单个概念得分不能反映其预期含义。

Method: 提出CHOQOLATE，一种设计上可解释的层，基于2-可加Choquet积分，将相关概念合并为紧凑节点。此外给出闭合形式的梯度推导，解释Choquet层为何能在无显式监督下驱动这种概念组织；Choquet权重可直接映射为Shapley值，支持测试时干预。

Result: 在四个数据集上，CHOQOLATE取得了更优的准确率-可解释性权衡，节点权重稀疏且语义连贯。实验验证了闭合梯度推导的结论。在标准偏差缓解基准上，训练后抑制虚假概念的效果与需要组标注或重新训练的方法相当，且无需这些条件。

Conclusion: CHOQOLATE通过Choquet积分将纠缠概念组织为语义连贯的紧凑节点，提升了概念瓶颈模型的可解释性与忠实性，并支持无需组标注或重训练的测试时干预，实现良好的准确率-可解释性权衡。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) built on vision-language models such as CLIP represent a latent space as human-understandable concepts. These representations are unfaithful: related concepts are entangled, so individual scores do not reflect their intended meaning. We propose CHOQOLATE, an interpretable-by-design layer based on 2-additive Choquet integrals, which merges correlated concepts into compact nodes. Across four datasets, CHOQOLATE achieves a favorable accuracy-interpretability trade-off, with weight-sparse and semantically coherent nodes. A closed-form gradient derivation, backed by experiments, explains why Choquet layers drive this organization without explicit supervision. Choquet weights also map directly to Shapley values, which enables test-time intervention. On standard bias-mitigation benchmarks, suppressing spurious concepts after training performs on par with methods that require group annotations or retraining, while needing neither.

</details>


### [190] [ByteTraX: Enhancing the ByteTrack Architecture with Optimised Thresholding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37801)
*Thomas A. O'Shea-Wheller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ByteTraX是对ByteTrack多目标跟踪算法的改进，通过统一匹配阈值和严格轨迹初始化标准，在多基准上提升性能并减少身份切换，同时速度提升超10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ByteTrack虽高效，但依赖检测置信度决定关联优先级，易导致轨迹错误重分类和身份切换。

Method: 采用单一统一匹配阈值优化轨迹连续性，并通过严格轨迹初始化标准惩罚身份切换。

Result: 在GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT、DeepSea-MOT等基准上一致提升；身份切换减少>40%，HOTA平均+3.6，IDF1+5.6，FPS+6.3，处理速度提升>10%。

Conclusion: ByteTraX在保持实时部署效率的同时显著优于ByteTrack，并提供开源代码、YOLO集成及部署说明。

Abstract: The ByteTrack algorithm is a widely used and computationally efficient multi-object tracking architecture. Its core innovation lies in the combination of lenient bounding box associations with tracklet similarity matching to robustly deal with object occlusions. However, this strategy is nevertheless vulnerable to erroneous track reclassification and identity switching, as detection confidence scores dictate association priority. To address this, I present a simple enhancement of the ByteTrack architecture, named ByteTraX, that optimises track continuity via a single unified matching threshold, while penalising identity switches through stringent track initiation criteria. This approach achieves consistently improved performance across a range of diverse benchmarks including GMOT-40, LC-MOT, SportsMOT, TeamTrack, DAMUNT, and DeepSea-MOT, while simultaneously increasing processing speed by >10%. Specifically, results demonstrate a >40% reduction in identity switches, accompanied by mean increases in HOTA of 3.6, IDF1 of 5.6, and FPS of 6.3. As such, adoption of the ByteTraX algorithm has the potential to substantially enhance tracking performance over the ByteTrack baseline, while retaining the efficiency needed for real-time deployment. To facilitate usage, I provide the source code, integration functionality for the YOLO family of object detection models, and deployment instructions via an open source repository.

</details>


### [191] [Pixel-Level Transformers in Remote Sensing: A Canopy Height Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37809)
*Sven Ligensa,Jan Pauls,Karsten Schrödter,Ibrahim Fayad,Fabian Gieseke*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究基于Transformer的中分辨率卫星影像冠层高度回归任务，发现像素级注意力优于大patch方案，并通过高效注意力变体权衡预测质量与资源开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林对缓解气候变化至关重要，利用中分辨率卫星影像预测冠层高度是可扩展的森林状态评估手段。Transformer虽在诸多领域表现优异，但直接用于像素级密集回归时常效果不佳，patch大小对性能影响关键，且像素级注意力资源消耗巨大。

Method: 采用像素级注意力方案，系统研究高效注意力变体，进行大量实验以在预测质量与资源需求之间寻找有利权衡，并与领域内多种成熟模型进行全面对比。

Result: 像素级注意力模型普遍优于依赖较大patch的模型；在合适超参数下，基于Transformer的架构可超越竞争方法；高效注意力变体可实现质量与资源的良好折衷。

Conclusion: 为基于中分辨率卫星影像的像素级回归任务（如冠层高度与生物量估计、土壤湿度制图和产量预测）的模型设计提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Predicting canopy height from medium-resolution satellite imagery is a common and scalable approach for assessing the condition of the world's forests, which play a crucial role in climate change mitigation. While Transformer-based architectures have shown strong performance in many domains, their straightforward application to dense (i.e., pixel-level) regression tasks often yields suboptimal results. In particular, the patch size has a crucial impact on the model performance. In this work, we consider pixel-level attention schemes and show that the resulting models generally outperform those relying on larger patch sizes. However, pixel-level attention can be a prohibitively resource-intensive operation. For this reason, we conduct an extensive experimental study using efficient attention variants to identify favorable trade-offs between prediction quality and resource requirements, facilitating the practical deployment of the proposed models. In addition, we perform a comprehensive comparison with several well-established models in the field and show that, with suitable hyperparameter choices, Transformer-based architectures can outperform competing approaches. Our findings provide practical guidance for designing models for pixel-level regression tasks on medium-resolution satellite imagery, including canopy height and biomass estimation, soil moisture mapping, and yield forecasting.

</details>


### [192] [WINGS: Reference-Free Gaussian Splatting Inpainting with 3D-Native Generative Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37816)
*Noé Lallouet,Michael Fischer,Elie Michel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个在3D原生生成先验的潜空间中直接操作的Gaussian Splatting补全方法，无需参考视图，避免多视图不一致并加速优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D场景补全需在3D空间掩码区域生成合理内容。现有方法依赖2D扩散模型生成一个或多个修复参考视图，存在多视图不一致和优化时间过长的问题。

Method: 参考-free的3D原生Gaussian Splatting补全：利用大规模预训练3D先验的嵌入空间，结合结构补全网络，驱动生成先验重建缺失区域的几何与外观，整个内容生成过程在3D中完成。

Result: 通过大量实验和用户研究，在定性、定量两方面验证了方法有效性，且比相关2D方法更快。

Conclusion: 这是首个不依赖修复参考视图、在3D原生生成先验学习表示空间中操作的Gaussian Splatting补全方法。

Abstract: Inpainting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, a key challenge in 3D editing, requires generating plausible content within a masked region of 3D space. Prior approaches rely on 2D diffusion models to produce one or several inpainted reference views, making them susceptible to challenges associated with multi-view inconsistency and lengthy optimization times. Departing from these approaches, we introduce a reference-free Gaussian splatting inpainting method operating natively in 3D. Our method leverages the embedding space of a large, pre-trained 3D prior, combined with a structure completion network to feed a generative prior which reconstructs the missing region's geometry and appearance. Performing content generation entirely in 3D, it avoids the need to reconcile inconsistencies of multiple inpainted reference images, and is faster than related 2D-based methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method qualitatively and quantitatively, through extensive experiments and a user study. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first Gaussian splatting inpainting method to operate in the learned representation space of a 3D-native generative prior without relying on inpainted reference views.

</details>


### [193] [Minkowski Attractor Networks: Closed-Form Hyperbolic Flows for Visual Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37817)
*Zhongping Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Minkowski Attractor Networks (MAN)，用伪黎曼 Minkowski 时空实现双曲几何表示，避免黎曼优化与迭代收缩，构建高吞吐视觉骨干。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面欧氏空间与环面曲率为零、体积多项式增长，难以嵌入多尺度树状视觉层级，导致度量畸变；双曲空间虽有指数体积增长，但已有方法依赖黎曼优化、gyrovector 演算与浮点不稳定。

Method: 将双曲流形视为二次曲面水平集，在 R^{1,m} 中结合线性 Lorentz 群传输、非线性锥提升与闭式径向重缩放，无需 ODE 求解或迭代回缩。MAN-2D 用 R^{1,1}→H^1，将通道分解为 D/2 个独立二维 Minkowski 块；MAN-4D 用 R^{1,3}→H^3，通过 SO^+(1,3) 的交换 Cartan 子代数参数化，用两个交换二维平面映射实现 4D Lorentz 等距。

Result: MAN-2D 作为高吞吐视觉骨干，最大化通道分解粒度；MAN-4D 实现无矩阵指数开销的 4D Lorentz 等距计算。

Conclusion: MAN 以算子分裂思路在 Minkowski 时空中高效实现双曲表示学习，单次前向即可完成，兼顾数值稳定与计算效率。

Abstract: Geometric representation learning predominantly scaffolds representations onto flat Euclidean subspaces or compact product tori ($\mathbb{T}^K$). However, flat manifolds possess vanishing curvature and polynomial volume growth, inherently suffering from metric distortion when embedding multi-scale, tree-like visual hierarchies. While hyperbolic spaces ($\mathbb{H}^m$) circumvent this via constant negative curvature ($K<0$) and exponential volume expansion, prior hyperbolic deep architectures are hindered by computationally cumbersome Riemannian optimization, non-linear gyrovector calculus, and floating-point instabilities.
  In this work, we introduce \textbf{Minkowski Attractor Networks (MAN)}, an operator-splitting-inspired framework that embeds representations within pseudo-Riemannian Minkowski spacetime ($\mathbb{R}^{1,m}$). By framing hyperbolic manifolds as quadric level sets, MAN resolves hyperbolic geometry by combining linear Lorentz group transport with non-linear cone lifting and closed-form radial rescaling, evaluating in a single forward pass without numerical ODE solvers or iterative retractions.
