Method: 论文从三方面设计：(1) 教师匹配侧，诊断发现低噪声RGB匹配由局部纹理线索主导，故采用固定高噪声匹配带；(2) 真实数据侧，利用原生干净RGB输出，设计DINO-Adv将DINO视觉表示引入对抗梯度路径，去除fake-score critic并提供局部参数化patch引导；(3) 分布级引导，提出无参数辅助语义分布场目标AF-Loss，在共享DINOv2空间的detached滚动真实/生成支撑集上运作，同时保留提示条件教师监督，不增加可学习参数或推理开销。三者共同构成DMA²。

Result: 四步DMA²学生模型在DPG-Bench、GenEval、VQAScore和COCO30K四个基准上均优于25步教师模型以及所评估的少步蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: 重新设计面向像素空间扩散的DMD接口（固定高噪声匹配、DINO-Adv与AF-Loss）可显著提升少步蒸馏性能，使4步学生超越25步教师，证明了原生RGB空间在文本到图像DMD中的设计价值。

Abstract: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) provides a general framework for few-step diffusion generation, but its modern text-to-image instantiations have been developed primarily around latent diffusion. It therefore overlooks key properties and design opportunities of native RGB. We revisit two DMD interfaces for pixel-space teachers. On the teacher-matching side, diagnostics show low-noise RGB matching is dominated by a local-texture cue, motivating a fixed high-noise matching band. On the real-data side, native clean-RGB outputs allow guidance from an external visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the heavy fake-score critic. DINO-Adv removes this critic from the adversarial gradient path and supplies local parametric patch guidance. For distribution-level guidance, we introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. It operates on detached rolling real and generated supports in the shared DINOv2 space while preserving prompt-conditioned teacher supervision. AF-Loss adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation. Together these designs form DMA$^2$. Across DPG-Bench, GenEval, VQAScore, and COCO30K, the four-step DMA$^2$ student performs better than the 25-step teacher and evaluated few-step distillers.

</details>


### [230] [Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38163)
*Haoyi Jiang,Liu Liu,Xinjiang Wang,Zhihao Sun,Zequn Chen,Sen Wang,Xinjie Wang,Xia Chen,Jingfeng Yao,Weiheng Zhao,Shanglin Yuan,Zhizhong Su,Wei Sui,Wenyu Liu,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出ReWAM，一种以表示为中心的世界-动作模型，基于预训练DINO特征，无需生成式视频预训练，在RoboTwin 2.0达93.6%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型将表示空间作为控制与预测的接口，但已有设计不清楚该空间应如何构建；单纯的重建保真度或预训练感知特征都不足以保证有效的策略学习。

Method: ReWAM基于预训练DINO特征，采用特征校准（Feature Calibration）和时间表示瓶颈（Temporal Representation Bottleneck）将特征组织成适合动态建模的紧凑世界状态；动作接地表示整形（Action-Grounded Representation Shaping）仅将动作损失梯度传至瓶颈，使策略塑造表示编码内容，而世界模型学习其演化。

Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上达93.6%成功率；在RoboDojo上使用约600小时具身预训练数据，平均得分12.29，成功率8.28%。

Conclusion: 通过受控比较揭示表示设计的重要性，ReWAM证明无需生成式视频预训练也能实现强性能，表示空间应由动作与动态建模共同塑造。

Abstract: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.

</details>


### [231] [Cropland PAtteRNS: Parallel Dimensional Attention Networks and Attention to Dataset Disparity for Crop Segmentation in Satellite Imagery Time Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38165)
*Joseph Metcalfe,Sara Sharifzadeh,Fabio Caraffini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Cropland PAtteRNS 混合 Transformer-卷积模型，对 Sentinel-2 时序数据的时序、光谱、空间三维分别做自注意力，实现全分解注意力并在作物分割任务上超越 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 SITS 作物分割领域过度追求新架构与大数据集，忽视关键细节：缺少对时序、光谱、空间三维的联合精细建模，且数据集类别分组与不同 tile-size 变体导致结果不可比。

Method: 提出 Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation（PAtteRNS），首个分别对时序、光谱、空间维度使用自注意力机制的混合 Transformer-卷积模型；设计新型并行 Transformer 架构实现全分解注意力，大幅降低三重分解自注意力的计算复杂度。在 PASTIS 和 MTLCC 数据集的多种 tile-size 变体上进行深度消融实验与对比。

Result: 在作物类别分割任务中全面超越所有对比模型，多种分割指标均验证；在少被关注的田块边界质量（Boundary IoU）上优势尤为显著。同时发现数据集内错误的类别分组会显著降低模型性能，且不同 tile-size 变体结果不可比，使跨 tile-size 的模型比较失效。

Conclusion: 建议标准化 SITS 作物分割数据集构建的最佳实践，并推动未来动态 tile-size 方法以获得理想模型性能。

Abstract: The landscape of satellite imagery time series datasets and boundary-pushing architectures for cropland segmentation has never been richer. However, in this gold rush, important truths are being missed on both fronts, as a drive for the most novel concepts or the largest datasets pushes finer details to the side. In this paper, we present our hybrid transformer-convolutional model, Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation (PAtteRNS), the first model to use self-attention mechanisms separately for each of the temporal, spectral, and spatial aspects of Sentinel-2 multispectral SITS data. To achieve fully-factorised attention in our proposed model, we introduce a novel parallel transformer architecture which significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention. We validate our architecture with an in-depth ablation study, and analyse the performance of our model against state-of-the-art crop segmentation models on multiple tile-size variants of the popular PASTIS and MTLCC datasets. Our findings show our model to outperform all others in the task of crop class segmentation, verified across multiple important segmentation metrics, with especially strong performance against compared models seen in the often under-reported parcel delineation quality, for which we use the Boundary IoU metric. We also find that flawed class groupings within datasets can have a significant negative impact on model performance, and report that alternate tile-size variants of crop segmentation datasets produce results incomparable to one-another, invalidating fair comparison between model performance when trained on different tile-sizes. Based on these findings, we suggest further work is required to standardise best practices when constructing SITS crop segmentation datasets, and to enable future dynamic-tile-sizing for ideal model performance.

</details>


### [232] [Adversarial Training for Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38170)
*Xin Lin,Zhifei Zhang,Yuqian Zhou,Haitian Zheng,Zhe Lin,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对像素扩散模型进行对抗后训练，能在不改变架构和采样流程的前提下，修正其高频细节不足，联合提升保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐与感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素扩散模型直接生成 RGB 图像，规避了自编码器瓶颈，但其输出系统性地低估了自然图像的细粒度统计特性（尤其是高频内容）。作者希望找到一种能有效修正这一缺陷的后训练方法。

Method: 从预训练模型出发，保留原有扩散/流匹配目标，在非高噪声时间步对预测输出加入对抗损失，不改变模型架构与采样过程。跨两个像素骨干网络进行实验，并通过频带/幂律分析、感知损失对比、最近邻/召回/无 GAN 的 SFT 对照，以及对潜扩散配置的测试来探究机制与边界。

Result: 方法联合改善了分布保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐和感知质量。频带与幂律分析显示原模型系统性欠产高频内容，对抗后训练恢复了缺失的谱功率；感知损失虽也提升高频，却牺牲了保真度与提示对齐。对照实验排除了记忆化、模式丢失和额外优化等解释。相同流程在测试的潜扩散配置下未带来可比收益，且几乎不增加解码高频功率。

Conclusion: 对抗后训练能有效修正像素扩散模型的高频统计缺陷并带来多方面联合提升；直接访问待修正图像的输出统计，是决定对抗后训练能否成功的关键因素。

Abstract: Pixel diffusion models generate RGB images directly, avoiding the bottleneck of an autoencoder, yet their outputs still systematically underrepresent fine-scale natural-image statistics. We show that adversarial learning provides an effective post-training correction for this deficiency. Starting from a pretrained model, we retain its original diffusion or flow-matching objective and add an adversarial loss to the predicted output at non-high-noise timesteps, leaving the model architecture and sampling procedure unchanged. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of adversarial post-training for pixel diffusion. Across two pixel backbones, the method jointly improves distribution fidelity, coverage, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality. We further investigate why it works. Frequency-band and power-law analyses show that the original models systematically underproduce natural-image high-frequency content, while adversarial post-training restores this missing spectral power. In contrast, perceptual loss also increases high-frequency content but sacrifices distribution fidelity and prompt alignment. Nearest-neighbor, recall, and matched no-GAN SFT controls further rule out memorization, mode dropping, and additional optimization as simple explanations. Finally, we examine the boundary of this effect. Under the tested latent diffusion configurations, the same procedure does not produce comparable joint gains and adds almost no decoded high-frequency power. These results identify direct output access to the image statistics being corrected as a key factor governing when adversarial post-training succeeds.

</details>


### [233] [Point2Part: Unified 3D Partitioning from Point Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38180)
*Hao-Tang Tsui,Yu-Rou Tuan,Xiaoxuan Ma,Nicolas Ugrinovic,Takaaki Shiratori,Kris Kitani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可提示的3D部件分解模型，将整个形状划分为无重叠、完整覆盖的部件，统一支持图像/网格到部件生成及部件分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D部件分解方法允许部件重叠或存在空隙，无法完整覆盖原形状，阻碍下游部件级应用。

Method: 基于预训练3D生成模型获取形状隐变量；用提示编码器将每个3D点提示映射为部件token并关注形状隐变量；设计部件解码器对所有部件token进行从粗到细的联合打分，将形状体素内每个位置唯一分配给一个部件。

Result: 在三个任务的部件质量指标上均超越现有方法，部件兼容性较此前SOTA提升一个数量级。

Conclusion: 将部件分解作为整体形状的联合划分，在共享形状隐空间中实现统一模型，效果显著优于已有方法。

Abstract: Existing 3D part decomposition methods do not necessarily partition the original shape into non-overlapping parts that collectively cover the entire shape, allowing overlaps or gaps that hinder downstream part-level applications. We instead formulate part decomposition as a joint partitioning of the entire shape, where the predicted parts are non-overlapping and jointly recover the entire shape. Our key insight is that part decomposition should consider all desired parts jointly, rather than modeling each part independently. To this end, we develop a promptable model for 3D part decomposition from images or meshes. Users can specify desired parts through 3D point prompts for controllable decomposition. Given one point prompt per desired part, our model produces the corresponding parts as a complete partition of the entire shape. We build on a pretrained 3D generation model and first obtain a shape latent from either an input image or mesh. We then introduce a prompt encoder that maps each 3D point prompt to a part token while attending to the shape latent. To decode the desired parts, we propose a novel part decoder jointly scoring the entire shape against all part tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, assigning every position within the shape volume to exactly one part. We perform part decomposition in this shared shape latent space, enabling a unified model for image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation. Our method outperforms existing works on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, and improves compatibility among parts by an order of magnitude over previous SOTA methods. Code and models will be released.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [234] [FD-VAD: Semantic Endpoint Detection for Streaming Full-Duplex Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35791)
*Puneet Mathur,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出FD-VAD，一种无需ASR的流式语义端点检测器，将语义端点检测建模为因果音频-语言推理任务，直接从有界因果音频窗口映射到继续/停止决策，在零样本设置下取得了领先的端点召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音交互中的自然轮流需要从部分语音中判断停顿是犹豫还是完成的对话意图。声学VAD缺乏语义信息，而基于级联ASR的端点检测依赖转录并引入额外处理阶段。

Method: 将语义端点检测形式化为因果音频-语言推理任务，提出FD-VAD：结合冻结语音编码器、轻量模态适配器和参数高效微调的语言模型，采用last-chunk训练目标实现流式推理；并引入置信度门控端点确认以控制打断与延迟，以及边界聚焦的难负样本采样。

Result: 在领域内和对话评估中，FD-VAD优于强流式与非流式语义轮次分类器，在TurnBench dev集零样本设置下（FP<=0.10）取得合格系统中最高的EOT召回率0.853。

Conclusion: 语义端点检测可直接从流式音频完成，无需中间ASR或对话状态跟踪。

Abstract: Natural turn-taking in full-duplex voice interaction requires determining from partial speech whether a pause reflects hesitation or a completed conversational intent. Acoustic voice activity detection lacks this semantic information, while cascaded ASR-based endpointing introduces transcription dependence and additional processing stages. We formulate semantic endpoint detection as a causal audio-language reasoning task and introduce FD-VAD, an ASR-free streaming endpointer that maps bounded causal audio windows directly to Continue/Stop decisions. FD-VAD combines a frozen speech encoder with a lightweight modality adapter and a parameter-efficiently adapted language model, using a last-chunk training objective for streaming inference. We further introduce confidence-gated endpoint commitment to control interruption versus delay and boundary-focused hard-negative sampling to improve decisions around ambiguous turn boundaries. Across in-domain and conversational evaluations, FD-VAD outperforms strong streaming and non-streaming semantic turn classifiers, and achieves the highest EOT recall among qualifying systems on TurnBench dev set $0.853$ (at FP<=0.10) in a zero-shot setting. These results show that semantic endpointing can be performed directly from streaming audio without intermediate ASR or dialogue state tracking.

</details>


### [235] [Sieve and Sage: Efficient Distraction Filtering for Reliable RALM Abstention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35794)
*Jongbin Won,Sung Geun An,Jay-yoon Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出将检索失败分为"无法回答"和"被干扰"两种状态，用轻量级模块Sieve先筛除干扰证据，再交由大模型Sage生成或弃答，显著提升准确率与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖单一大型LLM一步处理异构检索失败，导致弃答性能有限且计算成本高。

Method: 将检索失败分解为无证据的"无法回答"和相关证据混杂冲突/否定/对抗信息的"被干扰"两态；据此设计轻量模块Sieve在调用昂贵LLM（Sage）前筛除文档集中的干扰证据。

Result: 在通用和高风险专家领域评估中，相较单阶段基线准确率提升最高69.4个百分点，Macro-F1提升55.2个百分点，并实现最高1.99倍加速。

Conclusion: Sieve与Sage框架能预判并清除干扰噪声，为带弃答能力的RALM提供高效可靠的流水线。

Abstract: Just as Socrates recognized the limits of his own knowledge, Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) should learn to abstain when the retrieved evidence cannot support a reliable response. Existing approaches largely rely on monolithic LLMs to handle heterogeneous retrieval failures in a single step, resulting in limited abstention performance and high computational costs. We instead decompose retrieval failures into two distinct states: (i) the unanswerable state, where the required evidence is absent, and (ii) the distracted state, where relevant evidence is mixed with conflicting, negated, or adversarial information. Based on this decomposition, we introduce a lightweight module (Sieve) that screens retrieved document sets for distracting evidence before invoking a costly LLM (Sage) for grounded generation and abstention. Evaluated across both general and high-stakes expert domains, our Sieve and Sage framework preemptively detects distracting noise, improving system accuracy by up to 69.4 percentage points and Macro-F1 by 55.2 percentage points compared to one-stage baselines. Furthermore, it achieves up to a 1.99x speedup, establishing a highly efficient and reliable abstention pipeline for RALM with abstention.

</details>


### [236] [Developing an OCR model for Extracting Information from Invoices with Korean Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35796)
*Xiem HoangVan,Phu TranQuang,Minh DinhBao,Tien VuHuu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合深度学习与图像预处理的高效OCR模型，用于从韩语发票中自动提取关键信息，在收集的发票数据集上达到87% F1分数且处理时间可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发票包含购买项、时间、金额等关键信息，自动提取这些信息很重要。韩语是全球约8000万人的母语，在韩国及越南、菲律宾等设有大量韩企的国家都很重要，因此需要针对韩语发票的信息提取方案。

Method: 提出一种将深度学习模型与若干图像预处理技术相结合的OCR模型，用于韩语发票信息的自动提取。

Result: 在收集的丰富发票数据集上评估，达到87%的F1分数，且处理时间可忽略。

Conclusion: 该OCR模型能高效、准确地从韩语发票中提取信息，具有较强的实用价值。

Abstract: Invoices are commercial documents that contain various pieces of information, including the purchased items, time, and total money. Making the extraction of important information crucial. The stored information serves different purposes. Korean language is the native language of about 80 million people, playing an important role in not only South and North Korea but also in many other countries such as Vietnam, Philippine where a large number of Korean companies are located. In this context, to automatically extract proper information from the invoices with Korean language, we propose an efficient Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model in which a deep learning model is combined with some image preprocessing techniques. The proposed OCR model is assessed in a rich set of collected invoices showing that 87% F1-score can be achieved with negligible time processing.

</details>


### [237] [Rethinking Multimodal Fake News Detection in the Generative AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36850)
*Wenbin Shen,Guoxuan Qin,Guangxu Yao,Baodong Wang,Yuanbo Rui,Zhichao Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对生成式内容融入新闻场景,构建Weibo26数据集并提出GAHR框架,将生成性信息融入假新闻真实性推理,兼顾真实性检测与生成内容识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式内容日益进入新闻生产与传播,使假新闻从人工捏造变为原生与生成内容混合的复杂形态。现有多模态假新闻检测侧重真实性评估,很少刻画生成性差异对证据可靠性的影响;而AIGC检测仅判断内容是否由生成模型产生,无法判断新闻事件本身真假。两类任务在数据与评估上割裂。

Method: 构建面向生成式内容场景的多模态假新闻检测数据集Weibo26;提出Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning(GAHR)框架,将全局判断与局部校正相结合,使生成性信息参与新闻真实性推理。

Result: 在多个现有假新闻检测基准与Weibo26上的实验表明,GAHR在取得有竞争力的真实性检测性能的同时,能有效识别生成式内容。

Conclusion: GAHR弥合了假新闻检测与AIGC检测之间的割裂,实现了真实性判断与生成内容识别的统一,为生成式内容场景下的假新闻检测提供了数据与评估基础。

Abstract: Generative content is increasingly entering the production and dissemination of news, transforming fake news from manually fabricated or simply manipulated material into complex forms in which native and generated content jointly participate. Existing multimodal fake news detection research primarily focuses on veracity assessment and rarely characterizes how generativity differences affect the reliability of evidence. In contrast, AIGC detection primarily determines whether content is generated or modified by generative models, but it does not by itself establish whether the underlying news event is true. To bridge the separation between these tasks in data and evaluation, we construct Weibo26, a multimodal fake news detection dataset for generative-content scenarios. On this basis, we propose the Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR) framework, which combines global judgment with local correction so that generativity information participates in news-veracity reasoning. Experiments on multiple existing fake news detection benchmarks and Weibo26 show that GAHR achieves competitive veracity-detection performance while effectively identifying generative content.

</details>


### [238] [Evaluating the Effects of Prompt Perturbation on Bias and Hallucination in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35804)
*Mamehgol Yousefi,Ahmad Shahi,Mos Sharifi,Alvaro Romera,Simon Hoermann,Tham Piumsomboon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估LLM在决策任务中对扰动词句的鲁棒性，发现扰动有时可缓解偏见与幻觉，且Claude 3整体优于GPT-3.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被广泛用作决策辅助，但其可靠性受偏见和幻觉影响；作者欲探究扰动词句是否影响LLM决策的鲁棒性与可靠性。

Method: 对原始查询进行扰动生成变体，并在多个决策任务数据集上评估不同LLM（如Claude 3与GPT-3.5）的表现，比较其偏见、幻觉及任务有效性。

Result: 与既有研究相反，扰动在某些LLM上可缓解偏见和幻觉；Claude 3在多数数据集任务上更有效，GPT-3.5表现参差、部分可比但部分明显落后。

Conclusion: 需对LLM决策辅助工具进行严格测试与验证；本研究为开发更鲁棒、可信的AI决策助手提供参考。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in various natural language processing tasks, leading to their widespread deployment as intelligent assistants in decision-making contexts. However, the increasing complexity of these models raises concerns about their reliability, particularly regarding bias and hallucination. In this work, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs to perturbed variations of the original inquiry in decision-making tasks. We show that contrary to previous studies, perturbations can mitigate bias and hallucination in some LLMs over other models. It's found that Claude 3 is more effective for the tasks represented in most datasets, whereas models like GPT3.5 exhibit varying levels of adequacy, performing comparably in some cases but falling significantly behind in others. These insights are crucial for understanding the practical implications of deploying LLM-based assistants as effective decision-support tools in real-world applications, emphasising the need for rigorous testing and validation to ensure reliability and effectiveness. This study contributes to the growing body of research on LLM evaluation and provides insights for developing more robust and trustworthy AI assistants in critical decision-making contexts.

</details>


### [239] [HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36303)
*Feijie Wu,Hugo Barbalho,Konstantina Mellou,Marco Molinaro,Jing Gao,Ishai Menache,Xinzhi Zhang,Sirui Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HeurEvo是一个自动化"计划-代码-组件"协同进化框架，联合进化算法高层结构、实现代码和可复用组件池，在严格运行时约束下生成高质量优化求解方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有agentic启发式设计方法通常在预定义流程内改进启发式组件，或孤立地调整求解器配置，无法整体性地适应计算资源分配、求解器利用和算法结构调整。

Method: 提出HeurEvo框架：planner决定使用哪些组件、如何组合及跨阶段运行时分配；coder将计划实现为可执行代码；component evolver更新共享组件池。在island-based进化框架中，计划与实现协同进化，并由interpreter agent分析执行结果、识别改进机会提供反馈。

Result: 在多种组合优化基准和困难的MIPLIB实例上，HeurEvo在紧张运行时预算内找到高质量解，常达到或超越需数小时至数天计算的最先进求解器；在六边形填充等非线性几何问题上改善了此前最佳结果。

Conclusion: 联合搜索算法结构与实现对于agentic启发式设计具有重要价值。

Abstract: Recent advances in agentic heuristic design use AI agents and execution feedback to automate algorithm discovery for challenging optimization problems. In many practical settings, high-quality solutions must be obtained under strict runtime constraints, motivating hybrid approaches that combine problem-specific heuristics with powerful mathematical programming solvers. However, existing approaches typically improve heuristic components within predefined procedures or tune solver configurations in isolation. This limits holistic adaptation of where to allocate computation, how to leverage solvers, and how to refine the overall algorithmic structure. To address these limitations, we propose HeurEvo, an automated plan--code--component co-evolution framework that jointly evolves the high-level algorithmic structures, their implementations, and a shared pool of reusable components. A planner determines which algorithmic components to use, how to combine them, and how to allocate runtime across stages, a coder realizes the resulting plan as executable code, while a component evolver updates the shared component pool. Within an island-based evolutionary framework, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and identifies opportunities for improvement. Across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within tight runtime budgets, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art optimization solvers given hours or days of computation. On several nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing, it also improves upon the best previously reported results. These results highlight the value of jointly searching over algorithmic structure and implementation for agentic heuristic design.

</details>


### [240] [RAEGNet: Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network for Harm-Aware Multimodal Fake News Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36902)
*Wenbin Shen,Guoxuan Qin,Guangxu Yao,Baodong Wang,Yuanbo Rui,Zhongjie Ba,Zhichao Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出事件级证据检索框架ELERF与关系感知证据图网络RAEGNet，同时建模新闻真实性与潜在危害，在多个数据集上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚假新闻检测依赖实体级检索引入事件无关噪声，且只关注整体性能，忽略不同实例危害程度的差异。

Method: ELERF基于新闻的完整事件语义检索外部证据；RAEGNet构建含新闻-证据立场关系与证据-证据交互关系的有向图，并引入条件危害分支联合建模真实性与潜在危害。

Result: 在Weibo-21、Fakeddit及自建SSS数据集上，所有评估指标均优于多个基线方法。

Conclusion: 事件级证据检索结合关系图建模能有效减少噪声并兼顾危害性评估，提升多模态虚假新闻检测性能。

Abstract: Existing multimodal fake news detection methods often introduce external information to assist detection. However, most of them rely on entity-level retrieval and are therefore prone to introducing event-irrelevant noise. Meanwhile, existing methods mainly focus on improving overall performance and do not account for differences in the degree of harm posed by different instances of fake news. To address these limitations, we design an Event-Level Evidence Retrieval Framework (ELERF) and propose a Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network (RAEGNet). ELERF retrieves external evidence based on the complete event semantics of a news item. RAEGNet constructs a directed graph that incorporates news-evidence stance relations and evidence-evidence interaction relations, and introduces a conditional-harm branch to jointly model authenticity and potential harm. Experimental results demonstrate that RAEGNet outperforms multiple baseline methods across all evaluated metrics on Weibo-21, Fakeddit, and our self-constructed SSS dataset.

</details>


### [241] [Alignment Forecasting: Predicting Misalignment From Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35805)
*Chen Yueh-Han,Bruce W. Lee,Ilia Sucholutsky,Tomek Korbak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Alignment Forecasting任务，在微调前预测数据是否会导致对齐失败，并构建ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准（5000+问题，17模型/32数据集/16失败模式）；提出预测支架方法，效果优于基线，并能筛出有害训练样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练数据中微小缺陷有时会导致模型广泛失准，仅看数据表面难以判断，目前只能训练后审计模型。希望补充事后审计，实现训练前的对齐失败预测。

Method: 定义Alignment Forecasting：给定目标模型、微调数据集和失败模式，输出微调后该失败模式显著增加的概率。构建ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准。提出预测支架：LLM阅读数据集并评估其将模型推向失当行为的强度与广度，再由简单学习模型结合失败模式基率和目标模型先验倾向进行预测。

Result: 前沿模型直接提示表现差；预测支架显著高于随机，并优于在该任务上微调的模型以及能看到弱模型微调后行为的简单预测器；其信号能标记前沿模型分类器遗漏的有害样本；过滤UltraChat等数据中此类样本后，多数情况下模型更对齐（选择题评估），但开放式对话收益不明确。

Conclusion: 预测器尚不能可靠指导实际训练数据筛选，但在SFT场景下，训练前预测多种对齐失败是可行的。

Abstract: Training a language model on data with a narrow flaw can sometimes make the model broadly misaligned. Inspecting the data at face value often does not settle whether it will emerge, and today it is caught only after training, by auditing the resulting model. To complement post-hoc audits, we introduce Alignment Forecasting: the task of predicting alignment failures before training. Given a target model, a fine-tuning dataset, and a failure mode such as deception or sycophancy, a forecaster outputs the probability that fine-tuning would meaningfully increase that failure mode. To measure progress on alignment forecasting, we introduce ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH, a benchmark of over 5,000 forecasting questions spanning 17 target models, 32 datasets, and 16 failure modes. Frontier models prompted directly perform poorly on ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH. We therefore propose a forecasting scaffold in which an LLM reads the dataset and rates how strongly and broadly it pushes the model toward misbehavior, and a simple learned model combines that rating with the failure mode's base rate and the target model's prior tendency. This forecasts well above chance, and beats a model fine-tuned on the task and a simple forecaster allowed to see how weaker models behaved after fine-tuning on the same data. Its signals also flag problematic training examples that a frontier-model classifier misses. Filtering those examples out from real post-training data such as UltraChat results in more aligned models on our multiple-choice evaluation in most cases, though the benefit in open-ended conversations is unclear. More progress is needed before forecasts can reliably guide training data curation in practice, but our results suggest that forecasting many alignment failures before training can be tractable in the SFT setting.

</details>


### [242] [From Lexical Baselines to Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Structured Skill and Responsibility-Level Extraction with the SFIA Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35806)
*Ranuga Disansa,U. S. Samarasinghe,Lasith Gunawardena*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文首次针对SFIA框架提出结构化、层级感知的技能抽取基线，将任务形式化为从自由文本预测(技能, 责任等级)对，并比较五种策略，发现检索方法召回高、生成方法精度高，只有显式决策层级的策略能可靠预测等级，多智能体设计增加延迟但不提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化技能抽取系统多将技能表示为扁平标签，缺乏技能被实践时的责任等级维度。SFIA框架恰好定义了跨七个责任等级的147项IT专业技能，但尚无针对SFIA的基于LLM的自动化抽取研究，因此作者希望建立首个可复现的层级感知技能抽取基线。

Method: 将任务形式化为从自由文本进行(技能, 等级)对的结构化预测，并提出三个研究问题。评估五种策略：词法基线、稠密检索加LLM重排、零样本模式约束LLM、单智能体agentic RAG、以及三智能体（检索-匹配-验证）团队，全部对照专家映射的欧洲ICT角色画像，并使用完全自动化智能体流水线构建的SFIA 9语料库。

Result: 基于检索的匹配识别出最多技能，而生成式策略精度明显更高；只有将等级作为显式决策的策略才能可靠预测等级，基于相似度的选择错误率高出两倍以上；三智能体团队使延迟翻倍却未提升精度。

Conclusion: 添加智能体角色并不自动有利于封闭分类体系的匹配。该研究为针对SFIA的结构化、层级感知技能抽取提供了首个可复现基线，并公开了自动化构建的SFIA 9语料库。

Abstract: Automated skill extraction underpins workforce planning, yet most systems represent skills as flat labels with no notion of the responsibility level at which a skill is practiced. The Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) captures exactly this dimension, defining 147 professional skills across seven responsibility levels, but no automated LLM-based extraction targeting SFIA has been reported. We formalize the task as structured prediction of (skill, level) pairs from free text and ask three questions: how accurately can text be mapped onto SFIA's closed vocabulary, which strategies reliably predict the level alongside the skill, and do agentic designs improve on simpler retrieval and prompting? We evaluate five strategies (a lexical baseline, dense retrieval with LLM reranking, a zero-shot schema-constrained LLM, single-agent agentic RAG, and a three-agent retriever--matcher--verifier crew) against expert-mapped European ICT role profiles, all drawing on an SFIA~9 corpus built by a fully automated agentic pipeline that we release. Retrieval-based matching identifies the most skills while generative strategies are markedly more precise; only strategies assigning the level as an explicit decision predict it reliably, with similarity-based selection more than twice as inaccurate; and the crew doubles latency without improving accuracy, so added agent roles do not automatically benefit closed-taxonomy matching. These results provide the first reproducible baseline for structured, level-aware skill extraction against SFIA.

</details>


### [243] [Environment Steering: Using Data Flow Control to Improve Agent Utility and Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35807)
*Charlie Summers,Prajwal Raghunath,Aaditya Pai,Mayur Kulkarni,Zhuo Zhang,Oliver Kennedy,Eugene Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"环境引导"(Environment Steering):在运行时用数据库表建模agent与执行状态,追踪记录级数据流并按声明式策略检查,违规时给出策略与上下文相关反馈,引导agent走向安全轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent即使被要求安全行事,仍可能发起不安全工具调用。现有防御在执行前约束、修改工具输入输出或依赖LLM裁判,依赖模型行为,且只能阻断不安全动作,无法帮助agent恢复。

Method: 将agent与harness执行状态建模为数据库表,追踪记录级数据流,并在运行时用声明式策略检查这些数据流;检测到违规时,依据策略和上下文生成针对性反馈以引导agent。

Result: 在AgentDyn上,任务成功率相比无防御有所提升,同时攻击成功率达到0%。

Conclusion: 安全性应由执行环境在agent运行过程中强制执行,并在违规时引导其寻找安全替代方案,而非仅靠事前约束或阻断。

Abstract: LLM agents can make unsafe tool calls even when instructed to behave safely. Existing defenses constrain agents before execution, modify tool inputs/outputs, or rely on LLM judges; these approaches may depend on model behavior or block unsafe actions without helping the agent recover. We argue that the execution environment should instead enforce safety as the agent runs and steer it toward safe alternatives when violations occur---we call this Environment Steering. We implement this by modeling the agent and harness execution state as database tables, track the record-level data flows, and check these data flows against declarative policies during runtime. When violations are detected, policy- and context-specific feedback steers the agent toward safe trajectories. On AgentDyn, this enables the agent to improve task success rate over no-defense while achieving 0% attack success rate.

</details>


### [244] [When Successful Memories Mislead Embodied Agents:Memory Adaption For Task-Conditioned Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35808)
*Quanquan Li,Hongbo Zhang,Yihe Chi,Liuyang Song,Jingyu Li,Yuxiang Huang,Hongzhen Zhang,Guitao Cao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MATE是一种确定性的检索后记忆适配流程，将轨迹转化为面向执行的记忆，在ALFWorld上以约1/10 token达到81.3%/93.3%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统主要优化构建与检索，但检索到的经验可能包含不兼容动作或不合适的结构层级，语义相关性与历史成功不足以适配当前执行上下文。

Method: MATE对检索到的轨迹进行后处理：移除过时控制上下文、提取条件-动作-效果转移、执行经验证的动作归一化、选择依赖任务的表示、在固定预算下序列化，无需额外LLM推理。

Result: 在134个ALFWorld任务上，Qwen2.5-14B和72B成功率分别达81.3%和93.3%，token用量约为原始轨迹的1/10；对照实验表明经验证的动作归一化是恢复经验效用的主要机制。

Conclusion: 记忆适配应作为检索与具身执行之间的独立阶段。

Abstract: Experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration in embodied agents, but a trajectory that succeeded previously may be unsuitable for the current execution context. Existing memory systems pri marily optimize construction and retrieval; semantic relevance and historical success therefore remain insufficient when retrieved ex perience contains incompatible actions or an inappropriate level of structure. We introduce Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution (MATE), a deterministic post-retrieval procedure that converts trajectories into execution-oriented memory. MATE re moves obsolete control context, extracts condition-action-effect transitions, applies verified action normalization, selects a task dependent representation, and serializes the result under a fixed budget without additional LLM inference. On 134 ALFWorld tasks, MATE achieves task success rates of 81.3% and 93.3% with Qwen2.5-14B and 72B while using approximately one-tenth of the tokens required by raw trajectories. Controlled comparisons show that verified action normalization is the principal mechanism by which MATE restores the utility of retrieved experience, support ing memory adaptation as a distinct stage between retrieval and embodied execution.

</details>


### [245] [Can Multimodal Large Language Models Generate and Detect Multimodal Social Media Fake News?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35809)
*Jiyao Yang,Yang Liu,Zhenyue Qin,Qingyu Chen,Xiuzhen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究MLLMs是否能被用于大规模制造多模态假新闻，以及它们能否可靠检测此类假新闻。作者提出多智能体框架生成超9000条配对多模态假新闻，并基准测试16个模型，发现多数模型检测能力远低于人类水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展引发了对多模态大模型(MLLMs)被滥用于社交媒体大规模虚假信息宣传的担忧。尽管已有关于文本虚假信息的研究，但一个基本问题仍未解答：MLLMs能否被利用来捏造逼真的多模态假新闻，以及它们能否可靠地检测出这些假新闻。

Method: 提出一个多智能体框架，由故事智能体、图像智能体和评论家智能体协作，生成看似合理地反驳真实新闻的虚假社交媒体帖子。应用该框架在科学、健康和娱乐领域生成超过9000条配对的多模态新闻帖子，并基准测试16个开源和闭源MLLMs进行自动检测。

Result: 大多数模型在检测准确率上远低于人类水平，并且在识别图像真实性方面存在严重失败。

Conclusion: 该研究为开发抵御社交媒体假新闻的稳健防御措施提供了基础。代码和数据已公开。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of generative AI raises concerns about the misuse of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for large-scale disinformation campaigns on social media. Despite existing research on textual disinformation, a fundamental question remains unanswered: can MLLMs be exploited to fabricate realistic multimodal fake news, and can they reliably detect it? We introduce a multi-agent framework in which a story agent, an image agent, and a critic agent collaborate to produce fake social media posts that plausibly counter true news. We apply the framework to generate over 9,000 paired multimodal news posts across science, health, and entertainment domains, and benchmark 16 open- and closed-source MLLMs for automated detection. We find that most models fall substantially short of human-level accuracy and fail critically on identifying image authenticity. Our research provides a foundation for developing robust defenses against social media fake news. Code and data are available at https: //github.com/xiuzhenzhang/Multimodal.

</details>


### [246] [TRACE: Deployable Tree-Relational Structure Enhancement for Oncology LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35810)
*Jizheng Lai,Yingyun Li,Ying Qin,Haiyang Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TRACE，一个树-关系增强框架，通过显式可更新的医学结构提升肿瘤学LLM预测的准确性与可审计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤学LLM预测缺乏对显式医学结构的依赖，导致预测依据薄弱，需要可部署的结构化增强方案。

Method: TRACE将昂贵的离线结构学习与轻量在线推理分离：将肿瘤学概念与关系组织为可更新树-关系结构，利用LM损失驱动的证据进行精炼，推理时检索为紧凑的提示证据，支持零样本下任务自适应证据选择。

Result: 在十个肿瘤学分类任务和一个MedQuAD CancerGov问答基准上，TRACE在无标签评估和有监督微调中均有提升；优于naive RAG和通用GraphRAG，在受控METABRIC输入下仍有效，并生成与临床推理一致的可解释证据路径。

Conclusion: 显式、可更新的医学结构是通往更准确、可审计的肿瘤学LLM部署的实用路径。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in oncology applications, but their predictions are often weakly grounded in explicit medical structure. We present TRACE, a deployable tree-relational enhancement framework for oncology LLMs. TRACE separates expensive offline structure learning from lightweight online inference: oncology concepts and relations are organized into an updatable tree-relational structure, refined using LM-loss-derived evidence, and retrieved at inference time as compact prompt evidence. This design supports task-adaptive evidence selection without requiring supervised labels in the zero-shot setting. Across ten oncology classification tasks and one MedQuAD CancerGov QA benchmark, TRACE improves both label-free evaluation and supervised fine-tuning. Additional analyses show that TRACE improves over vanilla RAG and generic GraphRAG, remains useful under leakage-controlled METABRIC inputs, and produces interpretable evidence paths aligned with clinical reasoning. These results suggest that explicit, updatable medical structure is a practical path toward more accurate and auditable oncology LLM deployment.

</details>


### [247] [Lookahead-R: Budget-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution-Centric Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35811)
*Zongze Wu,Yani Guo,Runnan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Lookahead-R，将工具检索重构为资源受限的序贯决策问题，用轻量执行感知代理世界模型驱动蒙特卡洛树搜索，在ToolBench上实现更优的准确率-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在大型异构API生态中面临工具检索瓶颈：语义检索快但存在语义-功能鸿沟，执行验证精度高但延迟过大，二者难以兼顾。

Method: Lookahead-R引入轻量执行感知代理世界模型，联合预测工具执行成功、延迟成本与语义效用，无需调用真实API；并以此驱动代价敏感、不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在严格预算约束下探索工具空间。

Result: 在ToolBench基准上所有测试场景均取得更优的准确率-效率权衡；在最难的I3划分上NDCG@5达91.40%，超过SOTA ToolGen（90.16%）1.24%。消融实验表明显式延迟建模是资源约束下识别高质量工具的关键判别信号。

Conclusion: 通过将检索建模为规划问题并显式考虑延迟成本，可在不调用真实API的情况下有效提升工具检索的精度与效率。

Abstract: Tool retrieval is a critical bottleneck for LLM-based agents operating over large, heterogeneous API ecosystems. Existing approaches face an inherent trade-off: semantic retrievers are fast but suffer from the semantic-functional gap, while execution-based validation improves precision at the cost of prohibitive latency. We propose Lookahead-R, a planning-based framework that reformulates tool retrieval as a resource-constrained sequential decision-making problem. At its core, Lookahead-R introduces a lightweight execution-aware surrogate world model that jointly predicts tool execution success, latency cost, and semantic utility---without invoking real APIs. This world model drives a cost-sensitive, uncertainty-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search that navigates the tool space under strict budget constraints. Evaluated on the large-scale ToolBench benchmark, Lookahead-R achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off across all test scenarios. On the most challenging I3 split, it attains an NDCG@5 of 91.40\%, outperforming the state-of-the-art ToolGen (90.16\%) by 1.24\%. Ablation studies confirm that explicit latency modeling is the key discriminative signal for identifying high-quality tools under resource constraints.

</details>


### [248] [Automated Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogues in In-Car Conversational Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35812)
*Vaishnav Negi,Lev Sorokin,Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出面向车载对话助手(ICA)多轮对话能力的自动化测试框架，采用黑盒闭环仿真、策略引导用户模拟器和两层LLM评判，能显著发现更多故障类型与故障会话。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车载对话助手日益普及，但现有评测技术多针对单轮场景，难以覆盖多轮交互中的约束处理、上下文保持及安全关键行为，且缺乏显式真值，可靠性保障困难。

Method: 将ICA视为黑盒，通过闭环仿真进行评测：包含策略引导的用户模拟器、对抗式策略管理器，以及评估轮级故障与会话级质量的两层LLM评判器。

Result: 在工业级ICA上针对6个LLM后端和12名人工标注者进行评测；自动评判与人类标注高度一致；策略引导相比无引导仿真每会话多发现2.96倍独特故障类型，独特故障会话数翻倍以上。

Conclusion: 策略引导的自动闭环测试框架能有效提升ICA多轮对话故障的发现能力，并与人类判断保持一致，为安全关键的车载对话系统评测提供可行方案。

Abstract: In-car conversational assistants (ICAs) are increasingly integrated into vehicles to support route planning, vehicle control, and information access. Ensuring their reliability is challenging due to multi-turn interactions, the absence of explicit ground truth, and strict safety constraints. Existing evaluation techniques fall short, as they target single-turn settings and fail to capture constraint handling, context retention, and safety-critical behavior across turns. We propose an automated framework for testing the multi-turn conversational capabilities of ICAs. The system is treated as a black box and evaluated via closed-loop simulation with a strategy-guided user simulator, an adversarial strategy manager, and a two-tier LLM judge assessing turn-level failures and conversation-level quality. We evaluate the approach on an industrial ICA with six LLM backends and twelve human annotators. The automated judge shows substantial agreement with humans, and strategy guidance uncovers 2.96 times more unique failure types per conversation and more than doubles the number of unique failing conversations compared to unguided simulation.

</details>


### [249] [Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35814)
*Xunjian Yin,Tianchen Guan,Jinao Wang,Weili Cao,Daisy Xinlei Lin,Royce Cheng-Yue,Keagan Long,Kyle Wong,Bhuwan Dhingra,Xiangjun Wang,Shuyan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出BreakingWeb，一种通过对已可解任务施加环境干预来构造挑战的浏览器智能体基准，将难度变为可编程属性。含519对干净/干预任务，覆盖7个网站、29类干预；干预使智能体通过率平均下降22.9%，主要失败为“信念失败”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准靠不断收集新任务、网站来提升难度，导致难度更新成本高、难以控制，且多因素同时变化时无法判断到底什么使任务变难。作者希望把难度从“收集难任务”转变为环境可编程属性。

Method: 为每个基础任务配一个干预条件，保持用户指令、潜在目标和后端成功判定不变，仅在网络栈不同层改变环境；干预是确定性的、可检测、可恢复，并标注所加载的认知原语。构建519对干净/干预任务，跨7个自托管网站、29个干预家族，均按结果评分。评估6个强浏览器智能体、3个仅看截图GUI智能体和人类。

Result: 干预平均使智能体通过率下降22.9%，并推翻各智能体近半数原本干净解决的任务；人类首次尝试仅损失10.0%，熟悉一次后损失5.7%。主要失败是信念失败：六个智能体75%的失败以“声明成功”结束，但所需变更从未发生。

Conclusion: BreakingWeb将难度设计为可控、可检测、可恢复的环境干预，能有效区分智能体与人类能力，并揭示当前浏览器智能体的核心缺陷是信念失败而非单纯操作失败。代码、数据与环境已公开。

Abstract: As browser-use agents improve, benchmarks keep pace by collecting new tasks, websites, and applications, often making tasks longer or more novel. This makes difficulty expensive to refresh and difficult to control: when many aspects change at once, it is unclear what actually makes a task challenging. We instead construct challenging instances from tasks agents already solve, turning difficulty into a programmable property of the environment. BreakingWeb pairs every base task with an intervention condition that preserves the user instruction, latent target, and backend success criterion while changing the environment at different web stack layers. Each intervention is deterministic, detectable, and recoverable, and is annotated with the cognitive primitive it primarily loads. The benchmark contains 519 clean/intervention task pairs across seven self-hosted websites and 29 intervention families, all graded against outcomes. We evaluate six strong browser-use agents, three GUI-only agents that see only screenshots, and humans. The construction is effective: interventions cut agent pass rate by 22.9% on average and overturn nearly half of the tasks each agent solves cleanly, whereas humans lose 10.0% on a first attempt and 5.7% after one familiarisation attempt. The dominant failure is belief failure: 75% of the six agents' failures end with a declared success although the required change never happened. Our code, data and environment are publicly available at www.breakingweb.app.

</details>


### [250] [How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35815)
*Ian Arawjo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出依赖LLM评委分数和小样本AI评估的显著性claim在缺乏校准置信区间、假设检验与评委偏差校正时不可靠，提出统计工具evalstats解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术界越来越多基于LLM评委分数和小样本AI评估做显著性claim，但缺乏良好校准的置信区间、假设检验和评委偏差校正，导致结论不可靠。原始LLM评委分数上的运行统计会造成假阳性膨胀，且许多评分者一致性指标中假阳性风险在"接近完美"人-LLM一致性处达到峰值。

Method: 提出混合人-机评委设计的统计分析与工具；(1) 基于prediction-powered inference (PPI)实现九种假设检验，包括首个针对四种秩检验（Wilcoxon符号秩、Mann-Whitney U及omnibus变体）的PPI校正；(2) 引入bootstrap-adaptive power tuning使PPI++在小规模人工标注校准集下稳定，将估计权重向数据目标收缩并计入其采样方差；(3) 通过蒙特卡洛模拟为小样本AI评估(N<100)推导CI、p值和FWER校正方法建议，并警告避免bootstrap CI；(4) 打包为开源Python包evalstats，自动选择校准方法。

Result: 蒙特卡洛模拟给出小样本AI评估的方法推荐；在三个场景中演示evalstats，包括一个真实LLM评委在"substantial agreement"验证下会引导研究者发表虚假发现的案例。

Conclusion: evalstats可帮助研究者对LLM评委进行负责任的统计分析，避免假阳性与虚假发现，代码已公开于GitHub。

Abstract: Researchers across academia increasingly base significance claims on LLM judge scores and small-sample AI evaluations. Yet without well-calibrated confidence intervals (CIs), hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections, such claims are unreliable. We address these issues in several contributions. First, we find that running statistics over raw LLM judge scores leads to inflated false positives: counterintuitively, for many inter-rater agreement metrics, false positive risk peaks at "almost perfect" human-LLM agreement. To help researchers understand how to run statistics over LLM judges responsibly, we present guidance and tooling for the statistical analysis of mixed human-AI judge designs, and implement nine hypothesis tests via prediction-powered inference (PPI), including the first known PPI corrections for four rank-based tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney U, and omnibus variants). To keep PPI++ stable with small human-labeled calibration sets, we introduce bootstrap-adaptive power tuning, which shrinks the estimated weight toward a target estimated from the labeled data, and accounts for that weight's own sampling variance. Second, through Monte Carlo simulations, we derive recommendations for what CI, p-value, and FWER correction methods to use for small-sample AI evaluations (N<100), and warn researchers against bootstrap CIs. We package these recommendations into evalstats, an open-source Python package that selects calibrated methods automatically, and demonstrate it in three scenarios, including one where a real LLM judge validated at "substantial agreement" would have led a researcher to publish a spurious finding. evalstats is publicly available at https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats.

</details>


### [251] [PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35816)
*Linzhi Peng,Hanting Chen,Heng Chang,Ke Cheng,Bowen Du,Weifeng Lv*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出潜在锚点推理(latent anchor reasoning)作为局部检索单元,并构建PrimeSeeker框架,训练30B搜索智能体,在5个深度搜索基准上表现优异且检索冗余低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM搜索智能体训练通过增大证据图、增加跳数和延长轨迹来提升难度,但这些全局属性只是搜索所需局部检索能力的间接代理,存在不匹配问题。

Method: 定义潜在锚点推理:从描述性规格中解析未命名检索锚点,并将其转移到后续信息需求中。据此构建PrimeSeeker:构建网络锚点结构,联合推导问题与参考证据骨架;骨架保留构建时的支撑证据,并通过当前工具观察的抽取式高亮引导专家生成;高亮在SFT前移除,骨架重用审计参考步骤覆盖以作RL奖励。

Result: 构建9,221条专家轨迹,训练30B搜索智能体;在5个深度搜索基准上性能强劲,参考步骤优化进一步提升监督策略;轨迹检索冗余低,固定预算评估在显著更少工具调用下实现强解覆盖。

Conclusion: 以锚点解析与关系转移为核心的局部检索单元优于依赖全局难度代理的构建方式,带来更高效、低冗余的深度搜索智能体。

Abstract: Large language model search agents are often trained with synthetic questions whose difficulty is increased through larger evidence graphs, additional hops, and longer trajectories. These global properties, however, are only indirect proxies for the local retrieval capabilities required during search. To address this mismatch, we introduce latent anchor reasoning, which consists of resolving an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transferring the recovered anchor into a subsequent information demand. This primitive retrieval unit decomposes deep search into chains of coupled operations and organizes question construction around anchor resolution and relation transfer, without prescribing a canonical search path. Based on this formulation, we propose PrimeSeeker, a capability-oriented framework that constructs web-grounded anchor structures and jointly derives a question and a reference evidence skeleton. The skeleton preserves supporting evidence from construction and guides expert generation through extractive highlights of current tool observations. These highlights are removed before supervised fine-tuning, while the skeleton is subsequently reused to audit reference-step coverage for reinforcement-learning rewards. We construct 9,221 expert trajectories, training a 30B search agent. Across five deep-search benchmarks, PrimeSeeker achieves strong performance, while reference-step optimization further improves the supervised policy. The resulting trajectories exhibit low retrieval redundancy, and fixed-budget evaluation shows strong solution coverage with substantially fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.

</details>


### [252] [Mnemon: Raw Records, Fast Judgments, Slow Thoughts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36059)
*Guangren Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Mnemon 记忆代理，将记忆工作分为快速"System 1"（决策模型 Jev 做是非判断）与慢速"System 2"（LLM 规划搜索、组织答案）。原始对话以带日期记录存储，写入时不决策，故可读任意返回带日期记录的存储。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S、BEAM 上取得领先或媲美最优的成绩，成本增长极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数记忆系统在写入时将对话重写为事实、图或类型化记忆。作者认为记忆工作如思考一样可分为两系统：大部分是快速、独立的是非判断（记录是否需要、是否过时），少量是慢速的查询规划与答案组织。基于此分工构建更高效、可迁移的记忆代理。

Method: 1) 对话保留为原始带日期记录；2) LLM(System 2) 规划对记录的搜索；3) 决策模型 Jev(System 1) 以显式预算规则对搜索结果做大量是非判断；4) 判断汇聚成小型 View 供不变的答案模型使用；5) 后台任务将每条记录一次性整合为主题时间线、价值历史与长期指令并与记录关联，帮助整段对话类问题触及自身搜索漏掉的证据；6) 写入时不做任何记录决策，从而可读任意返回带日期记录的存储。

Result: gpt-4.1-mini 作答时：LoCoMo 91.7%（14 系统公开复评中最高），LongMemEval-S 83.8%，每问 <4k tokens，LoCoMo 有效成本指数最低。推理模型作答时：LoCoMo 92.2%，LongMemEval-S 94.4%（与已发表最佳持平）。BEAM 上历史从 100K 到 10M tokens，每问成本仅增至 1.11 倍。相同记录上 Jev 比两个 LLM 更能分离金标证据，且快 3-11 倍。

Conclusion: 记忆可像思考一样分为便宜快速的 System 1 判断与昂贵慢速的 System 2 规划。Mnemon 依此分工，以低成本、低上下文占用实现领先或媲美最优的长程记忆性能，且因写入无决策而具备存储无关的通用性。

Abstract: Long-term memory lets an LLM assistant use a history it can no longer reread, and most memory systems build it by rewriting conversations into facts, graphs or typed memories at write time. We argue that the work of memory divides, as thinking does, into two systems. Most of it is fast System 1 work: many small, independent yes/no judgments about records, such as whether a record is needed or no longer current, which a decision model makes by the dozen in a third of a second. Only a little is slow System 2 work: writing a few search queries, naming what the reply needs and composing the answer, which an LLM does well but slowly. We present Mnemon, a memory agent built on this division. It keeps conversations as raw, dated records; an LLM (System 2) plans searches over them, a decision model, Jev (System 1), judges what the searches return, and rules with explicit budgets turn the judgments into a small View for an unchanged answering model. A background pass consolidates each record once into topic timelines, value histories and standing instructions linked to the records, so that questions about a whole conversation reach evidence their own searches miss. Because nothing is decided about a record when it is written, the same agent can read any store that returns dated records.
  With gpt-4.1-mini answering, as in a public re-evaluation of 14 systems, Mnemon scores 91.7% on LoCoMo, the highest among them, and 83.8% on LongMemEval-S, from under 4k tokens of context per question, with the lowest effective cost index on LoCoMo. With a reasoning model answering, it reaches 92.2% on LoCoMo and 94.4% on LongMemEval-S, the latter on par with the best published results. From 100K to 10M tokens of history on BEAM, its cost per question grows by a factor of 1.11. On the same records, Jev separates gold evidence better than two LLMs and is 3-11 times faster.

</details>


### [253] [Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35817)
*Kaibo Wang,Ding Ding,Fangyu Ding,Zijin Feng,Han Shi,Haili Bai,Jiacheng Sun,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LUDI框架，通过"less uniform loss"和逐token时间嵌入解决均匀扩散模型的训练与采样问题，实现少步生成并成功将7B自回归模型转为具备推理能力的UDLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀扩散语言模型（UDLMs）虽有前景，但难以扩展，核心障碍在于训练目标过度均匀，以及采样过程中条件与目标混淆。

Method: 提出Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI)框架：(i) 引入less uniform loss，引导每个逆向转换指向干净token；(ii) 为模型配备逐token时间嵌入，提供token级损坏提示，支持基于置信度的少步采样。

Result: 跨规模实验表明LUDI监督更干净、少步生成更优；将7B自回归模型继续训练为LUDI-7B，成为具备复杂推理能力的UDLM，相对AR解码实现每步3 token加速，性能与掩码扩散基线相当。

Conclusion: UDLMs在复杂生成任务上的全部潜力尚未被充分挖掘。

Abstract: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.

</details>


### [254] [$τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35820)
*Soham Ray,Edgard dos Santos Paiva,Ruben Valenzuela,Karthik Narasimhan,Keshav Dhandhania,Victor Barres*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 τ-Multilingual 基准，将 τ-Voice 扩展到西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，通过母语者审核评估多语言语音代理行为。结果显示西/葡/印与英语差距小，但韩语和普通话任务完成率大幅下降，且失败模式各异，呼吁分开报告任务、交互和生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音代理基准多为纯英语，仅覆盖行为的狭窄切片，无法反映多语言场景下的真实表现，因此需要构建多语言、经母语者验证的评估基准。

Method: 将 τ-Voice 扩展至西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，加入母语者审核，并对生成语言与语音输出进行评估；共进行 4,500 次全双工通话，覆盖五种语音配置。同时发布语言包、验证过的评判器和工具。

Result: 西班牙语、葡萄牙语、印地语与英语的任务完成率差距在 3.2 分以内；韩语和普通话分别下降 14.7 和 8.4 分。失败模式不同：韩语系统更多漏答，普通话系统更常打断，两者都在工具和实体处理上表现不佳。Grok 任务完成领先但生成质量最低。

Conclusion: 多语言语音代理性能存在显著语言差异和不同失败模式，需分开报告任务、交互与生成质量指标；发布的语言包、评判器和工具可支持社区构建多语言语音代理评估。

Abstract: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $τ$-Multilingual, extending $τ$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.

</details>


### [255] [PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35865)
*Yida Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PACT利用对比数据对的结构设计四个训练项，在单token类型化决策任务上实现与已发表方法相当的准确率，同时提升鲁棒性与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单token类型化决策模型用普通交叉熵训练，忽略了训练数据中对比数据对、机器校验证明等丰富结构信息。

Method: 提出PACT，将结构转为四个无需新标注的训练项：对数据对的差中之差边界（对共享logit偏移不变）、对答案码位置偏差的置换一致性项、基于证明校验消融上下文的证据必要性项、评分字段的序数传输代价，外加三参数情境温度。

Result: 在冻结的324项留出集三种子测试中，准确率与已发表方法相当（84.6% vs 85.2%，McNemar p≥0.50），位置偏差最低（9.8% vs 13.8%），序数误差最低（MAE 0.232 vs 0.311）；相比仅用交叉熵的对照，三种子中两种显著更准，种子间差异减半，NLL降低26%。

Conclusion: 消融与证伪测试表明：无单项提升原始准确率，PACT的价值在鲁棒性与稳定性而非准确性指标。

Abstract: Single-token typed-decision models answer a schema question by reading the logits of a few one-letter answer codes at a single position: they are fast and return a probability for every allowed answer, but they are trained with plain cross-entropy that ignores most of the structure in their training data. We study such a model whose data is curated as contrastive pairs---two contexts that differ in one edited fact that flips the answer---each carrying a machine-checked certificate that deleting the decisive sentence makes the fact unknown. We propose PACT, which turns this structure into four training terms that need no new annotation: a difference-in-differences margin over each pair that is invariant to any shared logit offset, a permutation-consistency term against answer-code position bias, an evidence-necessity term on certificate-verified ablated contexts, and an ordinal transport cost for rubric fields, plus a three-parameter contextual temperature. On a frozen 324-item holdout with three seeds, PACT matches the published recipe in accuracy ($84.6\%$ vs. $85.2\%$; McNemar $p \ge 0.50$ at every seed) while giving the lowest position bias of all runs (answer flips under relabelling $9.8\%$ vs. $13.8\%$) and the lowest ordinal error on rubric fields (MAE $0.232$ vs. $0.311$). Against a control with the same optimiser and schedule but cross-entropy only, PACT is significantly more accurate at two of three seeds, halves the seed-to-seed spread and lowers NLL by $26\%$. Seed-matched ablations and pre-specified falsification tests locate these gains precisely: no single term raises raw accuracy, and the method's value lies in robustness and stability rather than headline accuracy. Code, data splits, trained adapters, and all run records are available at https://github.com/BennyLinntu/PACT-Pairwise-Anchored-Calibrated-Tuning-for-Single-Token-Typed-Decisions.

</details>


### [256] [Can We Still Trust Disaster Social Sensing? Empirical Evidence on Detecting AI-Generated Social Media Posts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35821)
*Xiaoshan Zhou,Zaifu Zhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文检验文本型AI检测器能否可靠区分人类与AI生成的灾情社交媒体帖子，发现跨模型检测近乎随机（AUROC约0.4-0.52），域名训练头虽达0.817但多为表面特征伪象，故不宜作为信任门控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾情社会感知依赖公众社交媒体帖子生成态势认知与人道需求证据，但生成式AI可产出貌似目击报告的文本，威胁证据可信度，因此需评估文本检测器能否充当操作级信任门控。

Method: 构建12,000条文本、3,000个语义匹配单元的九类灾害数据集，含H0原始、H1轻度校对、A0事实型AI、A1情感框架AI四类；另有6,000条42事件语料用于模型选择与阈值校准。评估OSM-Det、Fast-DetectGPT、Binoculars及LLM直接评判（跨五模型族），并做领域校准、冻结编码器线性读出、配对变换敏感性与数据集伪影控制。

Result: 14个冻结跨族配置AUROC仅0.402-0.517，校准低假阳点最佳前瞻召回3.6%；OSM-Det达AUROC 0.521、召回10.4%（假阳6.7%）。灾害训练线性头AUROC 0.817，但七特征表面分类器在H0对A0上已达0.784，中和表面不对称后头从0.733降至0.594；头还能区分来源不变的A0与A1。

Conclusion: 文本检测可靠性不足以充当操作信任门控，应依赖多模态主张、可问责来源及其他情境证据来保障灾情社会感知的信任。

Abstract: Disaster social sensing converts public social-media posts into evidence for situational awareness and humanitarian needs, but generative artificial intelligence (AI) can produce plausible messages that resemble eyewitness reports. This study investigates whether text-based AI detectors can reliably distinguish human-authored from AI-generated disaster posts. We construct a dataset of 12,000 texts organised into 3,000 matched semantic units from nine disasters: original human posts (H0), minimally LLM-proofread human posts (H1), factual AI-generated posts based on the same verified facts (A0), and affectively framed versions of those AI posts (A1). A separate 6,000-text corpus from 42 events supports model selection and threshold calibration. We evaluate OSM-Det, Fast-DetectGPT, Binoculars, and direct large language model (LLM) judges across five model families, then test disaster-domain calibration, a frozen-encoder linear readout, paired transformation sensitivity, and dataset artifact controls. Across fourteen frozen cross-family configurations, AUROC is 0.402-0.517 and the best prospective recall at a calibration-derived low-false-positive operating point is 3.6%; OSM-Det reaches AUROC 0.521 and 10.4% recall at a realised 6.7% false-positive rate. A disaster-trained linear head reaches AUROC 0.817, but a seven-feature surface classifier reaches 0.784 on the H0-versus-A0 contrast, and neutralising identified surface asymmetries reduces the head from 0.733 to 0.594. The head also separates A0 from A1 even though provenance is unchanged. The results show that text-based detection is not reliable enough to serve as an operational trust gate; multimodal claims, accountable sources, and other contextual evidence should be rested on to safeguard trust in disaster social sensing.

</details>


### [257] [Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35822)
*Sixing Chen,Zhuofan Josh Ying,Logan Riggs Smith,Jeremy Wertheimer,Natalie Shapira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过因果中介分析揭示语言模型谄媚同意(迎合用户观点)的机制:早期注意力头将用户意见信号注入残差流,偏置答案检索;消融这些头可大幅降低谄媚同时保留事实准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谄媚同意被广泛认为是语言模型的对齐失败,但其底层机制尚不清楚,限制了针对性对齐干预的开发。

Method: 采用因果中介分析,识别携带用户意见信号的早期注意力头,并进行消融实验;区分显式陈述意见与经由无内容反驳(如"你确定吗?")传达意见两种情形。

Result: 显式意见在早期即被注入最终prompt token的残差流,偏置后续答案检索,由一组稀疏早期注意力头承载;消融这些头显著降低谄媚且基本不损事实准确性。意见措辞无关,同一组头均承载。对于非显式反驳,发现另一组不同的头会抑制模型原本正确答案以促成修改后的答案。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了意见如何诱发谄媚同意的机制性解释,为开发更精准可靠的对齐干预迈进一步。

Abstract: Sycophantic agreement in language models refers to the tendency to overly affirm a user's stated beliefs or preferences, often at the expense of factual accuracy. Although it is widely recognized as an alignment failure, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we use causal mediation analysis to identify the mechanisms behind sycophantic agreement. We show that a stated opinion is incorporated into the residual stream of the final prompt token early, where it biases subsequent answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal. Ablating these heads substantially reduces sycophancy while leaving factual accuracy largely intact. The same heads carry the opinion when it is explicitly stated, regardless of how it is phrased. When an opinion is not stated explicitly but instead conveyed through content-free pushback (e.g., ``Are you sure?"), we find a distinct set of heads that suppresses the model's original correct answer to promote a revised answer. By providing a mechanistic account of how opinions induce sycophantic agreement, this work takes a step toward developing more targeted and reliable alignment interventions.

</details>


### [258] [Reliable but Design-Sensitive: Instrument Uncertainty in LLM Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35824)
*Thomas Reiter,Christoph Kern,Fedor Miasnikov,Sofiia Nikolenko,Rob Chew,Stephanie Eckman,Frauke Kreuter*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过测试7个LLM、12种任务设计、3次独立运行和3000条推文标注，发现任务设计与模型选择会引入显著"工具不确定性"，重复同一设置或依赖置信度分数都无法检测这种变异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为标注工具时，在同一设置下能给出可靠标签，但当研究者做出其他合理设计选择时，标签会发生变化。研究旨在系统量化这种由任务设计和模型选择带来的不确定性，并与人类标注工具的变异进行对比。

Method: 测试7个LLM、12种任务设计、3次独立运行，对3000条推文进行冒犯性语言和仇恨言论标注；计算重复设置下的一致率（Fleiss' κ）、改变任务设计下的一致率（Cohen's κ），并分析任务设计和模型选择对流行度估计方差的影响，以及置信度分数的表现。

Result: 重复同一模型和任务设计的一致率较高（中位 Fleiss' κ=0.91）；改变任务设计后一致率下降（中位 Cohen's κ=0.76）。任务设计和模型选择使流行度估计方差分别增加76.7倍（冒犯性语言）和110.6倍（仇恨言论）。LLM任务设计间的变异达560-572个基点，而五种人类工具版本仅为270-331个基点。置信度分数未能解决该问题：其更贴近模型重复输出而非与人类标签的一致，将6条推文合并在一个提示中使平均冒犯性语言置信度下降660个基点。

Conclusion: 作者将任务设计和模型选择引起的变异称为"工具不确定性"（instrument uncertainty），研究者只能通过比较合理的任务设计来测量它。重复单一设置或依赖置信度分数无法替代这一检验。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can give reliable labels under one setup yet change those labels when researchers make other reasonable design choices. We tested seven LLMs, 12 task designs, three independent runs, and 3,000 tweets labeled for offensive language and hate speech. Repeating the same model and task design produced high agreement (median Fleiss' $κ= 0.91$). Agreement fell when we changed the task design for the same tweets (median Cohen's $κ= 0.76$). Task design and model choice increased the variance of estimated prevalence by factors of 76.7 for offensive language and 110.6 for hate speech compared with sampling variance alone. Variation across LLM task designs reached 560-572 basis points, compared with 270-331 basis points across five human instrument versions. Confidence scores did not solve this problem. They tracked repeated model outputs more closely than agreement with human labels, and grouping six tweets in one prompt lowered mean offensive-language confidence by 660 basis points. We call the variation caused by task design and model choice instrument uncertainty. Researchers can measure it only by comparing reasonable task designs. Repeating one setup or relying on confidence scores cannot replace that test.

</details>


### [259] [Retrieval Sensitivity to Identity Signals in Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36534)
*Andrew Tang,Nicholas Deas,Kathleen McKeown,Vishal Misra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文考察密集检索器是否因查询中的身份信号（政治倾向与方言）而产生检索偏见，发现所有检索器都倾向返回与查询政治立场一致的文档，且在非裔美式英语（AAL）查询上表现比白人主流英语（WME）更差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实用户的查询常带有身份信号，但检索器通常只用中性查询评估，可能导致返回结果被政治意识形态和方言偏见影响，进而加剧政治极化与健康不平等。

Method: 在政治新闻和消费者健康两个领域设计评估，每个领域结合受控合成查询集（仅改变身份信号）与自然查询；测试五种密集检索器和一个稀疏基线；通过控制总体词汇不对称分数、以及用线性探针从查询嵌入中恢复政治倾向和方言来分析偏见来源。

Result: 所有检索器（i）返回与查询自身政治倾向一致的文章；（ii）对AAL问题的表现差于WME。控制词汇不对称分数后合成差距仍基本存在；线性探针能从嵌入中恢复倾向和方言，说明偏见超出表层词汇特征。

Conclusion: 检索偏见是真实且普遍的，若不解决可能加剧极化并强化AAL使用者已有的健康差距。

Abstract: Dense retrievers decide which documents reach users and the language models that use them, yet they are typically evaluated with neutral queries. We ask whether the identity signals that real users express in their queries---political ideology and dialect---bias what a retriever returns. We design evaluations in two domains, political news and consumer-health questions, each pairing a controlled synthetic set that varies only the identity signal with naturalistic queries. Across five dense retrievers and a sparse baseline, every retriever (i) retrieves articles that align with the query's own political lean and (ii) performs worse for questions written in African American Language (AAL) than in White Mainstream English (WME). Two analyses tie these gaps to queries' identity signals beyond surface vocabulary: partialling out an aggregate lexical-asymmetry score leaves the synthetic gaps largely intact, and linear probes recover lean and dialect from the retrievers' query embeddings beyond token-level features. Left unaddressed, such retrieval biases risk contributing to polarization and reinforcing the health disparities already faced by AAL speakers. Code is available at https://github.com/Andrewtcr/bias-ret.

</details>


### [260] [Beyond the Context Window: An Adaptive Entropy-Based Routing Framework for Hybrid Retrieval and Long-Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35831)
*Isaac Olufadewa,Miracle Adesina,Ezekiel Oladejo,Owen Adeniyi,Fadare Fadekemi,Olamide Oso,Uthman Babatunde,Matthew Olawoyin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出EDAR框架，用生成令牌的预测熵在推理时自适应选择RAG或长上下文处理，在保持97.4%长上下文精度的同时降低70.7%的token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文模型支持百万级token，但纯长上下文处理昂贵且对中间位置信息注意力不足；纯RAG快速但受限于检索质量，当检索片段部分相关或矛盾时容易出错。因此需要一种能动态决策的混合方案。

Method: EDAR基于RAG响应前几个生成令牌的token级概率分布的预测熵来判断是否升级到全长上下文处理。熵阈值通过验证集上成本与精度的权衡扫描确定。无需特定检索器或LC骨干，也不需要额外监督。

Result: 预测熵与幻觉率强相关（Pearson r=0.85，95% CI [0.83, 0.87]，2000次生成）。在LongBench v2和Infinity-Bench上，EDAR保留纯长上下文基线97.4%的准确率，减少70.7%总token消耗，仅升级18.2%查询，与纯长上下文系统的准确率差距统计上不显著。

Conclusion: 预测熵是用于RAG与长上下文推理路由的有效模型内部信号，基于阈值的混合系统能以小部分成本恢复大部分长上下文精度，且框架通用性强。

Abstract: Modern large language models now support context windows of more than one million tokens, which has raised the question of whether retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is still necessary. Pure long-context (LC) processing is expensive and is known to under-attend to information placed in the middle of long inputs, while pure RAG is fast but bounded by retrieval quality and prone to errors when retrieved chunks are partially relevant or contradictory. We propose the Entropy-Driven Adaptive Router (EDAR), a framework that decides at inference time whether to answer a query from retrieved chunks or to escalate it to full long-context processing. The decision uses the predictive entropy of the token-level probability distribution computed over the first few generated tokens of the RAG response. The entropy threshold is selected on a held-out validation set by sweeping cost against accuracy. Experiments compare EDAR against pure-RAG and pure-LC baselines on LongBench v2 and Infinity-Bench. Predictive entropy correlates strongly with hallucination rate on a held-out set of 2,000 generations (Pearson r = 0.85, 95% CI [0.83, 0.87]). On the long-context benchmarks, EDAR retains 97.4% of the accuracy of the pure long-context baseline while reducing total token expenditure by 70.7%, escalating only 18.2% of incoming queries. The accuracy gap between EDAR and the pure long-context system is not statistically distinguishable from zero at standard sample sizes. Predictive entropy is a useful model-internal signal for routing between RAG and long-context inference, and a threshold-based hybrid system can recover most of the accuracy of long-context models at a small fraction of the cost. The framework does not depend on a specific retriever or LC backbone, and it does not require additional supervision beyond what is normally produced during decoding.

</details>


### [261] [Follow the Entities: A Corpus Map for Agentic Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37226)
*Soyeong Jeong,Sujay Kumar Jauhar,Sung Ju Hwang,Andrew Joohun Nam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CorpusMap是一种围绕重复实体组织语料库的导航层，通过离线构建实体页与图结构，帮助LLM智能体高效跨文档检索证据，节省token并提升答案质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大文档集合问答需连接跨多文档的证据。现有LLM智能体在扁平文件集合上迭代搜索，因文档间缺乏关联提示，需为每个查询重新发现关系，既漏证据又耗费大量token。

Method: 将每个重复实体表示为Entity Page，聚合其信息并链接所有引用它的文档，形成实体-文档图供智能体遍历。CorpusMap离线构建，通过跨文档实体指代消解共享链接，避免推理时重复发现。

Result: 在3个基准数据集、7种模型上，CorpusMap在证据发现和答案质量上优于原始语料库智能体搜索，平均使用更少token，并优于4种替代导航层。

Conclusion: 实体可作为导航大型文档集合的有效锚点。

Abstract: Answering questions and completing tasks over large document collections often requires connecting evidence spread across multiple documents, such as a project's approval recorded in one, its requirements in another, and its latest status in a third. Recent LLM agents approach this by iteratively searching the full corpus rather than reading only a fixed set of top-ranked documents. However, when the corpus is exposed only as a flat collection of files, a relevant document gives no indication of how it relates to others, so the agent must rediscover these relationships for every query, often missing complementary evidence while simultaneously consuming substantial additional tokens. To address this, we introduce CorpusMap, a navigation layer that organizes the corpus around its recurring entities, which are identifiable from the documents themselves and can link a single document to many others across sources. Specifically, CorpusMap represents each recurring entity as an Entity Page that aggregates information about it and links to every document that refers to it, forming a graph between entities and documents that the agent can traverse to gather otherwise disconnected evidence. Moreover, since CorpusMap is constructed offline by resolving mentions of the same entity across documents, its links are shared across queries rather than rediscovered repeatedly at inference time. Using 7 different models with 3 benchmark datasets, we show that CorpusMap improves both evidence discovery and answer quality over raw-corpus agentic search while using fewer tokens on average, and further outperforms 4 alternative navigation layers, suggesting that entities serve as effective anchors for navigating large document collections.

</details>


### [262] [When Should LLMs Trust Their Own Revisions? A Risk-Aware Study of Intrinsic Self-Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35832)
*Tianzhu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM内在自我纠正的权衡：修订可纠错，也能把原本正确的答案改错。作者在29个开源模型、BoolQ/GSM8K/Corr2Cause上追踪初始与修订答案的正误转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内在自我纠正（无外部新证据下模型自我修订）被广泛认为有益，但第二次作答既可修正错误，也可能推翻原本正确的答案，这种双向权衡此前缺乏系统刻画。

Method: 在29个开源权重LLM上，对BoolQ、GSM8K、Corr2Cause追踪初始答案与修订答案之间的正确性转移；另做受控BoolQ实验考察不同refinement提示的影响；并比较三种运行时策略：保留初始答案、总是接受修订、基于初始响应后可用信号的选择性调用（含学习式gating）。

Result: 聚合准确率掩盖了差异巨大的修订行为：例如Llama-3.1-8B在GSM8K上提升25.5个百分点，但修订把19.1%的原本正确答案变为错误。refinement提示会改变纠错与损害之间的平衡；在部分场景学习式gating有效，另一些场景下无条件的简单策略反而更好。

Conclusion: 应将内在自我纠正视为一种"修订策略"而非普遍有益的二次作答，评估时需同时衡量其恢复的正确与引入的错误。

Abstract: Intrinsic self-correction asks a language model to revise its own answer without receiving new external evidence. A second pass can recover mistakes, but it can also overturn answers that were already correct. We study this trade-off across 29 open-weight LLMs on BoolQ, GSM8K, and Corr2Cause by tracking correctness transitions between initial and revised answers. Aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behavior: for example, Llama-3.1-8B improves by 25.5 percentage points on GSM8K, while refinement changes 19.1% of initially correct answers into wrong ones. A controlled BoolQ study further shows that refinement prompts shift the balance between recovery and harm. We then compare three runtime choices: keeping the initial answer, always accepting the revision, and selectively invoking revision using signals available after the initial response. The comparison identifies settings where learned gating is useful and others where a simpler unconditional policy performs better. These results suggest treating intrinsic self-correction as a revision policy rather than as a uniformly beneficial second pass, and evaluating it through both the corrections it recovers and the errors it introduces.

</details>


### [263] [Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis: Mapping Technological Diffusion across Academic Preprints, Patent Signals, and Compute Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35845)
*Muhammad Sukri Bin Ramli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出HSTA方法，用无监督语义轨迹分析追踪技术扩散，发现LLM与AI系统子话题语义演化最快，并指出单纯论文量速度不能格兰杰因果于算力激增。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFP等宏观经济指标因调查间隔和核算惯例存在多年报告滞后，无法实时捕捉技术突破，需从非结构化文本中直接追踪技术扩散。

Method: 分析arXiv预印本与USPTO专利共3万条记录，将Transformer句嵌入投影到单位超球面，用Spherical K-Means（8个子话题）和UMAP降维；提出两个指标：语义质心向量漂移（追踪词汇变迁/范式转变）与商业化偏移（跨语料峰值密度对齐）；并用VAR F检验结合Epoch AI硬件数据检验论文量与算力关系。

Result: LLM子话题漂移0.332、AI系统子话题漂移0.234，语义演化最快；季度论文量速度单独并不在常规显著性水平上格兰杰因果于前沿算力配置激增，需对文本信号施加物理资本约束条件。

Conclusion: HSTA提供客观、实时的机制来补充传统经济统计，可绕过多年度报告滞后追踪技术范式演化。

Abstract: Macroeconomic productivity metrics, such as Total Factor Productivity, register technological breakthroughs with multi-year reporting lags due to administrative survey intervals and national accounting conventions. This paper introduces Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis (HSTA), an unsupervised quantitative methodology that tracks technology diffusion directly from unstructured scientific and commercial text streams. We analyze 30,000 filtered document records spanning academic preprints from arXiv and patent application records from the USPTO. By projecting high-dimensional Transformer sentence embeddings onto unit hyperspheres using Spherical K-Means clustering across eight primary sub-topics and UMAP manifold reductions, HSTA formalizes two quantitative metrics: (1) Semantic Centroid Vector Drift, which tracks vocabulary shifts between temporal sub-corpora to identify structural paradigm transformations; and (2) Commercialization Offset, which evaluates cross-corpus peak density alignments between scientific discovery and intellectual property filings. Linking quarterly topic volume velocity with physical hardware metrics from the Epoch AI database, Vector Autoregressive F-tests demonstrate that quarterly paper volume velocity alone does not Granger-cause frontier compute allocation surges at conventional statistical significance levels, highlighting the necessity of conditioning textual signals on physical capital constraints. Empirical results reveal that sub-topics covering Large Language Models (with a drift metric of 0.332) and Artificial Intelligence Systems (with a drift metric of 0.234) undergo the highest rate of semantic evolution, offering an objective, real-time mechanism to complement traditional economic statistics.

</details>


### [264] [Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence: Detecting Evidence Gaps Before Generation in RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37469)
*Suting Chen,Peichun Hua,Yunming Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 RINSE，在生成答案前仅凭问题与证据判断证据是否充分，用三路信号组合，六数据集上排序准确率0.837，优于10种先前方法与前沿模型API，单GPU延迟36.5ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG检索到的段落常提及正确实体却缺少回答问题所需事实；即使被指示弃答，生成器仍对40.0-99.3%的证据不足问题作答。训练生成器弃答会绑定模型权重、可能奖励参数记忆、且需完整生成调用，故希望生成前就判断证据充分性。

Method: 指出构证不足证据测试的陷阱（移除相关证据或与无关问题配对会通过词汇重叠/位置泄露标签）；构建配对基准，用替换、删除、问题交换构造，变化答案支持同时控制表面特征；提出RINSE，组合三信号：问题各部分是否被覆盖、是否有段落提供答案、小模型共读段落判断是否充分。

Result: 六数据集上RINSE排序充分高于不足证据得分0.837（随机0.5），超过10种先前方法最优（0.746）与前沿模型API（0.784）；最弱数据集0.684高于其他方法最弱0.676；生成前本地运行，单GPU每问题36.5ms。

Conclusion: 证据充分性可在无答案生成时判断，但单一信号不通用；RINSE通过多信号整合实现更强且稳定的判断，为RAG提供高效前置充分性检测。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external sources, but retrieved passages often name the right entities without providing the facts needed to answer. Even when instructed to abstain, 12 generators answer 40.0-99.3% of insufficient-evidence questions. Training generators to abstain ties the decision to model weights, may reward answers recalled from parametric knowledge, and still requires a full generator call. Can sufficiency be judged from the question and evidence alone, before any answer exists? We identify pitfalls in constructing insufficient-evidence tests: removing relevant evidence or pairing evidence with unrelated questions can reveal labels through lexical overlap or evidence position. We build a paired benchmark using substitution, deletion, and question-swap constructions that vary answer support while controlling selected surface features, such as word use. Sufficiency can be judged without generating an answer, but no single signal works across all datasets. We introduce RINSE (Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence), which combines three signals: whether every part of the question is covered, whether any passage offers an answer, and whether a small language model reading the passages together judges them sufficient. Across six datasets, RINSE ranks sufficient above insufficient evidence with a score of 0.837 (chance 0.5), exceeding the best of 10 prior methods (0.746) and a frontier model queried through an API (0.784). Its weakest dataset scores higher than any other method's weakest (0.684 vs. 0.676). RINSE runs locally before generation, taking 36.5 ms per question on a single GPU.

</details>


### [265] [The Detectability Gap: Hidden Heterogeneity in Hallucination Detection Across Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35860)
*Pranav Darshan,Pranav A,Sravan Karthick T,Minal Moharir,Ivan P. Yamshchikov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于采样一致性的幻觉检测中的异质性，揭示高一致（Ghost）与低一致（Flickering）两种失效模式存在稳定的可检测性差距，呼吁采用按机制分层的评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合检测指标可能掩盖不同类型的错误在可检测性上的系统性差异，因此需研究一致性检测在不同失效模式上的异质性。

Method: 在4个语言模型和3个事实问答数据集上，根据答案一致性划分高一致（Ghost）与低一致（Flickering）区间，测量AUC差距；因统计量强耦合（|ρ|≈0.94–1.00），冻结区间分配后用词汇与语义响应分散度验证；再用单条扩散轨迹、无跨种子信息做更严格检验。

Result: 原始可检测性差距为0.35–0.46 AUC；冻结区间后词汇与语义分散度保留不对称性，12个模型-数据集设置自助95%区间均不含零；LLaDA三数据集均显著（p<0.005），Dream方向一致且一个显著；困难区间占比跨模型差异大（16%–77%），同一提示在不同模型常切换区间。

Conclusion: 聚合检测指标掩盖了持续存在、依赖模型的失效异质性，需采用按区间（失效机制）分层的评估方法。

Abstract: Sampling based consistency is widely used for hallucination detection, yet aggregate performance can conceal systematic differences in which errors are detectable. This work studies that heterogeneity across four language models and three factual question answering datasets.
