Motivation: 探究LLM能否通过生成问题来帮助作者改进论文草稿，并评估其与人类审稿人的相对价值。

Method: 基于ICLR和NeurIPS的投稿与最终稿配对数据集，对比GPT（有/无全文上下文）与人类审稿人产生的问题的有用性。

Result: GPT产生更多引致修改的问题，关联更广泛的编辑和更多样的内容；但GPT问题中能引致修改的比例远低于审稿人。

Conclusion: 自动化问题对作者有益；同时揭示了在长上下文场景下，正确的上下文关注反而会削弱推理模型产生有用输出的能力。

Abstract: We study the ability of LLMs to generate edit-inducing questions whose answer will improve a paper draft. On a dataset of paired submission and camera-ready papers from ICLR and NeurIPS, we compare the helpfulness of questions from GPT models with or without full paper context to that of human reviewers. GPT produces more edit-inducing questions and its questions are associated with more extensive edits and cover a broader range of edited content compared to questions from reviewers. However, a much smaller percentage of the GPT questions are edit-inducing. Our analyses confirm that automated questions can be beneficial to authors and highlight an example task where proper attending to long context deteriorates reasoning model ability to produce helpful output.

</details>


### [303] [Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36675)
*Ziqi Zhao,Fanqing Meng,Haocheng Lu,Lingxiao Du,Qiguang Chen,Mengkang Hu,Xiao-Ming Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出Gödel Forest，一个多智能体框架，将递归自我改进组织为协同演化的搜索树集合，以兼顾搜索深度与广度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心的RSI需直接更新模型参数，但验证数据策略需昂贵训练，导致单智能体陷入狭窄方向、缺乏探索广度，而朴素并行搜索或重度轨迹共享又牺牲长程搜索深度。

Method: Gödel Forest中每个智能体自主生长一棵持久搜索树，基于模型反馈加深、分支或剪枝数据策略以保障深度；并行树探索不同数据区域以扩展广度；通过动态协同演化记忆连接整个森林，将成功与失败蒸馏为紧凑的过程性经验并锚定全局排行榜。

Result: 在RSIBench-Data六个不同领域上，Gödel Forest较单智能体基线平均提升10.70%，并在五个任务上减少墙钟时间；消融显示协同演化共享记忆相比独立并行搜索带来+7.00%增益。

Conclusion: 集体蒸馏是可扩展自我改进的关键，协同演化的共享记忆使死胡同迅速警示全森林、突破快速催生新探索分支。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to achieve compounding gains by having models improve themselves. While most existing RSI systems optimize external agent harnesses or prompts around a frozen base model, data-centric RSI directly updates the model's own parameters by training on agent-generated data. However, because validating data strategies requires expensive model training, existing methods face a fundamental dilemma: a single agent gets trapped in narrow directions and lacks exploration breadth, while naive parallel search or heavy trace sharing sacrifices long-horizon search depth. To address this challenge, we introduce G"odel Forest, a multi-agent framework that organizes recursive self-improvement as an ensemble of co-evolving search trees. In G"odel Forest, each agent autonomously grows a persistent tree, deepening, branching, or pruning data strategies based on model feedback to secure depth, while parallel trees explore distinct regions of the data space to expand breadth. Crucially, rather than leaving trees isolated or flooding them with heavy execution logs, a dynamically co-evolving memory connects the forest: agents continuously distill their successes and failures into compact procedural lessons anchored to a global leaderboard. Through this forest ecosystem, a dead-end in one tree instantly warns the whole forest against unpromising paths, while an empirical breakthrough quickly seeds new exploration branches in neighboring trees. Evaluated on RSIBench-Data across six diverse domains, G"odel Forest outperforms the single-agent baseline by an average of 10.70% while reducing wall-clock time on five tasks. Ablations confirm that co-evolving shared memory yields a +7.00% gain over independent parallel search, demonstrating that collective distillation is key to scalable self-improvement. The code is available at https://github.com/evolvent-ai/Godel-Forest.

</details>


### [304] [ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36684)
*Jianshu Zhang,Keliang Wu,Chengxuan Qian,Xiyuan Yang,Ce Zhang,Ariel Tian,Anbang Liu,Haoran Lu,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出长任务中进度估计依赖上下文，提出ContextProgress-Bench基准和ProgressCompass框架，帮助PRM显著降低进度估计误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长任务中仅知最终成败信息不足，需PRM提供密集进度奖励；但当前帧常无法判断进度，进度依赖历史信息，现有基准多聚焦可从当前观测读出进度的短任务，PRM在需要上下文时的能力未被充分探索。

Method: 构建ContextProgress-Bench，含24个操作任务、120个回合，覆盖State Recall、Sequence Tracking、Recurrence Disambiguation三种设置；进行配对诊断实验；提出ProgressCompass，一个自主智能体循环，重新定位现有PRM并调用通用VLM提供其所需上下文。

Result: 即使读取完整历史的PRM也会迷失；提供正确上下文后，五个模型进度误差降低77-82%。ProgressCompass包裹下，同一冻结PRM进度误差降低63%，排名一致性提高76%。

Conclusion: 具身PRM并非无进度估计能力，而是缺乏正确上下文；ProgressCompass可让PRM在更长更复杂任务上更好地估计进度。

Abstract: Embodied agents now take on ever longer tasks. For long tasks, knowing only whether a task finally succeeds or fails says little; the steps along the way matter. Progress Reward Models (PRMs) score how far a task has come at every step, and serve as dense rewards, verifiers and monitors. Yet in long tasks the current frame alone often cannot tell how far the task has come, because progress depends on what happened before. We call this problem context-dependent progress estimation. Existing benchmarks on progress estimation mostly focus on short tasks whose progress can be read from the current observation, and whether PRMs can estimate progress when context is needed remains underexplored. We therefore build ContextProgress-Bench, with 24 manipulation tasks for 120 episodes. The benchmark covers three settings: (i) State Recall, where information needed for progress appeared earlier but is not in the current frame; (ii) Sequence Tracking, where steps follow a fixed order, so progress requires knowing which steps are done and which comes next; and (iii) Recurrence Disambiguation, where look-alike frames sit at very different progress. We then run a paired diagnosis: each PRM keeps the same input format in both runs, and in one run its instruction integrates the right context. Even PRMs that read the entire history get lost in estimating progress, yet with the right context the same five models cut their progress error by 77-82%. Embodied PRMs are thus not incapable of progress estimation, but lost without the right context. We therefore propose ProgressCompass, an autonomous agentic loop that reorients an existing PRM and uses current general-purpose VLMs to supply the context the PRM needs. Wrapped in the loop, the same frozen PRM cuts its progress error by 63% and raises its rank agreement by 76%. With such a compass, PRMs estimate progress far better on longer, more complex tasks.

</details>


### [305] [Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36691)
*Jianshu Zhang,Ce Zhang,Xiyuan Yang,Chenwei Xu,Haoran Lu,Yijiang Li,Yaqi Xie,Katia P. Sycara,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将VLM从连续视频中归纳可复用操作技能的问题形式化为流式具身技能发现(SESD)，提出Video2Skill基准，测试事件定位、分组和技能复用/新建三项能力，发现现有19个VLM分组接近随机、扩容技能困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作行为虽多样但共享少量可复用技能，规划这些技能有助于具身智能体泛化；然而智能体只能规划其已知技能，需从观察经验中反向恢复技能以积累知识。核心疑问是VLM能否将事件流组织为可复用技能。

Method: 提出SESD问题设定：模型按序列观看视频并维护持久技能库以影响后续决策。构建Video2Skill基准，涵盖机器人桌面操作与人类厨房活动，测试三项能力：时间定位操作事件、按同一变换分组事件、决定复用还是新建技能。评估19个开源VLM，并提出监督微调方法CLaRe（反事实技能库状态重平衡）。

Result: 多数模型分组接近随机水平，规模扩大并不稳定带来提升。错误类型与感知和技能库更新的耦合方式相关：联合模型将不同变换合并为一个技能，而从文本描述更新技能库的模型会重复生成已有技能。CLaRe等监督微调改善分组，但技能库规模停滞在参考规模一半以下，训练中未见过的变换虽能被时间定位却几乎不会被分配新技能。

Conclusion: 识别现有技能何时不足（即主动扩充技能库）是当前VLM的核心瓶颈，成为流式具身技能发现的关键挑战。

Abstract: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks. Yet an agent can only plan with skills it knows. Recovering skills from observed experience, the inverse of planning, builds this knowledge over time and yields skill data for training future agents. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe individual manipulation events well, but can they organize a stream of events into reusable skills? We formulate this problem as Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD): a model watches videos in sequence and maintains a persistent skill library that shapes its later decisions. To systematically measure this ability, we introduce Video2Skill, a benchmark that covers robot tabletop manipulation and human kitchen activity and tests three core capabilities: (i) locating manipulation events in time, (ii) grouping events of the same transformation, and (iii) deciding when to reuse an existing skill or create a new one. Across 19 open-source VLMs, many models group events at near-chance level, and scale does not consistently help. Their errors depend on how perception and library updates are coupled: joint models merge distinct transformations into one skill, while models that update the library from text descriptions duplicate recurring ones. Supervised fine-tuning, including our counterfactual library-state rebalancing (CLaRe), improves grouping but exposes a deeper bottleneck: trained models consolidate familiar skills yet rarely expand the library. Their libraries stall below half the reference size, and transformations unseen in training are located in time but almost never given a new skill. Recognizing when existing skills are insufficient thus emerges as the central challenge.

</details>


### [306] [Lost in Conversation or Lost in Translation? Diagnosing Multi-Turn Degradation in RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36700)
*Pranav Handa,Ariful Azad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究系统考察RAG/GraphRAG在多轮会话场景下的评估错配问题，通过150万次模拟对话发现多轮交互导致性能相对下降最高21%、不可靠性增加47%，并识别出"翻译迷失"与"对话迷失"两种失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG与GraphRAG几乎只在单轮、完整表述的查询上评估，但真实用户往往以简单问题起步、通过多轮追问逐步构建多跳问题，导致评估与真实使用场景严重错配。

Method: 基于多轮LLM评估的既有工作，将多跳QA基准问题转化为信息不完整的对话；在150万次模拟对话中，评估10个LLM助手与8种检索系统的组合表现。

Result: 多轮交互引发普遍性能退化：相对性能下降最高达21%，不可靠性上升47%，使RAG系统同时变得既不准又不稳。退化源于两种失败模式：一是"翻译迷失"（对话改写扭曲检索查询），二是"对话迷失"（检索成功但LLM无法综合跨轮分发的证据）。

Conclusion: 当前RAG/GraphRAG评估范式高估了系统在真实多轮对话中的能力，未来需针对多轮证据整合与查询保真度进行优化与评估。

Abstract: When conversing with large language models (LLMs), users often begin with a simple question and build towards a multi-hop question through follow-up turns. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and its graph-based variant (GraphRAG) have become the dominant approaches for grounding LLM responses in external evidence, yet both are evaluated almost exclusively on single-turn, fully specified queries. We systematically investigate this evaluation mismatch through a large-scale simulation study. Building on prior work on multi-turn LLM evaluation, we transform questions from multi-hop question answering (QA) benchmarks into underspecified conversations and evaluate ten LLM assistants with eight retrieval systems across 1.5 million simulated conversations. Our findings reveal that multi-turn interaction causes widespread performance degradation, incurring relative performance drops of up to 21% and increasing unreliability by 47%, making RAG systems simultaneously less accurate and less reliable. We identify two distinct failure modes behind this degradation. Systems are either lost in translation, where conversational rephrasing distorts the retrieval query, or lost in conversation, where retrieval succeeds but the LLM fails to synthesize evidence distributed across turns.

</details>


### [307] [LAURA: Knowledge Distillation for Interpretable Ambiguous Clause Identification in Legal Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36707)
*Amrita Singh,Aditya Joshi,Jiaojiao Jiang,Hye-young Paik*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LAURA训练框架，用IRAC-Unlearning提示的知识蒸馏将教师LLM能力迁移到≤1B开源学生模型，联合分类与理由生成，实现可解释的模糊条款识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律合同中的模糊性会给企业带来财务和法律风险。部分模糊可灵活解读而不引发争议，另一些则导致重大法律冲突，因此仅靠识别不够，还需可解释的理由分析。

Method: LAURA采用知识蒸馏，结合IRAC-Unlearning提示技术，将教师LLM知识迁移到≤1B参数的开源学生模型；学生模型用分类损失与理由生成损失的联合目标进行训练。

Result: 在7个基线和7个开源权重模型上的实验表明，使用Flan-T5（250M）的LAURA在所有可解释基线中取得最优可解释性，同时识别性能与最佳不透明基线持平。

Conclusion: LAURA能为法律与非法律相关方提供可解释的模糊条款识别，帮助判断哪些模糊需要进一步关注。

Abstract: Legal contracts contain ambiguities that expose enterprises to financial and legal risks. Some ambiguities allow flexible interpretation without triggering disputes, while others lead to significant legal conflicts. This makes identification alone insufficient, and interpretable rationale analysis essential. We propose LAURA, a post-training framework for interpretable ambiguous clause identification. LAURA leverages knowledge distillation with an IRAC-Unlearning prompting technique to transfer knowledge from a teacher LLM to an open-weight student model (<=1B parameters), which is then trained using a joint objective combining classification and rationale generation losses. The framework supports both legal and non-legal stakeholders in making informed decisions about which ambiguities require further attention. Extensive experiments across 7 baselines and 7 open-weight models demonstrate that LAURA with Flan-T5 (250M) delivers state-of-the-art interpretability over all interpretable baselines while matching the identification performance of the best-performing opaque baseline.

</details>


### [308] [ATTUNER: Recomputation-Free KV Cache Reuse via Query-Side Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36722)
*Xinghao Chen,Junnan Dong,Cai Ke,Chak Tou Leong,Haocheng Sun,Keyu Chen,Siyu An,Ruizhi Qiao,Xing Sun,Wenjie Li,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Attuner，一种查询侧适配方法，通过学习读取冻结的位置无关缓存（PIC），在不重算缓存的前提下恢复全上下文预填充质量。它仅训练不到 0.05% 参数，在 Qwen3-4B/8B 七个基准上超越现有 PIC 基线并可匹配全上下文质量，提速最高达 3.73 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体反复加载可复用内容（技能、文档、记忆），每次重复编码浪费算力。位置无关缓存（PIC）虽可独立编码并任意位置复用 KV，但相较全上下文预填充存在质量损失。现有修复方法依赖恢复全局位置 ID 或重算选中 token，成本高。

Method: 作者先定位损失来源：位置错配影响很小，独立缓存的内容表示基本忠实；性能下降仅出现在需在多个 artifact 间做选择的场景。用全预填充注意力分数替换 PIC 注意力分数即可恢复性能（KV 不变），表明问题出在注意力而非 KV。据此提出 Attuner：在 query 投影中插入低秩适配器，用全预填充分布蒸馏训练学生模型，推理时无需重算缓存或全上下文参考。

Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上，覆盖技能、文档、记忆、代码的七个基准测试，Attuner 在域内与域外设置均显著优于现有 PIC 基线，匹配全上下文预填充质量，并提供最高 3.73 倍加速；训练参数少于模型的 0.05%。

Conclusion: PIC 的质量损失主要源于注意力读取而非 KV 表示或位置错配。通过在 query 侧进行轻量低秩适配并用全预填充蒸馏，Attuner 能以极低训练成本高效复用缓存，兼顾质量与速度，适合 LLM 智能体的可复用内容场景。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly load reusable content, such as skills, documents, and memory entries, into the current context. Re-encoding this content for every request wastes computation. Position-independent caching (PIC) alleviates this by encoding each artifact independently and reusing its key-value (KV) states at arbitrary positions, but it incurs a quality loss relative to full-context prefill. Existing methods repair this loss by restoring global position IDs or recomputing selected tokens. In this work, we isolate the source of the loss, finding that the positional mismatch has minor effect, and independently cached artifacts retain faithful representations: reading a provided artifact stays largely accurate, and performance degrades only when the model must select among multiple artifacts. Moreover, replacing PIC's attention scores with full-prefill scores recovers performance with the cached KV unchanged, localizing the failure to the attention rather than KV recomputation. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{Attuner}, a query-side adaptation method that learns to read a frozen artifact cache. \textsc{Attuner} inserts low-rank adapters into the query projections and is trained by distilling full-prefill distribution into the student. It trains fewer than 0.05\% of the model parameters and, at inference, requires neither cache recomputation nor a full-context reference. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks covering skills, documents, memory, and code, \textsc{Attuner} substantially outperforms prior PIC baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, matches full-context prefill quality while providing up to $3.73\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [309] [Distilling What Matters: Confidence-Aware Selective Distillation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36734)
*Ayan Sengupta,Vaibhav Seth,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CaRE-KD，一种置信度门控的知识蒸馏框架，用不确定性自适应优化替代静态目标，解决LLM教师不可靠的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准KD假设教师模型是可靠oracle，但LLM中教师预测常具高熵和幻觉，导致学生先验校准退化，因此需要不确定性自适应机制。

Method: 两组件：token级CaRE-Divergence，基于师生置信度在Forward/Reverse KL间自适应切换；batch级Revival，当教师比学生更不确定时抑制更新。并给出梯度级分析说明其条件校准机制。

Result: 在8组师生对、11个基准（指令跟随、对话对齐、代码生成、数学推理）上一致优于Skewed-KL、α-β散度等基线：ROUGE-L最高+3.2，MBPP pass@1+2.1，GSM8k+1.7，CollegeMath+1.8，事实性判官+2.5。Revival可作为即插即用模块增强现有蒸馏目标。

Conclusion: 双粒度不确定性自适应设计能实现条件校准，持续提升蒸馏效果；Revival具通用性，可过滤不可靠的教师监督。

Abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) trains a smaller-capacity student model to imitate a larger-capacity teacher model by matching output distributions, implicitly assuming the teacher to be a reliable oracle. In large language models (LLMs), this assumption often fails: teacher predictions can exhibit high entropy and hallucinations, causing standard KD to degrade well-calibrated student priors. We propose CaRE-KD, a confidence-gated distillation framework that replaces static objectives with uncertainty-adaptive optimization. CaRE-KD has two components: a token-level loss (CaRE-Divergence) that adaptively switches between Forward and Reverse KL divergence based on teacher--student confidence, and a batch-level epistemic rejection mechanism (Revival) that suppresses updates when the teacher is more uncertain than the student. We provide a gradient-level analysis showing how this dual-granularity design induces a conditional calibration mechanism that prior static divergences cannot reproduce. Empirically, across eight teacher--student pairs and eleven benchmarks spanning instruction following, chat alignment, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, CaRE-KD delivers consistent gains over strong baselines (Skewed-KL, $α$--$β$ divergence). Highlights include up to $+3.2$ average ROUGE-L on instruction-following tasks, $+2.1$ pass@1 on MBPP, $+1.7$ accuracy on GSM8k, and $+1.8$ accuracy on CollegeMath over the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in LLM-as-a-judge factuality (up to $+2.5$ per task over Skewed-RKL). Revival further acts as a principled, loss-agnostic plug-in that systematically strengthens existing distillation objectives by filtering epistemically unreliable teacher supervision.

</details>


### [310] [VAA-CSEC: Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for Chinese Semantic Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36804)
*Yitong Han,Nankai Lin,Juan Luo,Hongyan Wu,Lianxi Wang,Shengyi Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，结合CoT蒸馏、SFT、RL与自一致性解码，通过投票引导优势分配和GLPO解决过度纠正及CoT与自一致性脱节问题，在中文语义纠错任务上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中文语义纠错中的语义错误比拼写和语法错误更隐蔽复杂，但研究不足。现有基于LLM的方法面临两大障碍：过度纠正，以及CoT推理与自一致性解码之间交互不清，导致CoT收益无法可靠传递到最终纠正结果。

Method: 提出VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，融合CoT蒸馏、监督微调、强化学习和自一致性解码。RL阶段设计符合CSEC最小编辑原则的任务特定奖励函数；并引入组级相对策略优化（GLPO），根据单条rollout奖励与投票聚合组奖励之间的差距重新分配GRPO优势，使RL训练目标与推理时的自一致性目标对齐。

Result: 在CSED-C和NaSGEC-Exam数据集上，VAA-CSEC在CSED-C上以47.72%的F0.5超越所有LLM基线，取得42.15%的最高召回率，并在NaSGEC-Exam上以41.55%的F0.5刷新SOTA。

Conclusion: VAA-CSEC通过投票引导优势分配与GLPO有效缓解过度纠正和对齐训练-推理目标，在中文语义纠错任务上全面优于现有LLM方法并达到新的SOTA。

Abstract: Chinese Semantic Error Correction (CSEC) targets semantic errors in Chinese text, which are typically more subtle and complex than spelling and grammatical errors but remain relatively underexplored. Existing LLM-based approaches face two recurring obstacles in this task: over-correction, and unclear interaction between Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and self-consistency decoding, such that the benefits brought by CoT cannot be reliably transferred to final corrections. We propose Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for CSEC (VAA-CSEC), a multi-stage framework that combines CoT distillation, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL) and self-consistency decoding. During RL, we design a task-specific reward function that directly aligned with the minimal-editing principle of CSEC. We further introduce Group-Level Relative Policy Optimization (GLPO), which reallocates GRPO advantages according to the margin between individual rollout rewards and the vote-aggregated group reward, aligning the RL training objective with the self-consistency objective used at inference time. Experiments on CSED-C and NaSGEC-Exam show that VAA-CSEC outperforms all LLM-based baselines on CSED-C with an F0.5 of 47.72%, achieves the highest recall of 42.15% among all methods, and establishes a new state of the art of 41.55% F0.5 on NaSGEC-Exam.

</details>


### [311] [Momentum-Coupled Rubric Adaptation for Detailed Image Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36893)
*Zhenwen Ji,Lei Jin,Shanyong Wang,Jiaming Lu,Chengqiang Lu,Yi Wu,Yao Hu,Lizhen Cui,Yanyu Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 MoCo Rubric 两阶段框架，通过共享参数多任务 SFT 和动量模型协调 Caption Policy、Rubric Generator、Rubric Judge 三者，实现基于评分量规的强化学习图像描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 rubric-based RL 方法常用独立模型分别负责生成、量规构建和评判，导致角色间解释不一致；动态量规方法的交替更新也使量规构建与评判同策略优化脱节。

Method: 第一阶段：角色条件、共享参数的多任务监督微调，使单一视觉语言模型同时充当 Caption Policy、Rubric Generator 和 Rubric Judge。第二阶段：Generator 基于当前 Policy 采样描述、参考描述和图像证据在线构建量规，Judge 提供基于量规的奖励，仅 Policy 用 GRPO 更新；用 Policy 参数的指数移动平均更新 Generator 与 Judge 共享的动量模型。

Result: 在五个描述基准上取得 72.83% 平均成对胜率，盲排序中最佳平均排名，以及基于描述问答的最高平均分。

Conclusion: MoCo Rubric 通过角色协调和动量同步，在不单独 RL 优化量规角色情况下保持其能力并跟踪策略更新，验证了结构化评分量规反馈的有效性。

Abstract: Detailed image captioning requires accurate and comprehensive descriptions of fine-grained visual content, yet caption quality spans factual accuracy, information coverage, and clarity. Compared with conventional methods that rely mainly on high-quality supervision or holistic rewards, rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes these requirements into explicit criteria and provides targeted, structured feedback. However, existing methods often use separate models for caption generation, rubric construction, and judging, which may lead to inconsistent interpretations across roles. Some dynamic rubric methods alternate updates between the caption policy and rubric generator while keeping the judge fixed, but staged optimization may still leave rubric construction and judging out of step with policy optimization. We propose MoCo Rubric, a two-stage framework that coordinates these roles. First, role-conditioned, shared-parameter multi-task supervised fine-tuning equips a single vision--language model to serve as the Caption Policy, Rubric Generator, and Rubric Judge. Then, the Generator constructs rubrics online from captions sampled by the current Policy, reference captions, and image evidence. The Judge provides rubric-based rewards, and only the Policy receives GRPO updates. As Policy updates change the candidates being evaluated, we use an exponential moving average of the Policy parameters to update one momentum model shared by the Generator and Judge. This gradual transfer lets both rubric roles track Policy updates without separate RL optimization while smoothing parameter changes that could disrupt their rubric capabilities under direct synchronization. Across five captioning benchmarks, MoCo Rubric achieves an average pairwise win rate of 72.83\%, the best mean rank in blind ranking, and the highest average score in caption-based question answering.

</details>


### [312] [MultiTalk: Scaling Full-Duplex Speech Models to Long, Multi-Party, Bilingual Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36903)
*Ke Wang,Houxing Ren,Zimu Lu,Yunqiao Yang,Zhuofan Zong,Mingjie Zhan,Hongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文扩展Moshi范式，同时面向长上下文和多方交互，构建了英中双语长时多方全双工对话数据集、评测基准及模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端全双工语音模型在长上下文鲁棒性和多方交互两方面受限；开放多方语音语料规模小、不适合编解码帧级建模，现有长音频基准偏被动听、语音对话基准多为短时双方。

Method: 发布57.6k小时合成训练数据MultiTalkPT/MultiTalkFT，支持可控长度、参与者数量、轮次、重叠、反馈、打断、受话人切换和长程指代；构建基于真实录音的MultiTalkBench；训练英中双语Moshi式模型。

Result: MultiTalkBench对话平均32.6分钟，包含长程实体追踪、话题一致性和受话人选择探针；模型在MultiTalkBench上显著优于Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5、Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct等开源基线。

Conclusion: 该工作从数据和评测两方面推进长时多方全双工语音对话，并验证了双语模型在长时多方交互中的有效性。

Abstract: End-to-end full-duplex speech models have brought open-source machine conversation closer to human-like interaction, yet existing systems remain limited in two intertwined dimensions: long-context robustness and multi-party interaction. Real-world scenarios such as meetings, group lessons, and social-robot reception require a single model to track, contextualize, and respond to multiple speakers over extended durations. Progress is constrained by both data and evaluation: open multi-party speech corpora remain small and are not designed for codec-frame-level full-duplex modeling, while existing long-audio benchmarks focus on passive listening and speech-to-speech benchmarks are mostly short and dyadic. We extend the Moshi paradigm jointly along the long-horizon and multi-party axes in English and Chinese. First, we release 57.6k hours of synthetic training data ($\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkPT}{MultiTalkPT}$ and $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkFT}{MultiTalkFT}$) for long-form, multi-party, English-Chinese full-duplex dialogue, with controllable length, participant count, turn-taking, overlap, backchannels, interruptions, addressee shifts, and long-range coreference. Second, we introduce $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkBench}{MultiTalkBench}$, built from real human recordings, for evaluating long-form, multi-party, bilingual full-duplex dialogue. Conversations average 32.6 minutes and include probes for long-range entity tracking, topic coherence, and addressee selection. Third, we train a bilingual Moshi-style model that sustains coherent multi-party English-Chinese conversations over extended durations and substantially outperforms open-source baselines including Moshi, MiniCPM-o-4.5, and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on MultiTalkBench.

</details>


### [313] [BaLEEN: Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities for Context-Aware ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36913)
*Chihiro Taguchi,Yotaro Kubo,Rujikorn Charakorn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BaLEEN：基于超网络的轻量级动态上下文自适应框架，无需微调ASR模型，通过Perceiver瓶颈注入偏差向量，显著降低关键词漏识率并改善WER/CER。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特定领域实体和罕见专有名词的转录是ASR的主要挑战，现有方法往往需要微调模型或增加推理开销。

Method: 用预训练语言模型编码变长上下文关键词，经Perceiver瓶颈压缩为固定长度的潜在向量序列，并将上下文相关的偏差向量直接注入ASR模型的中间编码器表示。语言模型与主干ASR均冻结，BaLEEN作为即插即用适配器，预计算上下文偏差时推理零额外开销。

Result: 在基于CTC的ASR模型、维基百科派生语料（含标注命名实体与合成语音）上评测：关键词漏识率相对无偏基线降低8.7%，同时WER改善21%，CER改善28%。

Conclusion: BaLEEN是一种高效、无需微调的动态上下文自适应方案，在提升关键词识别的同时改善整体识别性能，且推理零开销，具备较强的实用价值。

Abstract: Transcribing domain-specific entities and rare proper nouns remains a major challenge in automatic speech recognition (ASR). In this paper, we propose BaLEEN (Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities), a lightweight, hypernetwork-based framework for dynamic contextual adaptation without fine-tuning the underlying ASR model. BaLEEN encodes variable-length contextual keywords using a pretrained language model, compresses them into a fixed sequence of latent vectors via a Perceiver bottleneck, and injects context-dependent bias vectors directly into the intermediate encoder representations of the ASR model. Because both the language model and the backbone ASR model remain entirely frozen during training, BaLEEN operates as a plug-and-play adapter that incurs zero computational overhead at inference time when context biases are precomputed. We evaluate our method on a CTC-based ASR model using a Wikipedia-derived corpus with annotated named entities and synthetic speech. Experimental results demonstrate that BaLEEN reduces keyword miss rate by 8.7% on the test set relative to the unbiased baseline while simultaneously improving overall word error rate by 21% and character error rate by 28%.

</details>


### [314] [Can Language Models Learn to Forecast Stock Prices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36914)
*Jiacheng Guo,Suozhi Huang,Shuzhen Li,Yunlong Gao,Zerui Cheng,Jason Ge,Shushu Liang,Zihao Li,Hao Lu,Ming Yin,Shilong Liu,Jiashuo Liu,Xu Kuang,Mengdi Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文在按时间顺序的股票价格沙盒中研究后训练能否提升语言模型的金融预测能力。对Qwen3-4B先做工具使用示范的SFT，再用PPO结合基于实现收益的终端奖励训练，得到AURA-4B，方向-幅度得分从20.94翻倍到43.31，接近前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练在数学、软件工程、计算机操作等可验证结果任务上显著提升语言模型性能，但在金融市场预测中效果不明：实现收益噪声大，且有效预测所需的相关信息集并不先验清晰，模型需自行决定收集哪些观测并在结果未知前做出数值判断。

Method: 构建按时间顺序的股票价格沙盒，模型收集价格、成交量、相对表现和市场背景证据并预测未来收益；对Qwen3-4B先在工具使用示范上做监督微调（SFT），再以针对实现收益的预测分数作为终端奖励进行近端策略优化（PPO）。

Result: AURA-4B将初始方向-幅度得分从20.94提升到43.31（超过两倍），在该基准上与前沿语言模型相当；条件幅度一致性从33.3升至66.2，方向准确率从62.9变为65.4；SFT扩展了工具使用，PPO进一步提高排序和市场背景查询的比例。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在该基于结果筛选的基准上，后训练可大幅提升金融预测表现，同时改变模型调查市场的方式。

Abstract: Post-training has been shown to significantly improve language models' performance on tasks with verifiable outcomes, including mathematical reasoning, software engineering, and computer use. However, whether the same approach can improve forecasting in financial markets is much less clear. Compared with tasks with verifiable outcomes, not only are realized returns noisy, but even what constitutes a relevant information set for making effective predictions is not obvious a priori: the model must decide which observations to gather and then commit to a numerical judgment before the outcome is known. We study this question in a chronological stock-price sandbox, where a language model gathers price, volume, relative-performance, and market-context evidence and predicts a future return. We post-train Qwen3-4B with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-use demonstrations, then proximal policy optimization (PPO) with a terminal reward given by the forecast score against the realized return. The resulting AURA-4B more than doubles the starting direction--magnitude score, from 20.94 to 43.31, and is comparable to frontier language models on this benchmark. Conditional magnitude agreement rises from 33.3 to 66.2, while directional accuracy changes from 62.9 to 65.4. SFT expands tool use, and PPO further increases the share of ranking and market-context queries. These results show that post-training can substantially improve financial forecasting performance, together with changes in how the model investigates the market, on this outcome-selected benchmark.

</details>


### [315] [Benchmarking Automatic Speech Recognition Tools for Iberian Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36920)
*Fernando López,Pablo Gómez,David Solans,Paulo Villegas,Jordi Luque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对11个ASR系统在5种伊比利亚语言(另加德语、土耳其语作对照)上进行基准评测,发现精度、效率与语言覆盖存在明显权衡,低资源语言(尤其巴斯克语)性能显著下降,且多数系统存在性别差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伊比利亚语言的ASR综合评估仍有限,低资源语言、偏见及效率权衡研究不足,缺少面向实际场景的模型选择指导。

Method: 评测11个系统(10个开放权重模型+1个商业API),覆盖5种伊比利亚语言,以德语和土耳其语为对照;使用85小时数据集(朗读语音、广播媒体、有声书),用WER衡量精度、RTF/RTFx衡量效率。

Result: 无单一模型全面领先,精度、效率与语言覆盖之间存在清晰权衡;低资源语言尤其巴斯克语性能大幅下降,凸显训练覆盖的作用;多数系统存在一致的性别差异。

Conclusion: 该基准为真实场景下的多语言ASR模型选择提供实用指导,并揭示公平性挑战。

Abstract: Comprehensive evaluations of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for Iberian languages remain limited, and low-resource languages, biases, and efficiency trade-offs are underexplored. We benchmark eleven systems, ten open-weight models and one commercial API, across five Iberian languages (Basque, Catalan, Galician, Portuguese, Spanish), with German and Turkish as controls. Evaluation uses an 85-hour dataset covering read speech, broadcast media, and audiobooks, assessing accuracy and efficiency via word error rate (WER) and real-time factors (RTF/RTFx). Results show no single model dominates: accuracy, efficiency, and language coverage present clear trade-offs. Low-resource languages, especially Basque, degrade significantly, highlighting the role of training coverage. We observe consistent sex disparities across most systems, highlighting fairness challenges in multilingual ASR. Overall, the benchmark provides practical guidance for real-world model selection.

</details>


### [316] [Dating the Model: Hidden Dates in System Prompts Affect LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36931)
*Mario Sanz-Guerrero,Minh Duc Bui,Manuel Mager,Katharina von der Wense*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现LLM系统提示中会隐式注入当前日期（用户无法控制且每天变化），导致模型输出随日期波动，影响复现性和排行榜公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM输出已被证明会随硬件和批处理变化而不稳定，但现有研究忽略了系统提示中隐式注入的当前日期这一因素，它不受用户控制且每日变化，可能严重威胁研究的可复现性。

Method: 在9个近期LLM和6个数据集上评测，覆盖多项选择问答（MCQA）、数学推理、代码生成和机器翻译四类任务，考察仅因当前日期变化导致的性能波动，并与批大小、数值精度等其他非确定性来源对比；同时测试思维链（CoT）和少样本提示是否能缓解该敏感性。

Result: 性能仅随当前日期变化：MCQA最多6%、数学推理14%、代码生成7%、机器翻译2.84 BLEU；模型排名也随之改变，影响排行榜。日期效应超过批大小和数值精度等其他非确定性来源。CoT和少样本提示无法降低敏感性，CoT甚至放大该效应。

Conclusion: 日期效应凸显了LLM研究亟需谨慎的评测协议，以确保可复现性和公平比较。

Abstract: Reproducibility is essential for scientific research, yet prior work shows that LLM outputs vary with hardware and batching. We identify an overlooked factor: the hidden injection of the current date into system prompts, which users cannot control and which changes every day. Across 9 recent LLMs and 6 datasets spanning multiple-choice QA (MCQA), math reasoning, code generation, and machine translation, performance varies solely with the current date, with deltas of up to 6% on MCQA, 14% on math reasoning, 7% on code generation, and 2.84 BLEU on machine translation. Model rankings also shift, affecting leaderboards. This date effect exceeds other sources of non-determinism, such as batch size and numerical precision. Standard prompting techniques -- chain-of-thought and few-shot prompting -- do not reduce the sensitivity; chain-of-thought even amplifies it. Our findings underscore the need for careful evaluation protocols to ensure reproducibility and fair comparisons in LLM research.

</details>


### [317] [ER-JEPA: Experience Replay Improves Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36952)
*Jingnan Pu,Zi-En Fan,Feng Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ER-JEPA，在LLM-JEPA基础上加入情景回放记忆路径，通过存储和检索训练对提供额外监督，提升LLM的预测准确性与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM擅长token级生成，但可能学到不良抽象语义且缺乏全面感知；LLM-JEPA虽通过JEPA对齐同一知识的不同视图来缓解，但强对齐不一定带来准确稳定的预测。

Method: 在LLM-JEPA上增加episodic replay路径：将训练对存入memory，每步存储并检索相关数据，从当前batch和存储的训练对中共同学习，为token预测和表示对齐提供额外监督。

Result: 在NL-RX、GSM8K、Spider、NQ-Open等多个数据集上，ER-JEPA一致优于LLM-JEPA。

Conclusion: 通过引入情景回放记忆机制，ER-JEPA有效弥补了强对齐无法保证准确稳定预测的不足，实现了稳定的性能提升。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at token-level generation but may learn undesirable abstract semantics and lack comprehensive perception. LLM-JEPA mitigates this by aligning different views of the same underlying knowledge via a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). However, strong alignment does not necessarily lead to accurate, stable predictions. To address this, we propose ER-JEPA, which adds an episodic replay path to LLM-JEPA. ER-JEPA stores training pairs in a memory. At each step, it stores and retrieves relevant data to provide additional supervision. This enables learning from both the current batch and stored training pairs, providing additional supervision for token prediction and representation alignment. Experiments across multiple datasets (NL-RX, GSM8K, Spider, and NQ-Open) demonstrate that ER-JEPA consistently outperforms LLM-JEPA.

</details>


### [318] [Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36965)
*Zexiao Wang,Zihao Zhang,Xudong Wang,Pan Wang,Ziyi Ye,Haoyu Zhao,Zuxuan Wu,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Chinese-Jev 是一个面向中文决策任务的 System One 模型，通过统一数据处理与训练流程提升中文决策准确率，并在通用与医疗/法律/金融领域实现高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 System One 模型（如 Jev）在中文决策任务上准确率有限，影响其在通用及专业场景中的实用性。

Method: 将异构中文标注转为候选选项上的概率目标，形成跨领域统一训练形式；采用轻量 encoder-only 骨干进行文本编码，并进行面向决策的打分训练；先在 1000 万通用语料上预训练，再针对医疗、法律、金融分别微调；提出 CJ-Bench 评估准确率与校准。

Result: 一阶段预训练后，通用域准确率超 Jev 1.24%，加速 20.3x；领域微调后医疗准确率比 Jev 高 4.0%，专业域平均准确率达 Jev 的 92%，加速 17x，平均延迟 15ms；INT8 量化移动端部署延迟约 1.0s。

Conclusion: Chinese-Jev 有效提升中文决策准确率与效率，支持领域适配和移动端部署。

Abstract: System One models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative language models for tasks that require decisions rather than open-ended responses. However, existing Jev models exhibit limited Chinese-language decision accuracy, restricting their utility in both general and specialized settings. In this paper, we introduce Chinese-Jev, a System One model that addresses this gap through a unified data processing and training pipeline. Our data processing protocol converts heterogeneous Chinese-language annotations into probability targets over candidate options, enabling a shared training formulation across domains and question formats. To enable efficient inference, Chinese-Jev adopts a lightweight encoder-only backbone for text encoding and learns to score candidate answers through decision-oriented training. To address the misalignment between the pre-training distribution and downstream Chinese-language scenarios, we first train the model on a general-purpose corpus of 10 million examples, then fine-tune it separately for the medical, legal, and financial domains. To evaluate decision accuracy and calibration in both general and domain-specific Chinese-language settings, we introduce Chinese-Jev Bench (CJ-Bench). After first-stage pre-training, Chinese-Jev exceeds the accuracy of the closed-source Jev model by 1.24% on general-domain tasks while achieving a 20.3x speedup. Subsequent domain-specific fine-tuning yields a 4.0% accuracy improvement over Jev in medicine and achieves 92% of Jev's average accuracy across specialized domains, with a 17x speedup and an average latency of only 15 ms per example. We further demonstrate on-device deployment of an INT8-quantized model on mobile devices, achieving an inference latency of approximately 1.0 second per decision. The project is available at https://gulucaptain.github.io/Chinese-Jev/.

</details>


### [319] [Repetition, Not Length: Isolating the Counting Failure in Neural Text-to-Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36974)
*Kirill Borodin,Vasilii Kudryavtsev,Maxim Maslov,Grach Mkrtchian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 重复结构本身导致TTS模型失败，与长度无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTS模型在重复文本上出现循环、截断和计数错误，作者欲区分是重复本身还是文本长度导致失败。

Method: 将每个重复句子与句数、词数匹配但不含连续重复词的控制组配对，测试三种架构的六个模型，并进行贪婪解码、重复惩罚扫参、四个语音识别器及420种分析设定的稳健性检验，另测试第四种架构和两个非自回归基线。

Result: k≥6时控制组94.3%完全正确，重复组仅18.2%；差距在所有检验中方向不变，第四架构预测误差在1个百分点内，一个非自回归基线也失败；改变重复周期显示失败随周期性平滑增长，即使无相邻重复词仍保留一半失败。

Conclusion: TTS的失败源于文本的周期性/重复结构，而非长度；失败程度随周期性连续变化。

Abstract: Text-to-speech models loop, truncate and lose count on text that repeats a phrase many times. We show that repetition itself is what breaks them, not the length that comes with it. Every repeated sentence in our test set is paired with a control of matched sentence and word count in which no word ever repeats back-to-back. Six models from three architectures render the controls almost perfectly and fail the repeated twins: 94.3% against 18.2% exactly right at k >= 6. The gap survives greedy decoding, repetition-penalty sweeps, four independent speech recognisers and 420 analysis specifications without once reversing sign; a held-out fourth architecture lands within a point of its predicted gap, and one of two non-autoregressive baselines shows the same failure. Varying the period of the text shows the failure grows smoothly with periodicity, half of it surviving when no word is adjacent to itself.

</details>


### [320] [AMU:Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations---Structured Memory with SLM Guided Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36976)
*Tao Hwang,Yishi Diao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AMU：一个SLM引导的结构化框架，在写入阶段控制个性化对话记忆的准入与更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化助手的记忆系统多关注存储、检索或巩固，而记忆写入缺乏控制，导致瞬时请求、重复陈述和过时用户状态进入记忆，后续检索时影响个性化效果。

Method: AMU采用结构化记忆过滤决定哪些内容应进入记忆；并用SLM引导的存储管理判断已准入记录应单独存储、作为重复项丢弃，还是作为更新融合。

Result: 在受控的记忆写入与检索设置下评估，AMU能保持更干净、更可检索的个性化记忆。

Conclusion: 通过在写入阶段引入准入与更新控制，AMU提升了长期交互中个性化记忆的质量与检索可用性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of personalized assistants, but maintaining persistent user memory across long-term interactions remains challenging. Existing memory systems often focus on storage, retrieval, or consolidation, while memory writing remains less controlled: transient requests, duplicate statements, and outdated user states may enter memory and later be retrieved for personalization. In this paper, we present AMU: Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations, an SLM-guided (Small language model guided) structured framework for writing-time memory control. AMU uses structured memory filtering to decide what should enter memory and SLM-guided storage management to determine whether an admitted record should be stored separately, discarded as a duplicate, or fused as an update. We evaluate AMU in a controlled memory writing and retrieval setting. Experimental results show that AMU maintains cleaner and more retrievable personalized memories.

</details>


### [321] [SRJudge: Empowering Large Language Models with Selective Reasoning for Fine-Grained Knowledge Concept Tagging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36982)
*Zhiwei Yang,Jiahua Yang,Huiru Lin,Xing Chen,Quanlong Guan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出三阶段Select-Reason-Judge (SRJudge)框架，用SLM缩小候选集、轻量LLM推理、大LLM评判，实现细粒度知识概念标注，并构建生物/物理数据集，实验优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM用于知识概念标注时，因候选概念集规模大、决策空间维度高，难以从大量候选中选出正确概念。

Method: 三阶段框架：Stage1 Selector用微调SLM（如BERT）将候选缩至top-K短名单；Stage2 Reasoner用轻量LLM对短名单精细推理，结合改进强化学习策略、动态任务奖励函数和剪枝机制对齐人类推理偏好；Stage3 Judge用更大LLM评估推理过程与解释的合理性以确定最终输出。

Result: 构建了生物学数据集S_Bio和物理学数据集S_Phy两个高质量数据集，实验结果显示该方法在基准数据集上持续超越SOTA基线。

Conclusion: SRJudge通过选择性推理有效降低决策空间并提升知识概念标注效果，验证了其有效性与优越性。

Abstract: Knowledge concept tagging aims to assign specific concept or topic labels to educational content, which is essential for both educators and learners in traditional and online teaching practices. Recent work has explored large language models (LLMs) for this task, achieving promising performance. However, LLMs still struggle to select the correct concept from a large-scale candidate set due to the high dimensionality of the decision space. In this paper, we propose a novel three-stage Select-Reason-Judge (SRJudge) framework, which empowers LLMs with selective reasoning capability for fine-grained knowledge concept tagging. Specifically, the Selector in Stage 1 first narrows the candidate concepts to a top-K shortlist by fine-tuning a small language model (SLM), e.g., BERT, since the top-$K$ predictions hit the correct concept in most cases, thereby reducing the decision space of correct candidates. Next, the Stage 2 Reasoner employs a lightweight LLM for refined reasoning over the shortlisted candidates. It further integrates an improved reinforcement learning strategy with a dynamic task-specific reward function and a pruning mechanism to better align with human reasoning preferences. Finally, a larger LLM acts as a judger that evaluates the overall rationality of the reasoning process and its explanations to determine the final output. In addition, we construct two high-quality datasets for further validation, i.e., the biology dataset S_Bio and the physics dataset S_Phy. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmark datasets, verifying its effectiveness and superiority. Resources are available at: https://github.com/Nicozwy/SRJudge.

</details>


### [322] [CypherTurn: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Conversational Text-to-Cypher Evaluation and the Autonomy Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36987)
*Yuzhe Zhang,Weijie Zhu,Haolin Yang,Ziyun Zhang,Xianwei Xue,Mengke Chen,Qiutong Pan,Huaqian Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出首个对话式Text-to-Cypher基准CypherTurn，包含721个会话、5927轮对话，覆盖7个知识图谱和13种对话现象，评测15个模型并给出四项关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图数据库自然语言查询基准仅评估孤立的单轮查询，无法反映分析师实际进行的多轮会话式工作流程，因此缺乏对对话式Text-to-Cypher的系统评测。

Method: 构建CypherTurn基准（721会话/5927轮/7知识图谱/13对话现象），并在引导式oracle协议与全自主agentic协议下评测15个模型。

Result: 最优模型执行准确率仅64.7%，会话级正确率低于5%；自主运行下前沿模型排行榜顶部出现重排（Autonomy Divergence）；将动作预算从x3扩到x10无法缩小自主差距（模型自我限制约每轮两次动作）；单轮Cypher微调会损害多轮指令遵循，而架构适配的专门化模型可超越部分前沿模型。

Conclusion: CypherTurn确立了对话式图数据库推理的开放挑战，表明错误管理是独立于生成能力的部分独立能力，代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Graph databases are increasingly queried through natural language, yet every existing benchmark evaluates isolated single-turn queries rather than the multi-turn sessions through which analysts actually work. We introduce CypherTurn, the first benchmark for conversational Text-to-Cypher evaluation, comprising 721 sessions and 5,927 turns across 7 knowledge graphs and 13 conversational phenomena. We evaluate 15 models under a guided oracle protocol and a fully autonomous agentic protocol, yielding four findings. First, the best model reaches only 64.7% execution accuracy, and session-level correctness remains below 5%. Second, despite strong overall rank correlation, frontier models exhibit a consequential reordering of the top of the leaderboard under autonomous operation, a phenomenon we term the Autonomy Divergence, which reveals error-management as a partially independent capability from raw generation skill. Third, scaling action budgets from x3 to x10 fails to close the autonomy gap, as the strongest frontier models self-limit to approximately two actions per turn regardless of available budget. Fourth, single-turn Cypher fine-tuning degrades multi-turn instruction following, while architecture-appropriate specialization outperforms several frontier models. These results establish CypherTurn as an open challenge for conversational graph database reasoning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/BarryQ/CypherTurn.

</details>


### [323] [LatCom: Cross-Agent Latent Compression for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37017)
*Shinan Zhang,Tao Zhang,Qihui Zhu,Mengjie Zhang,Dong Jin,Yunpeng Hou,Shuangwu Chen,Xiaobin Tan,Quan Zheng,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LatCom：面向多智能体潜在协作的跨智能体潜在压缩框架，将多个发送者潜在映射为固定数量、接收方可读且任务相关的槽位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统用潜在协作避免自然语言通信的信息损失与编解码开销，但直接转发所有发送者潜在会使接收端上下文随智能体数量和推理长度增长，导致计算、内存和延迟增加。现有潜在压缩方法各自独立压缩再拼接，未解决跨智能体冗余。

Method: LatCom将多个发送者潜在映射为固定数量的接收方可读、任务相关槽位；不重建全部发送者隐状态，而是针对接收端任务效用优化压缩潜在。两阶段训练：先单发送者可读性学习，建立冻结接收方可解释的潜在接口；再多发送者融合学习，融合互补证据并去除跨智能体冗余。

Result: 在多个基准上用Qwen3-4B实验，相比LatentMAS平均推理加速2.46倍，输出token用量减少70.3%，同时保持平均准确率相当。

Conclusion: LatCom通过跨智能体潜在压缩有效去除冗余，在保持准确率的同时显著提升多智能体潜在协作效率。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly use latent collaboration to avoid the information loss and repeated encoding-decoding overhead of natural-language communication. However, directly forwarding all sender latents makes the receiver-side context scale with both the number of agents and the reasoning length, increasing computation, memory usage, and collaboration latency. A natural solution is latent compression. But we find that cross-agent redundancy remains unresolved in existing latent compression approaches, which typically compress each sender independently and then concatenate the results. We propose LatCom, a cross-agent latent compression framework for efficient multi-agent latent collaboration. LatCom maps multiple sender latents into a fixed number of receiver-readable and task-relevant slots. Rather than reconstructing all sender hidden states, it optimizes the compressed latents for receiver-side task utility. LatCom trains the compressor in two stages: single-sender readability learning first establishes a latent interface interpretable by the frozen receiver, and multi-sender fusion learning then trains the compressor to fuse complementary evidence and remove redundancy across agents. Experiments on multiple benchmarks with Qwen3-4B show that LatCom achieves an average 2.46x inference speed-up over LatentMAS and reduces output token usage by 70.3% while maintaining comparable average accuracy.

</details>


### [324] [Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37040)
*Federico Torrielli,Gianluca Barmina,Andrea Blasi Núñez,Amon Rapp,Luigi Di Caro,Peter Schneider-Kamp,Lukas Galke Poech*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨在自然语言自动编码器解释中应检查哪些token位置，通过470万条解释发现仅用聊天结构选择位置比计算信号更相关，解释5%位置即可保留几乎全部威胁检测成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释每个token位置成本高昂，审计者需要知道应检查哪些位置才能高效理解潜在威胁。

Method: 在prompt injection与concealment任务上分析470万条解释，比较模型计算信号与仅基于聊天结构训练的排序器。

Result: 聊天结构通常选出比计算信号更相关的解释，且无需前向传播；在四个数据集中的三个上，仅解释5%位置即可保留接近全部成功率；预训练verbalizer无需额外训练即可恢复模型经微调学会隐藏的词。

Conclusion: 审计者可集中解释生成于关键位置，且有用解释可超越verbalizer原本训练描述的模型范围。

Abstract: Natural language autoencoders translate a language model's internal activations into readable explanations. Explaining every token position is costly. Which positions should an auditor inspect to understand a potential threat? We study this question across $4.7$ million explanations on prompt injection and concealment. We compare signals from model computation with a ranker trained only on chat structure. Chat structure usually selects more relevant explanations than the computational signals, without requiring a model forward pass for position selection. On three of four datasets, explaining just $5\%$ of positions retains nearly all of the success rate from explaining every position, where success means obtaining an explanation about the threat. The benefit varies with the audit task. We also show that pretrained verbalizers recover words that models have learned to conceal through fine-tuning, without additional verbalizer training. These results identify where auditors can concentrate explanation generation and show that useful explanations can extend beyond the model a verbalizer was trained to describe.

</details>


### [325] [Learning from Think-Mode Advantage via On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37044)
*Wanqi Ren,Jianxiang Wang,Danxuan Liu,Linyi Ding,Yuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究利用"think-mode"优势的on-policy distillation (OPD)，提出trace-response divergence (TRD)概念，并设计ThinkOPD方法在response级别路由监督信号，在数学推理与代码生成任务上优于Uniform ThinkOPD及多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式中间推理让LLM获得更强的问题求解能力，作者希望从这种think-mode优势中学习。Uniform ThinkOPD虽使用on-policy前缀，但共享的privileged trace未必与每条完整回复路径兼容，导致同结果回复下teacher-student差异不一致。

Method: OPD保留学生生成轨迹，在student-visited前缀提供稠密token级teacher目标。作者提出TRD刻画trace与response的不兼容性，设计ThinkOPD，在response级别结合group-relative reward gain与TRD-based compatibility proxy进行监督路由，并在每个rollout group内归一化最终response权重。

Result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上，ThinkOPD在同模型设置和两组跨模型teacher-student配对中均优于Uniform ThinkOPD，并在受控比较中超过代表性rationale与self-distillation基线。受控干预显示，outcome benefit与TRD-based proxy提供互补路由信号。

Conclusion: Think-enabled OPD为研究teacher优势如何沿学生回复传递提供了受控实验环境，ThinkOPD通过TRD感知的response级路由有效提升蒸馏效果。

Abstract: Explicit intermediate reasoning gives large language models (LLMs) a stronger problem-solving mode. We study learning from this think-mode advantage via on-policy distillation (OPD). OPD preserves student-generated trajectories and provides dense token-level teacher targets at student-visited prefixes. Privileged reasoning is used during distillation rather than student inference. Uniform ThinkOPD, a natural think-enabled OPD baseline, conditions a fixed teacher on one shared think trace and uniformly distills every sibling student response. Although its prefixes are on-policy, the trace need not follow a route compatible with every complete response: the same privileged trace can induce different teacher-student discrepancies even when responses reach the same outcome. We summarize this interaction with trace-response divergence (TRD) and introduce ThinkOPD, which routes supervision at the response level by combining group-relative reward gain with a TRD-based compatibility proxy. Final response weights are normalized within each rollout group. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation, ThinkOPD outperforms Uniform ThinkOPD in both same-model settings and both cross-model teacher-student pairs, and it exceeds representative rationale and self-distillation baselines in a controlled comparison. Controlled interventions show that outcome benefit and the TRD-based proxy provide complementary routing signals in this setting. Think-enabled OPD provides a controlled setting for studying how teacher advantage becomes transferable along student responses.

</details>


### [326] [Traverse: Learning When to Remember, Reset, and Redirect for Long-Horizon Web Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37082)
*Jingyuan Ma,Lynx Aster,He Zhang,Siyao Song,Weijie Yuan,Zhe Zhang,Kai Jia,Zhifang Sui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出自主搜索框架（Rubric-Answer-Verify三状态）+ Seal Memory主动上下文管理，用RL训练；发现Seal Collapse问题，仅训练上下文管理后的最后片段解决；35B模型BrowseComp达72.83，多个基准超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程信息检索智能体易累积噪声或误导性上下文，早期错误持续存在且难以恢复。

Method: 自主搜索框架含Rubric/Answer/Verify三状态：先定义有效答案标准，按标准搜索，再独立验证结果后决定终止或继续。配备Seal Memory工具实现主动上下文管理。用强化学习训练该行为，针对Seal Collapse（训练不稳定、无法可靠学习记忆工具使用时机）提出仅训练上下文管理后最后片段的策略。

Result: 35B模型在BrowseComp上达72.83，超越同类开源系统；在BrowseComp-ZH、xbench、DeepSearchQA、WideSearch、金融调查、产品搜索上均持续优于基座模型。消融显示自主压缩优于自动压缩，并验证了RL设计。

Conclusion: 自主上下文管理与验证机制结合定制RL训练可显著提升长时程信息检索智能体的性能，仅训练后段片段能有效缓解Seal Collapse。

Abstract: Long-horizon information-seeking agents often accumulate noisy or misleading context, causing early mistakes to persist and making recovery increasingly difficult. We introduce an autonomous search harness in which the agent manages its own search process through three states: Rubric, Answer, and Verify. The agent first defines criteria for a valid answer, searches under these criteria, and then independently verifies the result before deciding whether to terminate or continue searching. It is further equipped with a Seal Memory tool that enables active context management. Training this behavior with reinforcement learning, however, can induce Seal Collapse, resulting in unstable training and preventing the agent from reliably learning when and how to use its memory tools. We solve this with a simple strategy that trains only the final segment after context management. Our 35B model achieves 72.83 on BrowseComp, outperforming comparable open-source systems, and consistently improves over the base model across BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, DeepSearchQA, WideSearch, financial investigation, and product search. Ablations show that autonomous compression outperforms automatic compaction and validate our RL design.

</details>


### [327] [What Does Post-Training Change in Multilingual Reasoning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37104)
*Hongyang Li,Xiao Li,Caesar Wu,Grégoire Danoy,Pascal Bouvry*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文审计了Qwen3在多语言竞赛数学任务上的推理能力，发现非英语语言存在严重的“交付”缺口，并揭示瓶颈随训练阶段（SFT、RL）转移，提出一条从英语中心能力到可靠多语言推理的后训练路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源推理模型在不同语言间提供不平等的推理能力获取。当模型能解题却无法用用户语言给出完整解答时，语言本身成为获取障碍，而非仅是性能差异来源。

Method: 在11种语言的竞赛数学任务上审计Qwen3检查点；评估同一模型家族的13个端点，涵盖已发布检查点、两种规模的多语言SFT、受控SFT消融，以及三种RL奖励形式；联合追踪正确性、语言遵循、终止性和交付效率。

Result: 十种非英语语言中，仅15.4–17.9%的问题能获得用所请求语言、含可见推理且正确终止的解答，而英语为92.9%。已发布模型常以英语推理。多语言SFT恢复目标语言推理，但准确率下降，且非英语推理易陷入不终止循环。RL恢复了终止性且不损失准确率，但只有奖励中含语言项的RL分支才有效；仅奖励正确性会使模型回归英语。

Conclusion: 这些训练阶段共同确立了一条建设性的后训练路径，可将英语中心的能力转化为可可靠交付的多语言推理。

Abstract: Open-source reasoning models provide unequal access to reasoning capability across languages. When a model can solve a problem but cannot deliver a complete solution in the user's language, language becomes an access barrier rather than merely a source of performance variation. We audit Qwen3 checkpoints on competition-mathematics tasks in eleven languages. Across the ten non-English languages, only 15.4-17.9% of problems receive a correct, terminating solution with visible reasoning in the requested language in any of 16 samples, compared with 92.9% in English. To identify the source of this disparity, we evaluate thirteen endpoints from one model family, spanning released checkpoints, multilingual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) at two scales, controlled SFT ablations, and three reinforcement-learning (RL) reward formulations. We jointly track correctness, language adherence, termination, and delivery efficiency. The dominant bottleneck shifts across post-training stages. Released models often reason in English. Multilingual SFT restores target-language reasoning, but accuracy declines across multilingual, English-only, and single-language SFT runs, showing that this cost is not specific to multilingual mixing; non-English reasoning traces additionally become prone to non-terminating loops. RL restores termination in both arms at no cost in accuracy, but only the arm whose reward includes a language term delivers: rewarding correctness alone returns the model to English. Together, these stages establish a constructive post-training path from English-pivoted capability to multilingual reasoning that is reliably delivered.

</details>


### [328] [Cross-Linguistic Effects in Bilingual Phoneme BabyLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37121)
*Nikitas Theodoropoulos,Maria Lymperaiou,Giorgos Filandrianos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文训练了以音素为输入的双语BabyLM（L2固定为英语，L1在德语、瑞典语、波斯语、巴斯克语间变化），发现音素输入下语法学习轨迹受L1影响比正字法输入更强，而早期词汇差异与音素库存相似性一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言效应是双语一语习得的核心议题。人工学习者可通过受控的语言组合与学习条件比较来研究L1-L2互动。现有双语语言模型工作受发展合理性约束，但与人类学习者存在根本差异，尤其体现在输入模态上：儿童主要从口语输入学习，而语言模型通常以正字法文本训练。为缩小这一差距，需结合音素输入。

Method: 将早期以音素表示训练模型的方向与双语BabyLM方向结合，训练以音素为输入的双语BabyLMs。固定英语为L2，L1分别取德语、瑞典语、波斯语、巴斯克语，这些语言在与英语的句法和音素库存距离上构成对比性组合。对比音素输入与正字法输入下的学习表现。

Result: 在音素输入下，语法学习轨迹呈现出比正字法输入更强的L1相关变异；早期词汇差异与音素库存相似性相一致。

Conclusion: 结合音素输入的双语BabyLM能更贴近儿童语言学习条件，揭示L1对L2学习的更强影响，表明输入模态是影响跨语言迁移模式的重要因素。

Abstract: Cross-linguistic effects are a central topic in bilingual first-language acquisition. Artificial learners can help investigate L1-L2 interactions by enabling controlled comparisons across language combinations and learning conditions. Recent work explores this direction by training bilingual language models under developmentally plausible constraints. However, human and model learners still diverge in fundamental ways, with one major difference being input modality: children learn primarily from spoken input, whereas language models are typically trained on orthographic text. To reduce this gap, researchers have trained models on phonemic representations of speech. In this work, we combine these research directions to train bilingual BabyLMs with phonemic input. We keep English fixed as the L2 and vary the L1 across German, Swedish, Persian, and Basque, selected to represent contrasting combinations of syntactic and phoneme-inventory distance from English. Our results show stronger L1-related variation in grammatical learning trajectories under phonemic than orthographic input, while early lexical differences align with phoneme-inventory similarity.

</details>


### [329] [LLM unbranding: Erasing Commercial Identity while Preserving Generic Utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37127)
*Kajetan Ożóg,Alicja Wojciechowska,Dawid Malarz,Paweł Batorski,Artur Kasymov,Przemysław Spurek*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM Unbranding新任务，定义并基准测试文本商标外观（trade dress）去除问题，并发布数据集与评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM频繁生成品牌描述，带来商标稀释、错误归属和品牌诽谤风险；相比视觉logo，文本中的trade dress（语言、口号、风格标记）更难识别和处理。

Method: 形式化定义LLM Unbranding任务，聚焦文本trade dress；构建覆盖多个商业领域知名品牌的评估数据集；评测现有SOTA机器遗忘模型；提出MUTE——一种推理时方法，通过迭代优化系统指令消除品牌泄漏，无需参数更新。

Result: 现有机器遗忘模型在选择性文本unbranding上存在明显局限；MUTE能有效中性化文本trade dress，同时保持LLM通用能力与效用。

Conclusion: LLM Unbranding是重要且新兴的挑战，MUTE提供了无需脆弱参数更新、可保留通用能力的有效解决方案，并公开数据集与代码。

Abstract: Establishing unbranding as a critical practice to prevent visual logos from acquiring negative connotations is standard in image generation. Large Language Models (LLMs) now face a parallel and emerging challenge. These models frequently generate brand descriptions within diverse contexts. This frequency introduces significant risks, such as trademark dilution, false attribution, and brand defamation. In response, we formally define the novel task of LLM Unbranding. We specifically address the complex challenge of managing trade dress within textual outputs. This involves neutralizing characteristic language, slogans, and stylistic markers that define brand identity. Crucially, these elements are less evident than explicit visual logos. To benchmark this task, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporating prominent brands from multiple commercial domains. We rigorously evaluate existing state-of-the-art machine unlearning models using this benchmark. This evaluation identifies their limitations in selective textual unbranding. Finally, we propose MUTE, a novel inference-time method that effectively neutralizes textual trade dress while preserving the LLM's general capabilities and utility. By leveraging an iterative refinement loop, MUTE systematically optimizes system instructions to safely eliminate brand leakage without requiring fragile parameter updates.
  Code and dataset: The evaluation dataset and code for LLM Unbranding are available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/LLM_unbranding. The implementation of MUTE is available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/MUTE.

</details>


### [330] [Bridging Semantic Gaps in RAG through Generated Context Knowledge Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37171)
*Xinkai Du,Chao Lv,Yalin Sun,Quanjie Han,Lei Yao,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出KASB框架，通过语义空间对齐缓解RAG中查询与检索上下文的不匹配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG虽结合了信息检索与大语言模型生成能力，但查询与检索上下文之间存在语义空间不匹配，限制了效果。

Method: 提出知识感知语义桥接（KASB），通过智能知识融合实现查询与文档的语义空间对齐，采用多阶段流程融合生成式与检索式知识，提升段落选择质量。

Result: 在三个主流开放域问答数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: KASB能提升检索段落的相关性与准确性，缓解语义空间不匹配问题。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation has established itself as a fundamental framework in natural language processing, seamlessly integrating information retrieval with the generative capabilities of large language models. However, this process is fundamentally constrained by a critical challenge: semantic space mismatch between queries and retrieved contexts. We propose Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging (KASB), a novel framework that improves passage selection quality through semantic space alignment between queries and retrieved documents through intelligent knowledge fusion. Our approach leverages the complementary strengths of generative and retrieval-based knowledge through a multistage process that enhances both relevance and accuracy. We evaluate KASB on three popular open-domain Question Answering datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [331] [VLM Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37175)
*Qingsong Yan,Xia Jiang,Yaoxin Wu,Wen Song,Lu Zhang,Yingjie Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种通用视觉-语言求解器，将文本实例描述与从输入导出的视觉表示结合，用单一VLM处理多种组合优化任务，并通过监督微调加验证器引导的强化学习训练，在多类问题上提升解质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的组合优化主要依赖文本序列化，可能丢失对生成有效解很重要的空间与关系结构，因此需要引入视觉信息弥补这一缺陷。

Method: 构建通用视觉-语言求解器：在文本实例描述基础上加入由输入导出的视觉表示；使用单一VLM跨不同CO任务；训练流程为监督微调后进行验证器引导的强化学习；视觉输入不含金标准解或解衍生信息。

Result: 实验表明，该VLM通常比纯文本基线提升解质量，在CVRP和JSSP等更复杂CO问题上增益尤其明显；且问题规模越大，视觉信息的优势越显著。

Conclusion: 视觉表示可作为文本序列化的有效补充，帮助通用VLM求解多种组合优化问题，并在复杂和大规模场景中带来更大收益。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have provided a unified interface for end-to-end combinatorial optimization (CO), but textual serialization alone may obscure spatial and relational structures that are important for generating effective CO solutions. This paper presents a general-purpose vision-language solver that augments textual instance descriptions with input-derived visual representations. A single vision-language model (VLM) is applied across different CO tasks and trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning. While the visual inputs contain no gold solutions or solution-derived information, our experiments show that the VLM generally improves solution quality over its text-only counterpart, with particularly clear gains on more complex CO problems such as CVRP and JSSP. The advantage of visual information is more pronounced at large problem scales.

</details>


### [332] [CredWise: A Controlled Agentic Decision-Intelligence Framework for Explainable and Auditable Credit-Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37223)
*Aakash Kumar Tiwari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 CredWise，一个集成信用风险预测、概率校准、可解释 AI、政策检索、SQL 分析和代理工作流的决策支持框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信用风险预测本身无法解释申请人为何有风险，也难以与其他证据结合，因此需要一站式决策支持。

Method: 基于 Lending Club 数据（1,345,310 笔贷款、18 个特征）训练 XGBoost，采用时间划分（2007–2016 训练、2017 验证、2018 测试），并加入概率校准、SHAP 解释、FAISS 政策检索、代理路由与 SQL 基准。

Result: 2018 测试集上 ROC-AUC 0.7109、PR-AUC 0.2993、F1 0.3714、准确率 65.44%；Brier 由 0.2157 降至 0.1273，ECE 由 0.2862 降至 0.0585；SHAP 排名跨年 Spearman 0.9959；FAISS Hit@1 0.929、MRR 0.964，检索 Hit@5=1.0；代理路由准确率 95.6%（43/45），SQL 六例三项指标均为 1.0。

Conclusion: CredWise 能将预测、解释、政策证据与结构化分析整合进受控工作流，属学术研究原型，最终决策仍由人工审核者负责。

Abstract: Credit-risk prediction is important in banking, but a prediction alone does not explain why an applicant is risky or how it should be combined with other evidence. This paper presents CredWise, a decision-support framework that integrates credit-risk prediction, probability calibration, explainable artificial intelligence, policy retrieval, SQL analytics, and controlled agent-based workflows. An XGBoost model is trained on Lending Club data (1,345,310 loans, 18 features) using a temporal split: 2007--2016 for training, 2017 for validation, and 2018 for testing. On the 2018 test set, the calibrated model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.7109, PR-AUC of 0.2993, F1-score of 0.3714, and accuracy of 65.44\%. Calibration reduced the Brier score from 0.2157 to 0.1273 and the expected calibration error from 0.2862 to 0.0585. SHAP explanations were temporally stable, with a Spearman correlation of 0.9959 between 2017 and 2018 feature rankings. On 28 labeled queries covering nine policy sections, FAISS achieved the best Hit@1 (0.929) and MRR (0.964), while all three retrieval methods reached Hit@5 = 1.0. Agent routing achieved 95.6\% accuracy (43 of 45 cases), and the SQL benchmark scored 1.0 on exact-match, execution-success, and result-match across six cases. These results show that CredWise can combine predictions, explanations, policy evidence, and structured analytics in one controlled workflow. It is an academic research prototype, and final decisions remain with a human reviewer.

</details>


### [333] [SemOPT: Fixing Semantic Errors in LLM-based Optimization Modeling via Reward-Guided Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37361)
*Zetong Zhou,Wentao Zhang,Jingyuan Wang,Yifan Yang,Zizhuo Wang,Shixi Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SemOPT，用语义奖励模型+分层奖励引导搜索，纠正LLM优化建模中的语义错误，在7个基准上平均提升7.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM自动将自然语言问题转为求解器代码时易出错；语义错误不引发运行失败但违反原问题意图，难检测与纠正。

Method: SemOPT = 语义奖励模型（区分忠实的数学模型与貌似合理但错误的模型）+ 自适应纠错系统，在建模空间做分层奖励引导搜索。

Result: 在7个优化建模基准上达到新SOTA，复杂数据集上比最强基线平均提升7.6%准确率。

Conclusion: 语义引导框架能有效检测并纠正LLM优化建模的语义错误，显著提升建模准确性。

Abstract: Operations research supports decision-making in domains such as energy, economics, and healthcare. Solving operations research problems typically begins with optimization modeling, which translates a natural-language problem description into executable solver code. LLMs offer a promising way to automate this process, but they remain prone to errors. In practice, these errors can be divided into two categories: syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver; semantic errors refer to solver code that successfully returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem. Since semantic errors do not trigger runtime failures, they are difficult to detect and rectify. To address this problem, we introduce SemOPT, a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT combines a semantic reward model that distinguishes faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones with an adaptive correction system that applies hierarchical reward-guided search over the modeling space. Experiments on seven optimization modeling benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art and achieves an average 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.

</details>


### [334] [Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37371)
*Rebecca Ramnauth,Brian Scassellati*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"适应编译"（adaptation compilation），将模型适应的位置、方式和程度重构为联合预测与决策问题，通过学习先前适应经验来预测候选程序的向量值反事实响应面，从而在适应前选择程序，实现适应搜索的摊销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模型适应遵循固定配方，但不同更新程序会产生显著不同的行为结果。为了避免对每个学习任务重新搜索候选程序，作者希望利用先前的适应经验为新任务决策如何适应，将适应搜索跨相关学习问题摊销。

Method: 引入adaptation compilation：编译器不针对每个学习片段重新搜索候选程序，而是从先前适应中学习，预测候选程序的向量值反事实响应面（其在获取、迁移、有界性和保持性上的预期效果），并在适应开始前选择程序。该预测几何捕捉多种行为后果而非单一标量分数，因此可在不同下游优先级下复用而无需重新训练。

Result: 在五种学习类型中，偏好的程序在各片段间差异显著，且这种差异可由适应前信息预测。在Llama-3.1-8B上，编译器选择的程序接近穷举搜索，并优于全局和特定目标默认值。在Gemma-2-9B上的复现保留了程序异质性和选择空间，但表明要利用这一空间，在偏离强默认值时需考虑不确定性。

Conclusion: 适应搜索可跨相关学习问题摊销，将先前的适应经验转化为决定未来学习应如何进行的基础。

Abstract: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation---and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.

</details>


### [335] [Look What You Made Us Cluster: Hate Narrative Extraction from Reddit Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37408)
*Annabelle K. L. Chua,Forster J. Khoo,Joel C. R. Tan,Huey Ting Ang,Kheng Hwee Tan,Joel Y. A. Sim,Shirley W. H. Ow,Ria Mundhra,Elsie C. K. Toh,Youfeng Xu,Lynnette H. X. Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将叙事表示为"实体-评价对"的抽取流水线，利用LLM推理扩展方面级情感分析并聚类，以提高网络仇恨叙事识别的精确性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算方法依赖语义表示，往往只能捕捉表层含义，导致仇恨叙事抽取的精度有限，缺乏精确性和可解释性。

Method: 采用LLM推理过程扩展方面级情感分析（ABSA），识别方面、判定其评判类型作为评价依据，并据此推导评价，从而将叙事表示为实体-评价对；随后用Leiden算法对抽取的叙事进行聚类，并通过LLM引导的细化过程将聚类解析到目标粒度。

Result: 以2024年英文Reddit上批评Taylor Swift的评论为案例验证流水线，分析了一个具有仇恨言论模式的代表性聚类，展示了其解释价值。

Conclusion: 将叙事表示为实体-评价对并结合LLM推理与聚类细化，能够实现更精确、更具可解释性的在线仇恨叙事抽取，为构建严谨的检测系统提供支持。

Abstract: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity-evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analyzing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.

</details>


### [336] [Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37443)
*Yi-Xuan Deng,Yi Zhang,Wei Liu,Chao Xue,Shuojin Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出MERA框架，将全局可搜索记忆与问题特定证据状态分离，用证据发现引导后续检索，并通过强化学习训练轻量规划器，显著提升长对话记忆任务的答案准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆使语言模型能利用过去交互，但回答所需证据常分散在远距离对话轮次中，且问题本身缺少定位线索。检索到的事实可揭示这些线索，因此需要基于已发现证据来条件化检索决策。

Method: MERA将全局可搜索记忆与问题特定证据状态分离；已验证证据引导后续检索但不限制全局记忆访问。通过强化学习训练轻量规划器（0.6B），奖励能找回此前缺失证据的查询。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B和GPT-4o-mini上均获高准确率。使用Qwen3-30B处理证据与生成答案时，0.6B规划器在LoCoMo达77.40%、LongMemEval-S达71.29%，分别超过无检索训练30B规划器4.10%和3.96%。LoCoMo上后续检索轮将累积证据召回率从55.5%提升至80.5%。

Conclusion: 基于证据状态的迭代检索与强化学习规划能有效解决远距离证据定位问题，小规模规划器可超越大规模基线，显著提升长对话记忆问答性能。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified evidence guides subsequent retrieval without restricting access to the global memory. We train a lightweight planner through reinforcement learning, rewarding queries that recover previously missing evidence. MERA achieves strong answer accuracy across Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini backbones. With Qwen3-30B for evidence processing and answer generation, the trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%, respectively. On LoCoMo, later retrieval rounds increase cumulative evidence recall from 55.5% to 80.5%.

</details>


### [337] [Regime Boundary Alignment for Evidence-Gated Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37491)
*Zeyan Li,Qirong Guo,SIyuan Qiu,Hu Xu,Chun Li,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA)，通过在同一问题-答案的配对变体上训练单一 reader，使其在证据支持时作答、证据缺失时拒答，从而解决检索增强模型在无证据时仍强行作答的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG 模型本应基于检索到的证据作答，但实践中即使证据缺失仍会继续作答（unsupported answering）。作者将此归因于训练信号：以答案为中心的微调对无支持上下文不设目标，无法区分"拒答的 reader"与"猜测的 reader"，导致无支持作答率接近 100%，且即使在支持准确率提升时依然如此。

Method: 提出 Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA)，在相同问题与金答案的匹配变体上训练单一 reader：当上下文支持答案时（包括存在冲突证据时）输出金答案，当正确支持被移除时则拒答。推理为普通解码，无需验证器、阈值或 regime 标签。

Result: 在三个多跳 QA 数据集、三个随机种子上，RBA 相比 conflict-focused training 将无支持作答率降低超过 60 个百分点，同时支持准确率相当。在留出的 TriviaQA 检索缺失切片上，同一 reader 将无支持作答从 100% 降至 1% 以下，并提升支持准确率。

Conclusion: 结果表明，证据门控式作答必须在支持边界的"两侧"都进行学习才能实现，即同时在有支持与无支持的情形上训练模型。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models are expected to answer from the retrieved evidence, but in practice they often keep answering when that evidence is missing. We trace this behavior to the training signal: answer-focused fine-tuning assigns no target to unsupported contexts, so it cannot distinguish a reader that abstains from one that guesses, and unsupported answering stays near 100% even as supported accuracy improves. We introduce Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA), which trains a single reader on matched variants of the same question and gold answer. The reader is trained to produce the gold answer when the context supports it, including when conflicting evidence is also present, and to abstain when the correct support is removed; inference is ordinary decoding, with no verifier, threshold, or regime label. On three multi-hop QA datasets across three seeds, RBA reduces the unsupported-answer rate by more than sixty percentage points relative to conflict-focused training while matching its supported accuracy. On a held-out TriviaQA retrieval-miss slice, the same reader reduces unsupported answering from 100% to below 1% while also improving supported accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-gated answering must be learned on both sides of the support boundary.

</details>


### [338] [Your Benchmark Is Not Saturated: Reviving Multiple-Choice Evaluation with Answer Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37494)
*Mohamed Eltahir,Abobaker Ahmed,Nawaf Barebood,Hussain Bu Subayt,Tanveer Hussain,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 AnswerPool：将共享上下文的 N 道多选题的所有选项混合成一个选项池，要求模型为每题指派答案，在不新增题目/标签下提升难度，并可在同一轮评估弃答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多选题基准评分便宜但容易饱和，传统办法是不断写更难的题，成本高且需对每个基准重复进行。饱和基准中仍含更难任务：由于每题的错误选项是为该题单独设计的，模型可通过排除少数选项来得分，说明格式给予了“排除法红利”。

Method: AnswerPool：取 N 个共享上下文的题目，将其全部选项汇集为一个列表，让模型为每个问题分配答案；不写新题、不改标签；同时在池中删除答案以制造不可答题，并以精确真值在同一轮中评估弃答。

Result: 五道四选项题整组猜对概率从 10^-3 降至 5×10^-7。跨 8 个文本/图像/视频基准、18 个模型，池化对所有模型都更难；排除法红利对最弱模型最大；8 个开源权重模型中有 7 个会对 87%–100% 的不可答题给出答案。

Conclusion: AnswerPool 通过选项池化提高多选基准难度并量化“排除法红利”；能识别自身答案的模型可保持原多选分数，而准确率损失即格式带来的排除收益；同时揭示模型在不可答题上严重缺乏弃答能力。

Abstract: Multiple-choice benchmarks are cheap to grade and are running out of room, and the standard remedy, writing harder items, is slow and repeated for every benchmark. A saturated benchmark still holds a harder task. Each question's wrong options are written for that question alone, so a model can score by eliminating a few options. We propose AnswerPool: take $N$ questions that share a context, pool all their options into one list, and ask the model to assign every question its answer. No item is written and no label changes. The chance of guessing a group right falls from $10^{-3}$ to $5\times10^{-7}$ for five four-option questions, and a model that recognizes its answers keeps its multiple-choice score, so the accuracy lost to pooling measures the credit the format gave for elimination. Deleting answers from the pool makes questions unanswerable with exact ground truth, so abstention is scored in the same pass. Across eight text, image, and video benchmarks and eighteen models, pooling is harder for every model, the elimination credit is largest for the weakest models, and seven of eight open-weight models answer 87 to 100% of unanswerable questions.

</details>


### [339] [Larry Caused the Car to Stop, But the Model Didn't Notice: Transformer Blindness to the M-Heuristic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37497)
*Stefania Butnaru,Claudiu Creanga*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究编码器Transformer（DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART）是否在默认NLI任务中运用M-Heuristic（标记形式暗示标记含义），结果表明它们并未捕捉词汇使役与迂说使役的语用区别，仅在显式元语言提示下（Gemini）才可用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代Transformer在语义关系建模上表现出色，但其语用推理能力仍缺乏研究，尤其是编码器模型是否遵循新格莱斯M-Heuristic这一语用原则尚未明确。

Method: 通过在自然语言推理框架下对比词汇使役（如"Larry stopped the car"）与迂说使役（如"Larry caused the car to stop"），在15个可变及物动词、188种条件下测试DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART；并进行探测分析与控制实验，以及30组三元组的语义相似度分析，最后在显式元语言框架下测试Gemini Flash-Lite。

Result: DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART均未捕捉到该语用区别，DeBERTa在100%情况下预测为"Neutral"；探测分析最初看似存在表征-使用分离，但控制实验发现其跟踪的是句法复杂度而非使役语用；语义相似度显示30组中有29组迂说使役更接近无中介方式描述，与M-Heuristic预测相反；Gemini Flash-Lite在显式元语言框架下达到100%准确并给出具体条目线索。

Conclusion: M-Heuristic原则在受指令情况下可用，但在默认NLI中未被使用；编码器Transformer的语用推理能力具有局限性，探测结果可能被句法复杂度混淆。

Abstract: Modern transformer models excel at capturing semantic relationships through sentence embeddings, yet their ability to perform pragmatic reasoning remains understudied.
