Abstract: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence. We introduce TOCOMAS, a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System. TOCOMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. During online self-evolution, TOCOMAS proposes coupled changes to agent, collaboration, and memory policies, retaining for subsequent tasks only candidates that satisfy structural constraints and improve evaluated reward. Across BBEH, WorkBench, SWE-Bench-Verified, and CoMemBench, TOCOMAS improves task success over baselines across backbones. CoMemBench also shows gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified progress, handoffs, and memory isolation.

</details>


### [587] [BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37956)
*Xiwei Zeng,Shengrong Li,Yiheng Liu,Chunwei Tian,Daoqiang Zhang,Qi Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BrainNet Studio 是一个集成化工具包，支持静态与动态脑网络分析，涵盖网络构建、特征提取、预测建模、生物标志物识别、可视化与大模型辅助解读，整合27种算法并可公开获取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统脑网络工具多聚焦静态连接组，难以充分表征时变拓扑与高阶时空依赖，且缺乏将动态网络建模与现代图学习、序列学习方法整合的一体化流程。

Method: 提供统一工作流，整合27种算法（含深度学习、图神经网络、时空序列模型），并引入大语言模型生成可验证的功能连接、结构连接及结构-功能耦合摘要。

Result: 用户可在一致的计算框架内配置分析任务、比较方法、检查输出并扩展功能，无需反复搭建特定应用流程。

Conclusion: BrainNet Studio 为认知神经科学、脑疾病探索性研究和脑机接口提供了实用且可扩展的连接组分析平台，代码已公开。

Abstract: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. The toolkit integrates 27 algorithms, including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models, to support classification and the identification of discriminative brain regions and connections. A large language model generates researcher-verifiable summaries of functional connectivity, structural connectivity, and structure-function coupling at individual and group levels. Within a consistent computational framework, users can configure analytical tasks, compare methods, inspect outputs, and extend functionality without repeatedly assembling application-specific pipelines. BrainNet Studio provides a practical and extensible platform for connectome analysis in cognitive neuroscience, exploratory studies of brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio.

</details>


### [588] [SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37968)
*Jungwoo Yang,In Jin Kong,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SelfSearch：无需奖励信号的自改进搜索，利用历史自我修改记录让LLM agent自我改进，提升任务成功率并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent具备修改自身指令、工具和执行流程的能力，但现有方法依赖下游重复评估来搜索改进，成本高且与所评估任务强绑定。

Method: 提出SelfSearch，一种无奖励搜索过程：agent利用先前自我改进回合的记录（包含推理、工具动作与结果）来修改自身，为任务求解和自我修改提供具体经验。

Result: 在六个模型-基准设置中，总体平均成功率均优于初始agent；Terminal-Bench 2.1上单个agent最高提升11.2个百分点；SWE-bench Multilingual上成功率提升5.0个百分点，同时执行成本降低38.5%。仅花$4.03搜索成本，即在公开九框架对比设定下用DeepSeek V4 Flash解决82.0%的Terminal-Bench 2.1任务，与最高分框架Codex持平。

Conclusion: 通过自我修改获得的经验可提升agent的下游能力与效率，且在更低搜索成本下达到与评估引导基线相当的竞争性表现。

Abstract: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce \textbf{SelfSearch}, a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model--benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by \textbf{5.0} percentage points while reducing execution cost by \textbf{38.5}\% on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only \textbf{\$4.03} in search cost, it produces a harness that solves \textbf{82.0}\% of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents' downstream capabilities and efficiency.

</details>


### [589] [KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37988)
*Joao Monteiro,Louis Béthune,Anastasiia Filippova,Sonia Laguna,David Grangier,Marco Cuturi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出KV-Kaizen，通过学习一个选择器，在不驱逐token的前提下沿深度、精度、秩三个维度自适应的为每层生成缓存配置，实现KV cache压缩，保持准确率的同时大幅节省内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM上下文增长，KV cache可超过模型权重内存，而解码是memory-bound的，缓存越大解码越慢。现有工作通过丢弃最不相关token来缓解，但一次性驱逐决策可能对后续有害，因此需要一种不驱逐token即可压缩缓存的方法。

Method: 训练一个选择器(selector)，在推理时于pre-fill前只运行一次，根据上下文为每层自适应生成缓存配置。选择器沿三个轴操作：跨层共享同一cache(深度)、以更少比特缓存(精度)、截断低秩latent缓存表示(秩)。关键是将这些干预局部且自适应地组合，而非独立且均匀地应用于所有层。

Result: 在指令跟随和推理任务上，选择器在准确率-cache大小的帕累托前沿上优于无学习和post-hoc基线。在长上下文任务上优于驱逐方法并可与之组合，14B模型上达到32x更小的解码缓存且保持准确率。4x缓存缩减下7B以上参数无准确率损失，且压缩模型比同缓存大小的更小未压缩模型更准确。

Conclusion: 结果支持先训练大模型，之后再对其进行压缩的思路。提出了一种不驱逐token的自适应KV cache压缩范式。

Abstract: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cache compression without evicting tokens. We achieve this by learning a selector that is able to produce, based on context, a per-layer cache configuration towards an overall compression budget. The selector operates along three axes: sharing one cache across layers (depth), caching at fewer bits (precision), or truncating the low-rank latent cache representations (rank). We call the resulting method KV-Kaizen, for the many small per-layer choices it compounds. We observe that these interventions taken independently and uniformly over all layers limit achievable compression because they degrade accuracy. Crucially, composing them locally and adaptively to the context can instead preserve accuracy while achieving large memory savings. At inference, the selector runs once, before pre-fill. In evaluations on instruction following and reasoning tasks, our selectors reach the Pareto frontier of accuracy against cache size, against learning-free and post-hoc baselines. On long-context tasks, KV-Kaizen improves on eviction and can be composed with it, reaching a 32x smaller decode-time cache on a 14B model while preserving accuracy. A 4x cache size reduction incurs no accuracy degradation from 7B parameters up, and a compressed model is more accurate than a smaller uncompressed one with the same cache size. Together, these findings support pre-training large models and compressing them only afterwards.

</details>


### [590] [Which Attention Heads are like the Human Head? Not the Ones that Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37991)
*Christopher Pinier,Gustaw Opiełka,Hannes Rosenbusch,Taylor Webb,Michael D. Nunez,Claire E. Stevenson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文发现在抽象模式补全任务中，LLM注意力头与大脑的对齐同其因果贡献相分离：脑对齐头虽参与任务但对性能影响有限，而功能向量选择的头在消融时更具破坏性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑-AI对齐常被解读为模型与大脑执行相似计算，但对齐单元是否真正因果参与模型计算很少被检验。作者旨在区分对齐与因果性，厘清二者关系。

Method: 在抽象模式补全任务(AAABAAA→B)上，比较LLM注意力头表示与人类EEG；通过消融脑对齐头并对比归因补丁选出的头，考察性能影响；对比概念向量(CV)与功能向量(FV)两种头集合；在17个3B-72B模型上重复验证。

Result: 对齐与因果分离：脑对齐头对性能有贡献，但移除破坏性远小于归因补丁所选头。脑对齐与FV分数关联弱，与CV分数关联随模型变化。发现两类脑对齐头：新颖性头与重复性头。新颖性头追踪显著性并注视人类所看元素，但移除平均不如随机消融有害；重复性头贡献适中且与CV相关。FV排序移除的破坏性显著大于脑排序移除。

Conclusion: 脑对齐主要捕捉模型如何读取刺激，仅微弱反映其如何表征模式并解决任务。

Abstract: Brain-AI alignment is often interpreted as a sign that model and brain perform similar computations. Whether the aligned units are causally involved in model computation is rarely checked. On an abstract pattern-completion task (AAABAAA $\rightarrow$ B), we compare LLM attention-head representations with human EEG and test how ablating those heads affects task performance. Alignment and causation dissociate: brain-aligned heads contribute to performance, but their removal is substantially less disruptive than removal of heads selected via attribution patching. We compare two head sets that prior interpretability work defines without reference to the brain: concept vectors (CVs), which represent abstract patterns across formats, and function vectors (FVs), selected for their contribution to correct-answer prediction. Brain alignment shows little association with FV scores, while its association with CV scores varies across models. Among brain-aligned heads, we find recurring attention profiles: one emphasizes distinctive elements (novelty heads), the other repeating elements (repetition heads). The novelty family tracks salience and attends to the same elements that humans look at, yet its removal is less damaging than random ablation on average. Repetition heads contribute modestly to performance and are associated with abstract-pattern representation (CVs). Across 17 models spanning 3B-72B parameters, FV-ranked removal is substantially more disruptive than brain-ranked removal. Brain alignment thus captures how the model reads the stimulus, and only faintly captures how it represents the pattern and solves the task.

</details>


### [591] [Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38005)
*Huaman Sun,Dingcheng Wang,Jason Hartline,Jessica Hullman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个决策论框架，将大语言模型（LLM）在概率推理中的决策损失分解为"信念形成"和"信念到行动转化"两个部分，并系统评估了针对这两部分（或两者联合）的强化学习干预效果及其迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多被用作决策助手，需要在明确的决策成本下基于证据进行概率推理。然而，现有研究缺乏对LLM决策能力中"信念形成"与"最优行动选择"两个环节的清晰区分与诊断。

Method: 提出一个决策论框架，将决策损失分解为两部分：从证据形成准确信念、以及将信念转化为最大化给定效用函数的行动。使用具有已知真实标签的合成基准，对前沿模型与开源模型进行分解分析；并评估针对信念、决策或两者的RL干预，检验其跨组件、跨引出格式的迁移性，以及决策性能能否在信念不提升的情况下改善。

Result: 针对概率推理中某一组件的干预会使决策损失发生再分配，能提升目标组件但未必迁移到其他组件；联合针对信念形成与决策制定可同时提升两者，但依赖于训练与评估格式的匹配。

Conclusion: LLM的概率推理能力可被有效分解诊断，但各组件间未必自动迁移，联合优化需注意训练与评估格式的一致性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. We further evaluate whether RL interventions targeting beliefs, decisions, or both improve these components across three domains, whether improvements transfer across components and elicitation formats, and whether decision performance can improve without improvement in belief formation. We find that targeting one component of probabilistic reasoning redistributes decision loss, improving the target without necessarily transferring to others, and that jointly targeting belief formation and decision-making improves both but hinges on matched formats between training and evaluation.

</details>


### [592] [HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38006)
*Kenan Alkiek,Moontae Lee,David Jurgens,V. G. Vinod Vydiswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HARISSA 利用模型自身隐藏状态，让预填充状态预测能否答对、答案状态预测答案是否正确，从而在一个策略中决定是否加算力与是否转人工，实现本地部署的效率与安全兼顾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地运行语言模型在隐私、延迟和成本上有优势，但本地硬件只能容纳能力较弱的小模型。将困难查询升级到云端模型会丧失隐私与成本优势；而留在本地则面临两个决策：哪些查询值得花更多算力（效率），以及哪些答案足够安全可交付、否则应转交人工（安全）。

Method: HARISSA 对模型进行微调，使其预填充状态（生成任何 token 前计算）预测模型是否会答对，其答案状态（生成答案结束时）预测该答案是否正确；随后用一个策略在两个状态上做两个决策，按从最便宜到最昂贵的解答方式级联，跳过预填充状态预测会失败的方式，并在最终停下时的答案被预测为错误时转交查询。

Result: 在单模型设备上，HARISSA 与思维链（CoT）的精度差距在 1 个百分点内，延迟低 2.7 倍；在容纳同一模型四个规模的服务器上，同延迟下比 FrugalGPT 和 Self-REF 级联更准确，且在同转交率下，答案状态在六组任务与设置中的五组里比标准置信信号产生更少的错误答案。

Conclusion: 模型自身的隐藏状态足以支撑效率与安全两类决策，HARISSA 无需依赖云端升级即可在本地部署中实现接近更强方法的精度，并兼具低延迟与更可靠的交付判断。

Abstract: Running a language model locally offers advantages in privacy, latency, and cost, but local hardware fits only small models, which are less capable than frontier models. The usual remedy for a hard query, escalating it to a cloud model, gives up the privacy and cost advantages of running locally. A deployment that stays local faces two decisions for hard queries instead. First, it can spend more computation on a query, e.g., reasoning before answering, which raises accuracy at a cost in latency, so it must decide which queries are worth the extra computation (efficiency). Second, some queries are beyond the local model, and delivering a wrong answer is worse than deferring the query to a human in the loop, so it must decide which answers are safe to deliver (safety). We show that both decisions can be made from the model's own hidden states. The prefill state, computed before any token is generated, predicts whether the model will answer correctly, and the answer state, at the end of the generated answer, predicts whether that answer is correct. HARISSA fine-tunes the model so that both states predict correctness, then makes both decisions with one policy that cascades through the ways of answering from cheapest to most expensive, skipping a way the prefill state predicts will fail and deferring the query when the answer it stops with is predicted wrong. On a device running a single model, HARISSA is within one accuracy point of chain-of-thought at 2.7 times lower latency. On a server holding four sizes of one model, HARISSA is more accurate than the FrugalGPT and Self-REF cascades at the same latency, and at the same deferral rate the answer state leaves fewer wrong answers than the standard confidence signals in five of six task and setting pairs.

</details>


### [593] [PE-EK-PINN: Physics Embedding with Evolving Kernel for Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38023)
*Huiwen Zhang,Feng Ye,Chu Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PE-EK-PINN，将物理核视为可复用学习表示，通过冻结子系统场并升级为"进化核"，实现分层表示，使活跃核数量与系统规模无关，训练成本从O(N)降至O(log N)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PINN仅通过损失残差约束控制方程，对高振荡波行为依赖优化发现，在涉及奇异激励、吸收边界和数十波长波场的实际辐射问题上表现不佳。架构物理嵌入虽通过解析振荡核与可学习包络分解改进，但核字典需手工构建且随基元数量指数增长。

Method: PE-EK-PINN将物理核作为可复用学习表示而非固定解析输入：冻结已收敛的子系统场，将其提升为进化核，通过变换其副本表示更高层配置，无需推导新控制方程，构建分层结构。

Result: 在偶极子阵列、复合线源几何和交叉阵列实验中，训练成本大幅降低，相对L2误差减少或相当；256偶极子阵列求解比直接PE-PINN快30倍以上。

Conclusion: 该方法使峰值活跃核数量独立于系统规模，将累积训练成本从O(N)降至O(log N)，有效解决复杂辐射问题中的振荡波建模挑战。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) embed governing equations into deep learning, but enforce them only through loss residuals, leaving highly oscillatory wave behavior to be discovered by optimization. As a result, methods that achieve relative $L_2$ errors below $10^{-3}$ on standard manufactured Helmholtz benchmarks can fail on practical radiation problems involving singular excitations, absorbing boundaries, and wave fields spanning tens of wavelengths. Architectural physics embedding addresses this limitation by factorizing the field into analytically derived oscillatory kernels and learnable envelopes. However, the kernel dictionary must be manually constructed and scales with the number of elementary units, growing exponentially with the depth of hierarchically structured systems such as antenna arrays and metasurfaces. We propose PE-EK-PINN (Physics Embedded with Evolving Kernels), which treats physics kernels as reusable learned representations rather than fixed analytical inputs. A converged subsystem field is frozen and promoted to an evolved kernel, whose transformed copies are reused to represent higher-level configurations without deriving new governing equations. The resulting hierarchy makes the peak number of active kernels independent of system size and reduces cumulative training cost from $O(N)$ to $O(\log N)$. Experiments on dipole arrays, composite line-source geometries, and cross arrays demonstrate the dramatic training cost reduction, while achieving a reduced or comparable relative $L_2$ error. One notable example is PE-EK-PINN solves a $256$-dipole array more than 30 times faster than direct PE-PINN.

</details>


### [594] [Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38024)
*Jaewon Chu,Ji Soo Lee,Jihwan Park,Dohwan Ko,Jeehye Na,Seunghun Lee,Taehoon Lee,Minseo Yoon,Minseok Joo,Yunyang Xiong,Hyunwoo J. Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出RASO框架，利用外部技能语料库作为先验知识来优化智能体技能，通过检索增强初始化与更新两阶段，在四个基准、两个模型上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能优化方法忽视了公开共享的海量技能知识，仅依赖昂贵的智能体rollout迭代优化，成本高且未利用积累知识。

Method: RASO检索现有技能知识，并通过Cross-Harness Adaptation适配目标任务的领域与harness差异。包含两阶段：RASI无需rollout构建知识奠基的初始技能；RASU在执行反馈引导下迭代检索外部知识以精炼技能。

Result: 在四个智能体基准和两个模型上，RASO一致优于无检索增强初始化与更新的基线方法。

Conclusion: 利用外部技能语料库作为先验可有效且一致地提升技能优化效果，减少对昂贵rollout的依赖。

Abstract: An agent skill is a reusable, actionable natural-language artifact that guides an agent to perform a task effectively under a given harness. Recent studies have explored the optimization of agent skills, contributing to a growing collection of publicly available skills spanning diverse tasks, domains, and harnesses. Despite millions of publicly shared skills, existing skill optimization methods largely overlook this accumulated knowledge, instead relying solely on expensive agent rollouts to iteratively refine skills for a target task. To address this, we propose \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization (RASO)}, a framework that leverages an external skill corpus as prior knowledge throughout skill optimization. RASO retrieves relevant knowledge from existing skills and adapts it to the target task and harness via Cross-Harness Adaptation, accounting for mismatches in both domain and harness. RASO comprises two complementary stages: \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Initialization (RASI)} constructs a knowledge-grounded initial skill without requiring agent rollouts, while \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Update (RASU)} iteratively refines the skill by retrieving external knowledge guided by execution feedback. Across four agent benchmarks and two models, extensive experiments show that RASO consistently outperforms baselines without retrieval-augmented skill initialization and updating.

</details>


### [595] [UserProxyBench: Evaluating LLM User Simulators for Agent Benchmarks and Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38043)
*Ashish Jain,Armaan Sandhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 UserProxyBench 评估层与 User Fidelity Score (UFS)，用于衡量多轮交互基准中"用户代理"（模拟用户）是否遵守其私有指令，独立于 agent 的成功率。实验表明不同用户代理会使任务奖励波动 15.2 分，且成功回合中 24.4% 存在用户规格违反，主要失败模式为过早披露信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式 agent 基准与多轮强化学习常引入第二个语言模型充当"用户"，它控制 agent 获取信息的内容与时机。然而现有基准只对 agent 打分，并不直接衡量该模拟用户是否正确履行了被分配的角色，导致评估存在盲区。

Method: 构建 UserProxyBench 作为 tau-bench 系列之上的评估层，并提出 User Fidelity Score (UFS)：基于任务私有用户指令、采用与任务挂钩的评分标准（rubric）来独立评估用户代理的合规性，不受 agent 成败影响。在 375 个企业任务中固定 agent 为 GPT-5.5，仅更换用户代理。

Result: 仅更换用户代理即可使平均任务奖励变化 15.2 分；24.4% 的成功回合存在用户规格违反。主要失败模式是"过早披露"——用户在信息被请求前就提供信息。该行为对任务奖励影响很小，但在成功回合中使 agent 平均少调用 1.06 次工具，从而改变了被评估的交互过程却保持奖励不变。此外，在 7 个代理上识别出经验性的"成本—保真度前沿"。

Conclusion: 用户代理的保真度是当前基准中被忽视却影响显著的因素，UFS 与成本—保真度前沿为实践者选择满足所需保真度的最低成本模拟器提供依据。

Abstract: Interactive agent benchmarks and multi-turn reinforcement learning increasingly place a second language model in the role of the user. This simulated user controls what information the agent receives and when, yet current benchmarks score only the agent and do not directly measure whether the user correctly executed its assigned role. We introduce UserProxyBench, an evaluation layer over the tau-bench family, and the User Fidelity Score (UFS), which measures adherence to the benchmark's private user instructions using task-grounded rubric criteria scored independently of agent success. Holding the agent fixed at GPT-5.5 and varying only the user proxy across 375 enterprise tasks changes mean task reward by 15.2 points, while 24.4% of successful episodes contain a user-specification violation. The dominant failure is premature disclosure: users provide information before it is requested. This behavior has little effect on task reward, yet among successful episodes it causes the agent to make 1.06 fewer tool calls on average, changing the interaction being evaluated while preserving the reward. Finally, across seven proxies we identify an empirical cost-fidelity frontier, enabling practitioners to select the least expensive simulator that satisfies a required fidelity level.

</details>


### [596] [Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38070)
*Feiyang Li,Shengjing Liu,Qi Zhan,Sijie Cheng,Weiqing Wang,Hongwen Chen,Yuxuan Yang,Wen Wang,Yile Wang,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DTC框架，用两个模型解码时分歧token计数来估计LLM推理置信度，校准效果优于概率与口述基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理链能力增强，需评估与校准其推理置信度以量化答案不确定性，但现有基于关键token概率的方法机制不清，且简单替代也可提升校准，促使探索更有效的置信信号。

Method: DTC：沿同一推理轨迹对比两个模型的下一个token分布，用Jensen-Shannon散度识别强分歧token，统计其数量作为置信度信号；支持白盒与黑盒（辅以辅助模型）评估，无需训练、不干扰生成。

Result: 多模型家族与六个数学基准上校准优于概率类与口述类基线；白盒下纯计数估计器平均ECE 13.0%，标准全序列置信方法为32.7%-42.4%；黑盒下DeepSeek-V3.2平均ECE从32.1%-40.2%降至13.7%-16.3%。

Conclusion: 分歧token数量与答案准确率几乎负相关，是简单有效的置信信号，为LLM推理不确定性量化提供新思路。

Abstract: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also improve calibration, motivating us to further explore effective signals of model confidence. We introduce Divergent Token Confidence (DTC), a framework that estimates confidence by counting tokens at which two models strongly disagree during decoding. DTC identifies these divergent tokens using the Jensen-Shannon divergence between next-token distributions evaluated along the same reasoning trajectory. We find that their count is almost negatively associated with answer accuracy, thereby serving as a simple yet effective signal for uncertainty quantification. DTC supports both white-box and black-box evaluation using auxiliary models, without explicit training and affecting the generation process. Experiments across multiple model families and six mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved calibration over probability-based and verbalized baselines. Under white-box evaluation, the count-only estimator achieves an average expected calibration error of 13.0%, compared with 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods. In black-box settings, it also improves calibration over the original verbalized scores. For example, mean expected calibration error falls from 32.1%-40.2% to 13.7%-16.3% on DeepSeek-V3.2. These findings provide new insights for improving reasoning uncertainty quantification in large language models. The code is released at https://github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git.

</details>


### [597] [Character Training for Risk-Averse Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38093)
*Arav Dhoot,Punya Syon Pandey,Jamie Johnson,Daniel Tan,Elliott Thornley,David Demitri Africa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过"角色训练"(character training)向AI智能体灌输风险厌恶偏好，采用基于在策略蒸馏的模型宪法方法，证明该机制可有效减少错位智能体的灾难性行为风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 错位(misaligned)的AI智能体可能造成灾难性危害，但若智能体具有风险厌恶，会更倾向选择与人类达成交易等安全策略，而非叛乱等高风险策略。因此需要找到有效机制来培养智能体的风险厌恶。

Method: 构建描述智能体资源上恒定绝对风险厌恶(CARA)的模型宪法，通过on-policy distillation(在策略蒸馏)将其灌输给模型，实现角色训练。并调整宪法的不同方面(如token预算、模型选择)进行分析。

Result: 尽管训练时从未见过基准的决策格式，角色训练模型仍能与直接在该基准上训练的基线竞争，且在四个模型中的两个上分布外泛化更好。token预算和模型选择是影响风险厌恶灌输效果最显著的因素。

Conclusion: 角色训练是一种有前景且可扩展的灌输广泛性情(dispositions)的方法，可用于缓解错位AI智能体带来的风险。

Abstract: Risk aversion in resources could prevent misaligned AI agents from causing catastrophic harm. Misaligned but risk-averse agents would tend to favor safer strategies like making deals with humans over riskier strategies like rebelling. We train agents to be risk averse through character training, finding that persona traits provide a robust mechanism for instilling risk preferences. To do this, we construct a model constitution describing constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) over an agent's resources and instill it through on-policy distillation. Despite never seeing the benchmark's decision format during training, character-trained models are competitive with baselines trained directly on it, and generalise better than them out of distribution on two of our four models. We also modulate different aspects of the constitution, finding that token budget and model choice are the most influential aspect of character training to instill risk aversion. We conclude from these results that character training is a promising and scalable way to instil broad dispositions, which we can use to our advantage in mitigating risk from misaligned AI agents.

</details>


### [598] [NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38098)
*Ruiyu Yan,Bowen Chen,Shaowen Wan,Lin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: NeuronEye是一个即插即用框架，从VLM中间表示构建稀疏概念级神经元词表，并在推理时选择性激活与查询相关的视觉概念，提升视觉语言推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLM将物体身份、空间布局和局部属性隐含地纠缠在稠密隐状态中，难以隔离和调节特定语言查询所需的视觉证据。

Method: 受生物视觉稀疏群体编码和自上而下调制启发，将视觉token状态分解为按概念级簇组织的过完备稀疏基，用语言查询激活相关簇并定位概念表达的patch，将聚焦证据注入回视觉token；辅以抑制机制减弱主导感知方向。全部操作在冻结VLM骨干的单次前向传播中完成。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，CV-Bench总体准确率+3.1（Distance +9.5），BLINK Multi-view +8.3；LLaVA-1.6-7B上呈现类似趋势。

Conclusion: 稀疏神经元词表不仅可作为事后可解释性工具，还能作为概念级视觉推理的主动接口。

Abstract: Current vision-language models (VLMs) encode visual information in dense hidden states where object identity, spatial layout, and local attributes are implicitly entangled rather than explicitly disentangled, limiting their ability to isolate and modulate the specific visual evidence required by a given language query. Inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, we introduce NeuronEye, a plug-in framework that constructs a sparse, concept-level neuron vocabulary from intermediate VLM representations and selectively activates query-relevant visual concepts during inference. NeuronEye decomposes vision-token states into an overcomplete sparse basis organized by concept-level clusters, uses the language query to activate relevant clusters and localize the patches where selected concepts are expressed, and injects the focused evidence back into vision tokens. A complementary suppression mechanism attenuates dominant perceptual directions to preserve weaker but relevant cues. All operations run in a single forward pass over a frozen VLM backbone. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, NeuronEye raises CV-Bench overall accuracy by +3.1 with gains of +9.5 on Distance, and improves BLINK Multi-view by +8.3, with similar trends on LLaVA-1.6-7B. These results suggest that sparse neuron vocabularies can serve not only as post-hoc interpretability tools but also as active interfaces for concept-level visual reasoning.

</details>


### [599] [Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38108)
*Subba Reddy Oota,Francisco Herrera,Jordi Cabot Sagrera,Marcos López de Prado,Shadab Khan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究"计划声明-执行差距"(Plan Declaration-Execution Gap)，提出Planning-as-Routing框架：LLM声明四种规划模式之一（Predefined、Sequential、Hierarchical、Search），由确定性路由器分派给对应模式的专用执行器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成功的规划需要两种能力：为任务选择合适的计划，以及忠实地执行该计划。现有planner-executor系统可能在这两个阶段任一处失败，而仅凭最终任务成功无法区分是选择失败还是执行失败。

Method: 提出Planning-as-Routing：LLM声明四种规划模式之一（Predefined、Sequential、Hierarchical、Search），确定性路由器将任务分派给对应的pattern-specific executor。在4个基准、3个LLM上进行实验，比较通用Plan+ReAct与模式专用执行器。

Result: 三个一致模式：(1)通用Plan+ReAct难以保留声明的规划结构，长计划尤甚，三个基准中仅22%–45%轨迹保留结构，而模式专用执行器能强制结构；(2)规划模式有效性随环境和模型变化：ALFWorld上Search最佳，SWE-bench上Hierarchical最佳，同一基准内不同模型最优模式也可能不同；(3)最大收益来自执行：模式专用执行器将ALFWorld成功率从0.48提升到0.92，SWE-bench Verified从0.36提升到0.44。当前LLM无法可靠地为每个任务选择最强模式，但few-shot示例在某些基准-模型组合中可改善选择。

Conclusion: 可靠的agent规划既需要有效的模式选择，也需要忠实的执行。路由显著缩小了执行差距，而任务特定的模式选择仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable agents to solve long-horizon tasks by generating a plan and then executing it in an environment. However, successful planning requires two distinct capabilities: selecting an appropriate plan for the task and executing it faithfully. Existing planner--executor systems can fail at either stage, while final task success alone cannot distinguish selection from execution failures. We therefore study the Plan Declaration--Execution Gap and introduce Planning-as-Routing, where an LLM declares one of four planning modes: Predefined, Sequential, Hierarchical, or Search, and a deterministic router dispatches the task to the corresponding pattern-specific executor. Across four benchmarks and three LLMs, we find three consistent patterns. First, generic Plan+ReAct often fails to preserve declared planning structure, especially for longer plans: across three benchmarks, only (22)--(45%) of trajectories preserve it, whereas pattern-specific executors enforce the intended structure. Second, planning-mode effectiveness varies across environments and models: Search performs best on ALFWorld, Hierarchical on SWE-bench, and the strongest pattern can vary across models within the same benchmark. Third, the largest gains come from execution: pattern-specific executors improve task success from (0.48) to (0.92) on ALFWorld and from (0.36) to (0.44) on SWE-bench Verified over Plan+ReAct. Current LLMs, however, do not reliably select the strongest mode for each task, although few-shot examples improve selection in some benchmark--model combinations. Overall, reliable agent planning requires both effective mode selection and faithful execution: routing substantially closes the execution gap, while task-specific mode selection remains open.

</details>


### [600] [Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38120)
*I. Samuel Akinwande,Mykel J. Kochenderfer,Clark Barrett*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文探索使用随机世界模型作为视觉反馈神经系统的感知代理，并开发验证程序，在紧急制动基准上超越GAN代理与现有验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证基于视觉的神经反馈系统需要对其控制器所依赖的观测建模，该模型需同时捕捉传感器变化并保持闭环分析可处理性。GAN感知代理体积大、复杂场景复现差且难以验证。

Method: 训练具有物理接地潜在变量的世界模型，其操作可被标准验证器界定；并开发结合证伪、自适应精化、符号分析与反向分析的验证程序。

Result: 世界模型比参数多130倍的GAN代理更忠实地复现留出帧；在紧急制动基准的GAN代理上解决整个状态空间，其中38%被现有验证器未解决；在RGB版本上首次报告结果，用世界模型代理解决超过80%状态空间。

Conclusion: 随机世界模型是比GAN更丰富且可验证的感知代理，结合所提验证程序可显著扩展视觉神经反馈系统的可验证状态空间。

Abstract: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.

</details>


### [601] [AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38142)
*Rishabh Agrawal,Hejie Cui,Shasha Li,Shanchan Wu,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AdviSD方法，结合结果强化学习与选择性自蒸馏，让可训练顾问用自然语言指导冻结的执行模型，性能显著优于GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 顾问从完成交互的反馈中学习改进建议时，某些看似合理的纠正可能不改变执行结果，但仍会影响顾问在其他情境中的决策；在共享参数模型中，这类纠正可能限制学习，若其目标对有用建议的偏好弱于其他纠正。

Method: AdviSD将基于结果的强化学习与来自"反馈条件化顾问副本"的自蒸馏选择性结合：反思生成纠正，顾问对同一记录的执行响应在有/无建议条件下打分，用差异幅度选择监督的决策；无需执行器似然或额外执行器rollout。

Result: 用Qwen3-8B作为顾问指导Gemini和Claude，AdviSD在BFCL-v3上比advisor-GRPO高4.2-6.4个百分点，在EnvScaler上高3.9-5.1分；可泛化到域外任务，并跨执行器版本与模型家族迁移；优于等量随机选择。

Conclusion: 对纠正进行选择性学习（基于建议对执行响应的影响幅度）能提升顾问最终性能，优于从所有纠正学习，且无需额外执行器交互。

Abstract: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.

</details>


### [602] [Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38143)
*Cheng Qian,Kunlun Zhu,Beibin Li,Zhenhailong Wang,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"元技能(Meta-Skill)"，让Builder在模型权重冻结条件下学习为目标(Target)构建更优执行环境，无需微调即可实现系统级自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent性能既取决于推理能力，也取决于其所处的执行环境。作者希望在不更新模型权重的情况下，让一个模型学会为另一个模型构建更好的执行环境，并使这种经验可复用。

Method: 提出Test-time AI-for-AI框架：Builder从Target在开发集上的执行反馈中学习Meta-Skill（规定何时需要支持、提供何种资源的准则），形成冻结的技能库；随后用该技能库为未见任务构建执行环境(harness)。

Result: 在Harness-Bench和NewtonBench上，完整技能库相比无技能构建将宏平均性能提升8.95个百分点，相比直接向Target交付同一技能库提升12.02个百分点。

Conclusion: 将经验转化为可执行的支撑具有明确价值；当同一模型同时扮演Builder和Target时仍有增益，暗示了一条通过"学习构建更好环境"实现系统级自我改进的路径。

Abstract: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.

</details>


### [603] [Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38147)
*Paras Dahal,Anton Bakhtin,Taco Cohen,Zhengxing Chen,Carole-Jean Wu,Rob Fergus,Scott Yih,Gabriel Synnaeve,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,Sanjeev Arora,Jason Weston,Anirudh Goyal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"智能体元推理"(agentic meta-reasoning),一种推理时框架,将长程任务中的控制决策显式化为结构化推理过程:工作者(worker)执行任务层计算,控制器(controller)整合已确立的成果、探索候选选项、在预算约束下评估价值并调度下一步。在ProgramBench上以GPT-5.5达71.5%(Codex为58.0%)、Opus 4.8达67.2%(Claude Code为65.5%),其他基准较直接控制提升3.6–4.2分,且在更大预算区间持续改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能体处理更长、更复杂的问题,控制执行本身成为一项独立任务。每一步运行都带来新的控制选择:基于哪部分中间成果继续、是否重新开始、何时停止。现有生产级编码智能体和研究框架缺乏对这种控制决策的显式、结构化处理,因此需要一种专门的推理时机制来管理长程智能体的执行。

Method: 提出智能体元推理(agentic meta-reasoning)推理时harness,将控制选择变成显式结构化推理。架构分为:worker执行任务级计算;controller负责整合运行已确立的成果、探索下一步选项、在剩余预算下评估各选项价值、并借助持久记忆(persistent memory)中提取的上下文调度所选工作。决策之间,控制器只保留运行的紧凑摘要,而无需回放完整历史。对照基线包括生产级编码智能体、研究框架,以及使用相同worker和计算预算的直接控制智能体(Direct Control Agent)。

Result: ProgramBench(通过程序重建测试长程智能体能力):GPT-5.5下达71.5%对比Codex的58.0%;Opus 4.8下达67.2%对比Claude Code的65.5%。其他基准(抽象推理、多领域长程推理、证明生成)上,跨三个前沿模型平均较直接控制提升3.6–4.2分。在直接控制趋于平台的预算范围内仍持续改进,但小预算下开销可能带来负面影响。工件图分析显示:更多复用早期工作、多数设置下对正确解覆盖更高、最终选择上增益不均衡。

Conclusion: 结果表明,随着智能体扩展到更长运行,将计算用于结构化控制变得越来越重要。元推理在长程任务上优于生产级系统和同等预算的直接控制,尽管在极小预算下其控制开销可能成为负担。

Abstract: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.

</details>


### [604] [PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15106)
*Mark Deutel,Simon Geis,Axel Plinge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PrototypeNAS，一种零样本NAS方法，快速自动化地为不同MCU选择、压缩和特化DNN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备硬件约束多样，DNN需逐一特化，人工成本高；现有NAS耗资源、耗时且未考虑目标系统资源约束。

Method: 三步搜索：1) 新搜索空间，结合多种架构结构优化及剪枝、量化配置优化；2) 使用零样本代理集成；3) 用Hypervolume子集选择从多目标Pareto前沿蒸馏代表精度-FLOPs权衡的架构。

Result: 在3类任务共12个数据集（图像分类、时间序列分类、目标检测）上评估，数分钟内找到可在商用MCU部署的小模型，精度接近大型DNN。

Conclusion: PrototypeNAS能在分钟级内为MCU生成小而高效的DNN，兼顾部署可行性与精度。

Abstract: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.

</details>

### [605] [Massively Parallel Reinforcement Learning with a Chaotic Reconfigurable Clockless Chip](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36347)
*Eric Oliveira-Gomes,Damien Rontani*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于异步布尔网络（格）的准模拟决策架构，在无时钟可重构芯片上实现分布式布尔混沌，用于大规模强化学习硬件加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于物理动力系统的硬件加速器有望实现高能效强化学习，但其扩展性受限于需要大量统计独立的熵源。

Method: 在网络每个节点使用单个逻辑元件作为自主熵源，构建时钟缺失的可重构芯片上的异步布尔网络，产生空间耦合的分布式布尔混沌，从而生成节点间统计依赖性极低的并行混沌布尔转移流。

Result: 在1024臂老虎机问题上实验演示并行决策，规模超越以往硬件实现并显著改善幂律缩放；将熵源扩展至5120个并行通道，总样本生成速率达2.14 TS/s；实现于商用可重构CMOS芯片，集成密度高、可编程性好。

Conclusion: 分布式布尔混沌可作为大规模强化学习和全集成高通量决策加速器的重要硬件基底。

Abstract: Hardware accelerators based on physical dynamical systems offer an attractive route toward energy-efficient reinforcement learning applications. However, their scalability is challenging because it requires many statistically independent entropy sources. Here, we introduce a quasi-analog decision-making architecture based on asynchronous Boolean networks (or lattices) implemented on a clockless reconfigurable chip. Each node in the network consists of a single logic element that acts as an autonomous entropy source. This architecture gives rise to distributed Boolean chaos, in which a spatially coupled network generates parallel streams of chaotic Boolean transitions with very low statistical dependence between nodes. We experimentally demonstrate parallel decision-making on a 1024-armed bandit problem, which is beyond the scale of previous hardware implementations, while significantly improving power-law scaling performance. Separately, we scale the proposed entropy source to 5120 parallel channels, yielding an aggregate sample generation rate of 2.14 TS/s. Our solution is implemented on a commercial reconfigurable CMOS chip and offers high integration density and ease of programmability. Our results pave the way for using distributed Boolean chaos as a valuable hardware substrate for large-scale reinforcement learning and for the development of fully integrated, high-throughput decision-making accelerators.

</details>


### [606] [NeuroDyn-EEG: An Interpretable Pre-trained Model for EEG Based on Neural Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36773)
*Yi Cui,Tong Zhao,Jiaxin Lei,Chuyi Yang,Yifan Cui,Ling Zhang,Yuxiang Yan,Bo Hong*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出NeuroDyn-EEG预训练框架，将神经动力学生成先验融入EEG表征学习，从19通道头皮EEG推断90个AAL脑区的11类区域参数及1个全局参数，兼顾判别与机制可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床头皮EEG可非侵入反映神经精神疾病动态，但现有判别式深度模型缺乏解剖索引的生理可解释性。

Method: 融合扩展Jansen-Rit神经质量模型、基于leadfield的源投影与仿真参数反演；在生理范围内的合成参数-EEG对上预训练，仅约2.43M可训练参数。

Result: 三级评估：受控仿真中噪声下参数恢复稳健，真实静息态EEG逆-前向闭环谱与相位一致；四个基准（AD65、PD31、Figshare MDD、TUAB）上具竞争力，PD31与MDD获最高BACC/AUROC/AUCPR，AD65获最高BACC；事后区域分析揭示疾病特异改变（AD65以C_1为主，MDD以theta为主）。

Conclusion: NeuroDyn-EEG将头皮EEG映射为解剖索引的动力学参数，桥接表征学习与机制神经生理学。

Abstract: Clinical scalp electroencephalography (EEG) offers a noninvasive window into neural dynamics of neuropsychiatric disorders. However, discriminative deep models often lack anatomically indexed physiological interpretability. We propose NeuroDyn-EEG, a pretraining framework integrating generative priors from neural dynamics. It couples an extended Jansen-Rit neural mass model, leadfield-based source projection, and simulation-based parameter inversion. Trained on synthetic parameter-EEG pairs within physiological ranges, NeuroDyn-EEG estimates 11 regional parameter families across 90 AAL regions plus one global parameter from standard 19-channel EEG, using only ~2.43M trainable parameters.
  We evaluate the framework across three levels. First, controlled simulations demonstrate robust parameter recovery under diverse noise conditions, while real resting-state EEG evaluations confirm spectral and phase consistency in an inverse-forward closed loop. Second, on four clinical benchmarks (AD65, PD31, Figshare MDD, and TUAB), NeuroDyn-EEG achieves competitive classification performance, securing the highest BACC, AUROC, and AUCPR on PD31 and MDD, and highest BACC on AD65. Third, post hoc regional analyses reveal disease-specific alterations: local synaptic connectivity C_1 involves the most altered regions in AD65, whereas the firing threshold theta ranks first in MDD, offering testable mechanistic hypotheses.
  Overall, NeuroDyn-EEG maps scalp EEG to anatomically indexed dynamical parameters, bridging representation learning and mechanistic neurophysiology. Code: https://github.com/Gnosis-Neurodynamics/NeuroDyn-EEG.

</details>


### [607] [Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion for Feedforward, Locally Trained Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37047)
*Aidin Attar,Eleonora Cicciarella,Michele Rossi*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出一种基于TTFS脉冲延迟的SNN，结合残差式连接与多深度时序融合(MDTF)，用全局部在线学习(逐层STDP+R-STDP)处理静态图像和事件流，在多数据集上显著优于STDP/R-STDP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心研究问题是：何种架构选择最能支持多层卷积SNN中的局部在线学习，以在无全局反向传播条件下提升静态图像与事件流的分类性能。

Method: 完整管道包括：将原始视觉数据转为稀疏脉冲延迟的早期视觉前端；逐层无监督STDP训练的四层卷积骨干；确定性多深度时序融合(MDTF)，保留早期时序证据、加入中间层稀疏残差事件，仅当深层特征与早期表示时间一致时才引入；最后用R-STDP训练分类器。

Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、N-MNIST上验证。选择性多深度融合在高变异性任务上大幅超越传统STDP/R-STDP基线：Fashion-MNIST +18.2个百分点，CIFAR-10 +29.2个百分点。活动预算分析显示，移除大量晚期或弱脉冲事件后仍保持高精度，体现高数据效率与低事件处理需求。

Conclusion: MDTF结合残差式多深度与时间一致性共识，可有效支持全局部在线学习的卷积SNN，在准确率与事件效率上均具优势，代码已开源。

Abstract: We propose a new spiking neural network (SNN) design to process static images and event streams using time-to-first-spike (TTFS) latencies. Our key research question is which architectural choices best accommodate local and online learning in multi-layer convolutional SNNs. This question is addressed via an original framework combining residual-like connections with multi-depth feature aggregation and consensus. The full SNN pipeline features an early-vision front end, to convert raw visual data into sparse spike latencies, a four-layer convolutional backbone trained layerwise with unsupervised spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), a deterministic Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF) and a final classifier trained with reward-modulated spike-timing-dependent plasticity (R-STDP). Rather than replacing early features in deeper layers, the proposed MDTF preserves early temporal evidence, adding sparse residual events from intermediate layers, and incorporating deeper features only when they agree in time with earlier representations. The resulting architecture is experimentally validated across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and N-MNIST, delivering strong classification performance under a fully local learning regime. Selective multi-depth fusion significantly outperforms traditional STDP/R-STDP baselines on higher-variability visual tasks (achieving +18.2 pp on Fashion-MNIST and +29.2 pp on CIFAR-10). Furthermore, activity-budget analyses show that the network retains high accuracy even when removing a large fraction of late or weak spike events, confirming its high data efficiency and reduced event-processing requirements. The codebase is publicly available at github.com/aidinattar/multi-depth- temporal-fusion-snn.

</details>


### [608] [Adaptive Rotation for iSOMA: Geometry, Benchmarking, and Noise Robustness in Variational Quantum Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37193)
*Vojtěch Novák,Ivan Zelinka*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出 iSOMA-AR，通过从成功迁移位移中学习基并在该基上选择性应用扰动掩码，以降低 iSOMA 的坐标依赖性，同时保留低成本领导者导向迁移机制。实验显示其在确定性、坐标敏感问题上收益明显，但在噪声场景中优势主要来自 SOMA 底层机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: iSOMA 的迁移机制成本低，但存在坐标依赖问题；作者希望在不牺牲其廉价领导者导向迁移机制的前提下降低坐标依赖性。

Method: 提出 iSOMA-AR：从成功迁移位移中学习一个方向基，并在该基中选择性应用标准扰动（PRT）掩码；还进行了门限阈值、旋转上限等消融，并修复全零 PRT 掩码。

Result: 在完整无噪声 BBOB 上显著优于基线 iSOMA，尤其在几何困难地形；在 CEC 2011 真实问题上多数优于 iL-SHADE，但相对 iSOMA 不显著。量子目标上改进多数横向场条件；强噪声下 SOMA 变体最稳健，但 iSOMA-AR 未显著优于 iSOMA。

Conclusion: 自适应旋转主要对坐标敏感的确定性优化问题有用；噪声鲁棒性主要源自底层 SOMA 迁移机制，而非自适应旋转本身。

Abstract: We study whether the coordinate dependence of the improved Self-Organizing Migrating Algorithm (iSOMA) can be reduced while retaining its inexpensive leader-directed migration mechanism. We introduce iSOMA-AR, which learns a basis from successful migration displacements and selectively applies the standard perturbation mask in that basis. On the complete noiseless BBOB suite, iSOMA- AR significantly outperformed baseline iSOMA across matched conditions, with the largest gains on geometrically difficult landscapes. A targeted ablation shows that the learned orientation is beneficial on a rotated ill-conditioned landscape and that moderate changes of the gate threshold and rotation cap preserve the qualitative result. On CEC 2011 Real World Optimization Problems, iSOMA-AR outperformed iL-SHADE on most problems, although its advantage over baseline iSOMA was not statistically significant. A canonical-jSO rerun is reported as a post-hoc sensitivity check alongside the original jSO-derived comparator. On frustrated-spin variational quantum objectives, adaptive rotation improved most transverse-field conditions, while gains on the diagonal and anisotropic models were absent or selective. Under strong effective sampling noise, the SOMA variants were the most robust population-based methods in the comparison, but iSOMA-AR was not significantly better than baseline iSOMA. Repairing all-zero PRT masks greatly reduced repeated-point evaluations without changing endpoint quality significantly, making this implementation detail unlikely to explain the noise result. Overall, adaptive rotation is most useful on coordinate-sensitive deterministic problems, while the observed noise robustness appears to arise mainly from the underlying SOMA migration mechanism.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

### [609] [Agent-Callable Feature Coverage: Measuring Software Readiness for AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35789)
*Zedong Peng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出GUI-API parity原则及ACFC、ARC两个度量框架，实证发现多数软件对AI代理的支持不足，尤其文档与安全治理滞后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理已能通过截图操作图形软件，关键问题转向软件如何通过结构化、可控渠道支持代理。为此需形式化代理对软件功能的可访问性需求，即GUI-API parity原则。

Method: 提出两项贡献：(1) Agent-Callable Feature Coverage (ACFC)，量化系统人类功能对代理的可用比例；(2) Agent Readiness Conformance (ARC)，从Accessibility、Discoverability、Controllability三维度各0-3分评估，合成0-9分，借鉴Richardson成熟度模型。对30个系统进行实证研究，并在10个部署系统上开展受控测试。

Result: 30个系统跨五类别的ARC-based ACFC得分远低于仅看Accessibility的结果，多数API覆盖中等但文档与安全治理滞后。10系统测试中，API-only代理完成58项任务中的56项；文档消融后降至50项，说明Discoverability影响执行；不可访问能力作为负对照未被解决。结论在三个代理模型（含本地Gemma4）上一致。

Conclusion: 结构化接口的覆盖与可用性存在显著差距，仅看API覆盖会高估代理就绪度，需重视代理导向文档与安全治理。

Abstract: AI agents already operate graphical software through screenshot-based computer use, so the pressing question is not whether agents can operate software, but how well software supports them through structured, controllable channels. We formalize this need as the GUI-API parity principle: every capability available to human users through a graphical interface should also be accessible to agents through a structured, callable interface with appropriate safety metadata. To operationalize this principle, we introduce two contributions. First, Agent-Callable Feature Coverage (ACFC), a product-level readiness metric quantifying how much of a system's human-facing functionality agents can access and use. Second, Agent Readiness Conformance (ARC), a framework that scores each capability on three axes: Accessibility (can an agent call it), Discoverability (can an agent find and understand it), and Controllability (can an agent use it safely), each on a 0-3 scale, yielding a composite 0-9 readiness score. Drawing on the Richardson Maturity Model, ARC provides finer-grained assessment than binary coverage. In an empirical study of 30 software systems across five categories, ARC-based ACFC scores are substantially lower than Accessibility-only metrics would suggest: most systems achieve moderate API coverage but lag on agent-oriented documentation and safety governance. In a controlled testbed of ten deployed systems, API-only agents completed 56 of 58 tasks whose target capabilities were exposed through structured interfaces; a documentation ablation reduced this to 50 of 58, showing that Discoverability affects execution even among accessible capabilities, while inaccessible capabilities, included as negative controls, were not solved. These findings hold across three agent models, including Google's open-weights Gemma4 run locally.

</details>


### [610] [A Leakage-Safe, Cost-Aware Regression Testing Methodology for the Quantum Transpiler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35834)
*Furqan Nasir,Muhammad Arif Shah,Ifitkhar Alam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出面向Qiskit量子转译器的、防泄漏且成本感知的回归测试选择方法，并进行了预算绑定的预注册评估。结果显示复杂的risk_score选择器不如简单基线，但据其机制推导出的多样性优先选择器接近最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Qiskit等量子SDK持续修改，单个转译器pass变更即可引入软件回归，因此在固定的CI测试预算下，必须从规模大、成本异质的测试套件中选择并排序测试。

Method: 采用防泄漏、成本感知的回归测试选择方法，并进行预注册的预算绑定评估。使用成本异质语料（116个单元，成本跨度9,945倍，T_full=69.17秒），预算基于实测成本事先固定。评估了透明risk_score选择器，并进行组件消融，以及第二个独立预注册的变异测试评估（19个事件）来检验其机制所推导的多样性优先选择器。

Result: risk_score选择器的检测-预算AUC均值为0.721，低于仅多样性基线0.874（Cliff's δ=-0.64，大效应）、成本/历史/变更阶段基线0.840和随机0.821。消融显示复合方法不如其自身最佳信号，有效信号是多样性与新颖性，而非严重性或成本。多样性优先选择器将差距缩小到可忽略效应（0.880 vs 0.880，δ=-0.08），并显著优于原复合方法（0.880 vs 0.768，δ=+0.57）。两个真实Qiskit CI前向回归事件佐证，按事件逐一报告。

Conclusion: 更复杂的风险选择器并不优于简单优先级基线；有效机制是多样性与新颖性而非严重性或成本。多样性优先选择器可接近最强基线。作者将这一负面结果作为诚实的预注册发现报告并公开全部代码、数据与工件以保证可复现性。

Abstract: Quantum SDKs such as Qiskit are revised continually, and a single transpiler-pass change can introduce a software regression, so continuous integration (CI) must select and prioritize tests from a large, cost-heterogeneous suite under a fixed budget. We present a leakage-safe, cost-aware regression-test-selection methodology for the Qiskit quantum transpiler, with a pre-registered, budget binding evaluation that avoids data leakage. The evaluation uses a cost-heterogeneous corpus (116 units, per-unit cost spread 9,945X, T_full = 69.17 s) whose budgets were fixed from measured cost before any test-oracle label was read. A transparent risk_score selector does not beat simple test case-prioritization baselines: mean detection-vs-budget AUC is 0.721 [95% CI 0.44, 0.94] versus 0.874 [0.65, 1.00] for diversity-only (Cliff's δ = -0.64, large), with cost/history/change-stage baselines at 0.840 and random at 0.821. A component ablation shows the composite underperforms its own best signal: diversity and novelty, not severity or cost, are the effective signal. A second, independently pre-registered evaluation (19 mutation-testing events: nine original plus ten new, verified operators) tests the decomposed, diversity-first selector this mechanism implies: it closes the gap to the strongest baseline to a negligible effect size (0.880 vs 0.880, δ = -0.08) while decisively beating the original composite (0.880 vs 0.768, δ = +0.57). Two verified forward-regression events from real Qiskit CI history corroborate it, reported per event, not pooled, under a pre-declared claim-scope rule. We report the negative result as an honest, pre-registered finding with its mechanism. All code, data, and artifacts from this empirical software engineering study are released for reproducibility.

</details>


### [611] [Beyond Rule-Based Mutation Testing: Test-Aware Mutant Generation Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35841)
*Nils Kiele,Zainab Saad,Zirui Wang,Steve Drew,Samira Ebrahimi Kahou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出test-aware变异体生成方法：向LLM提供题目描述、标准解与基础测试，要求生成能通过基础测试的变异体，在HumanEval/MBPP上验证故障率远超test-blind和规则工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于规则的变异测试工具会产生大量琐碎、冗余或等价变异体，限制其发现测试套件缺口的实用性；而现有LLM方法多忽视测试上下文（test-blind），无法推理已有测试覆盖内容，导致生成的变异体易被轻易杀死、效率低。

Method: 提出test-aware变异体生成：将问题陈述、规范解与基础单元测试置于单一提示中，要求LLM生成能通过全部基础测试的非平凡变异体。在HumanEval和MBPP上评测5个LLM（Gemini 3.1 Pro/Flash、GPT 5.1 Codex Mini、GPT 4.1 Mini、Qwen3-32B），并以EvalPlus扩展测试套件作为自动预言机判定存活变异体是否为真实缺陷。同时对比test-blind提示与规则工具mutmut。

Result: test-aware提示的已验证故障率达87.7%（HumanEval）和79.1%（MBPP），远超test-blind提示（12.2%/23.0%）和mutmut（4.4%/5.7%）。三种方法的故障隐蔽性相当，但test-aware每验证故障的计算成本最低。

Conclusion: 将已有单元测试暴露给LLM，可将变异体生成从无目标的错误注入转变为有效发现测试套件弱点；该工作为将test-aware变异体生成扩展到生产级环境奠定基础。

Abstract: Mutation testing evaluates test-suite adequacy by injecting synthetic faults into program code. However, traditional rule-based tools often generate large numbers of trivial, redundant, or equivalent mutants that limit their practical use for identifying gaps in a test suite. While recent large language model (LLM)-based approaches generate more realistic faults, most remain test-blind: The model sees only the source code and cannot reason about what existing tests already cover. We propose test-aware mutant generation, in which an LLM receives the problem statement, canonical solution and base tests in a single prompt, and must generate a nontrivial mutant that passes the base unit tests. We evaluate this approach across a set of five LLMs -- Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT 5.1 Codex Mini, GPT 4.1 Mini, Qwen3-32B -- on the HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks. The extended EvalPlus test suites serve as an automated oracle to verify whether surviving mutants represent genuine bugs. Test-aware prompting yields verified fault rates of 87.7% (HumanEval) and 79.1% (MBPP), meaning these mutants pass all base tests but are caught by the oracle. This vastly outperforms the matched test-blind prompting (which yields only 12.2% and 23.0%, respectively) and the traditional rule-based tool mutmut (4.4% and 5.7%). While fault subtlety (the fraction of extended tests a mutant fails) remains comparable across all three methods, test-awareness minimizes the computational cost per verified fault, compared to test-blind prompting. Exposing an LLM to existing unit tests shifts mutant generation from untargeted bug injection toward effective discovery of weaknesses in an existing test suite. Our work establishes a concrete foundation for future research to scale test-aware mutant generation to production-level environments.

</details>


### [612] [PoliVEM: a Python-driven virtual element framework for computational solid mechanics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35878)
*Paulo Akira F. Enabe,Rodrigo Provasi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: PoliVEM是一个基于虚单元法(VEM)的C++17计算核心与Python接口框架，统一实现梁、2D/3D弹性、轴对称、瞬态扩散和有限应变超弹性，通过共享的投影、装配与求解基础设施验证多物理场共性实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VEM在固体与结构力学中已有多种离散形式，但缺乏将一维梁、二维/三维弹性、轴对称弹性、瞬态扩散与有限应变超弹性等不同公式统一到同一代码基础设施的框架，导致新公式难以复用网格表示、自由度编号、边界条件、稀疏装配与求解器等通用组件。

Method: 提出PoliVEM框架：C++17核心加Python接口；将顶点、边、面、体自由度统一存储于一个层次结构；由公共多项式数据构造能量、应变和L²投影，并在单元级别保留一致性-稳定性分裂；核心按网格、材料、单元、装配器、求解器职责分离并以组合方式耦合。数值基础设施包含多边形/多面体网格输入、高阶实体编号、投影算子缓存、静态凝聚、着色稀疏装配、基于矩阵结构的线性求解器选择、带线搜索与正则化的增量Newton法，以及显式/隐式时间积分。

Result: 三个数值实验通过多项式再现、静态凝聚后恢复、高阶自由度处理、多边形与多面体网格、patch test、刚度谱及与独立有限元计算对比，验证了梁与2D/3D弹性公式的公共核心；同时识别出各向异性单元上高阶多项式基的缩放问题及稀疏直接分解所需内存为主要局限。

Conclusion: PoliVEM成功以统一核心支持多种VEM公式，证明共享投影、装配与求解基础设施的可行性，但高阶基在各向异性网格上的缩放与稀疏直接分解的内存占用仍是当前实现的主要瓶颈。

Abstract: This work presents PoliVEM, a software framework for the Virtual Element Method (VEM) in computational solid and structural mechanics. A C++17 computational core and a Python interface place one-dimensional beams, two- and three-dimensional elasticity, axisymmetric elasticity, transient diffusion, and finite-strain hyperelasticity in a common implementation. The framework stores vertex, edge, face, and cell degrees of freedom in one hierarchy, constructs the energy, strain, and $L^2$ projections from common polynomial data, and retains the consistency--stabilization split at the element level. The core separates the mesh, material, element, assembler, and solver responsibilities and combines them by composition. A new formulation supplies its projection, discrete form, and stabilization while reusing the mesh representation, degree-of-freedom numbering, boundary-condition treatment, sparse assembly, algebraic solvers, and Python binding pattern. The numerical infrastructure includes polygonal and polyhedral mesh input, higher-order entity numbering, cached projection operators, static condensation, coloured sparse assembly, linear solver selection based on the matrix structure, an incremental Newton method with line search and regularization, and explicit and implicit time integration. Three numerical experiments examine the shared implementation through polynomial reproduction, recovery after static condensation, higher-order degree-of-freedom handling, polygonal and polyhedral meshes, patch tests, stiffness spectra, and comparisons with independent finite element calculations. The results verify the common core for the beam and two- and three-dimensional elasticity formulations. They also identify the scaling of high-order polynomial bases on anisotropic cells and the memory required by sparse direct factorizations as the main limitations of the current implementation.

</details>


### [613] [The Artifact Promotion Control Model: An Implementation Case Study. Build on Target Machines vs. Build Once and Promote Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35891)
*Vasili Gavrilov,Enkli Ylli*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文以更严格的形式重述"工件提升"（一次构建、逐环境复用同一构建副本）控制模型，并给出 AWS 生产案例验证：单命令发布、工件自主流转，31 次发布中每服务器约 36 秒（总 6 分钟），四周内 22 次发布，并列明控制项存在与缺失（无签名、无扫描、无审批记录、部署无校验）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者此前以工程散文形式提出工件提升，但缺乏严格表述与实证记录，且合规法规（FedRAMP/SI-7、SOX 404、FFIEC、DO-178C、FDA 21 CFR Part 11、HIPAA、DoD IL）对完整性与变更控制的要求，用"目标机重复构建"更难满足。因此需将已有零散文献部件整合为统一模型并用生产记录检验。

Method: Part I 以严格形式重构模型：定义发布对象、部署跨越的控制域、工件与环境身份区分、把源码库失陷作为控制域问题；整合构建一次原则、build/release/run 拆分、二进制授权、供应链分离（NIST SP 800-204D）等既有文献部件；论证构建期注入密钥破坏工件身份、部署期下载依赖库是随数量增长的攻击面、发布角色无需生产口令。Part II 为 AWS 上生产 Web 应用的匿名化案例，发布仅一条命令、工件从上传到运行完全自主；按平台记录逐阶段计时 31 次发布，并给出控制项对照表与未覆盖的两个发布单元。

Result: 31 次生产发布逐阶段计时：每服务器约 36 秒，整体滚动发布约 6 分钟；前四周完成 22 次发布；应用达到其服务等级；控制表显示实现具备/缺失项——缺签名、缺扫描、缺审批记录、缺部署时校验；并识别出流水线未覆盖的两个发布单元。结尾以对照表逐条核验 Part I 各项主张与生产记录。

Conclusion: 该模型可作为云部署的控制模型，其完整性/变更控制属性比目标机重复构建更直接满足多项法规要求；但案例亦暴露自动化流水线在签名、扫描、审批与部署校验等控制上的缺口，需补齐方可完全兑现模型承诺。

Abstract: Artifact promotion means building the software once and moving that same built copy through the test and production environments, instead of building it again on each server. A previous treatment by the first author presented it as a control model for cloud deployment in accessible engineering prose. Part I of this paper restates the model in stricter form: the release object, the control domains a deployment crosses, the artifact-versus-environment identity distinction, source-control compromise as a control-domain question, and the regulatory controls (FedRAMP/SI-7, SOX 404, FFIEC, DO-178C, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, DoD IL) whose integrity and change-control requirements the model's properties meet more directly than build-on-target does. The parts of the model are each in the literature already: the build-once principle, the build/release/run split, binary authorization, separation as a supply-chain property, NIST SP 800-204D. The paper assembles them as one model, whatever form the built copy takes; states that a secret injected at build time breaks artifact identity; restates why downloading libraries at deployment time is an attack surface that grows with their number; and derives that the releasing role needs no production password. Part II is an anonymized case study of a production web application on AWS in which a release is one command and the artifact's path from upload to running fleet is autonomous. It reports 31 production rollouts timed stage by stage from the platform's records (36 s per server inside a six-minute rollout), 22 releases in the first four weeks, the application's service levels, a control table stating which controls the implementation has and which it lacks (no signature, no scan, no approval record, no verification at deploy), and the two release units the pipeline did not cover. A closing table checks each claim of Part I against that record.

</details>


### [614] [UNBIND: UNlearning By INference-time Directional Steering for Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35913)
*Zhengyang Shan,Jiayun Xin,Yanjun Lin,Xu Qian,Zhiang Liu,Minghui Xu,Yue Zhang,Qin Hu,Kun Li,Xiuzhen Cheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出UNBIND框架，在推理时选择性遗忘目标代码，同时保持模型权重不变和通用编程能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码大模型从大规模语料中记忆了特定实现，在版权或安全问题出现时需要去除，但目标代码与需保留代码共享计算模式，遗忘与通用能力之间存在矛盾。

Method: 分别构建两个方向：一个识别对应目标代码的隐藏状态，另一个抑制其复现，从而实现推理时的选择性遗忘，模型权重保持固定。

Result: 在两个代码模型、两个语料上与14个基线对比，UNBIND在所有设置下取得最高的遗忘-效用联合得分；F-BLEU显示目标代码复现下降97.3%–99.1%；HumanEval+最多少解2题、MBPP+最多少解6题；重复抽取中至少50 token的精确片段从188–262降到0–2（共300个），无片段达到100 token，平均最佳恢复率0.43%–6.45%。

Conclusion: 多语言及相关代码评估显示UNBIND能在有效遗忘的同时对有用编程能力影响有限，是一种实用的选择性代码遗忘方案。

Abstract: Code large language models acquire programming capabilities from large code corpora, but can also memorize implementations that later require removal. Code unlearning is needed to control their continued reproduction when copyright or security concerns arise. However, targeted and retained code share computational patterns, creating a tension between forgetting specific implementations and preserving general programming ability. We propose \textbf{UNBIND}, a code unlearning framework that separately considers which hidden states correspond to the target code and how to suppress its reproduction. By constructing separate directions for these objectives, UNBIND achieves selective unlearning at inference time while keeping model weights fixed. Our evaluation covers fourteen baselines across two code models and two corpora. UNBIND achieves the highest joint forgetting and utility score in every setting. It reduces target code reproduction by 97.3\% to 99.1\% as measured by F-BLEU, with at most two fewer HumanEval+ and six fewer MBPP+ problems solved than the original models. In repeated extraction tests under a fixed budget, the number of targets yielding exact spans of at least 50 tokens falls from 188--262 to 0--2 out of 300 per setting. No extracted span reaches 100 tokens, and the mean best recovery ratio ranges from 0.43\% to 6.45\%. Multilingual and related-code evaluations further show effective forgetting with limited impact on useful programming capabilities, supporting UNBIND as a practical approach to selective code unlearning.

</details>


### [615] [Evaluating Name-Only Directory Routing for One-Shot Code Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35918)
*Manoj Bajaj*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 测试语言模型能否依据目录与文件名（而非固定词法查询）定位被遗漏的标注代码文件，在82个真实issue上评估效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码智能体早期难点在于找对文件，固定词法查询（如FTS5、rg）常漏掉相关代码文件，本文探究基于目录/文件名路由能否补充这些遗漏候选。

Method: 在11个仓库、固定pre-fix提交下的82个审计issue上，比较name-only目录路由、FTS5、固定full-issue rg查询；并在共享16K token预算下对比行覆盖，另设flat path对照。

Result: 八个候选内文件召回：路由0.465 vs FTS5 0.352 vs rg 0.245；对FTS5配对增益0.113（95%区间0.053–0.168）。16K预算下标注行覆盖0.443 vs 0.246。路由+FTS5达0.491，但增益不确定。flat path对照0.572但需24.6次模型调用（路由8.9次）。

Conclusion: 目录路由可为一次性词法搜索补充相关文件候选，但无法归因于层级结构本身，也未能证明其提升issue解决率。

Abstract: Finding the right files is an early challenge for coding agents. We test whether a language model can follow directory and file names to find annotated code files missed by fixed lexical queries. Across 82 audited issues from 11 repositories at pinned pre-fix commits, name-only directory routing recovered 0.465 of gold files within eight candidates, compared with 0.352 for FTS5 and 0.245 for a fixed full-issue rg query. The paired gain over FTS5 was 0.113 (95% repository-cluster bootstrap interval, 0.053 to 0.168). Under a shared 16K-token context budget, routing delivered 0.443 of annotated lines versus 0.246 for FTS5 on 55 cases with fully aligned annotations. At the same eight-file limit, combining routing with FTS5 reached 0.491 file recall, but its gain over routing alone was uncertain. An exploratory flat path control reached 0.572 recall while using 24.6 model calls per issue, compared with 8.9 for routing. Routing averaged 8.9 seconds per issue; FTS5 took 7 milliseconds per query after a 0.9-second build. On this cohort, directory routing added relevant file candidates to one-shot lexical search, but the study cannot attribute the gain to hierarchy or show that it improves issue resolution.

</details>


### [616] [The Uneven Decline of Collective Knowledge Production: Evidence from Stack Overflow After Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36069)
*Myokyung Han,Taegyoon Kim,Jinhyuk Yun,Lanu Kim*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文以Stack Overflow为研究对象，将ChatGPT-3.5发布视为自然冲击，分析2020–2025年间逾200万条问题，揭示Gen AI对集体知识的影响是不均衡的：简单、数据丰富的知识最先流失，而复杂、数据稀缺的知识得以留存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gen AI正在重塑个人学习与工作方式，但其对"集体知识"（在线社区共同产出的共享知识体系）的影响尚不清晰。已有研究记录了知识分享平台参与度的整体下降，但具体哪类知识最先流失仍未知，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 以Stack Overflow为场景，将ChatGPT-3.5发布作为自然冲击（natural shock），收集2020–2025年间200多万条问题，从"难度"和"数据可得性"两个维度追踪集体知识的变化，并结合代码复杂度、话题/标签份额分析、跨编程语言对比及多种稳健性检验。

Result: 简单问题急剧减少，难题变得更常见（代码复杂度上升予以佐证）；数据丰富的话题和标签份额下降，数据稀缺话题份额上升。两维度存在交互：简单问题的减少集中出现在数据丰富领域，而难题的增加与数据可得性无关。该模式在Python之外的其他编程语言中同样成立，且越流行的语言变化越显著。

Conclusion: Gen AI对集体知识的影响是不均衡的：它首先侵蚀简单、易获取的知识，而更复杂、更冷门的知识则得以保留。

Abstract: Generative AI (Gen AI) is reshaping how individuals learn and work, but its consequences for collective knowledge, the shared body of knowledge that online communities produce together, remain poorly understood. Prior work has documented an aggregate decline in participation on knowledge-sharing platforms, but it remains unclear which specific kinds of knowledge are being lost first. We study this question using Stack Overflow, one of the largest online communities for software engineering, treating the release of ChatGPT-3.5 as a natural shock. Analyzing over two million questions posted between 2020 and 2025, we track how two dimensions of collective knowledge, difficulty and data availability, change following Gen AI's release. Using diverse methods and robust checks, we find consistent patterns. Easy questions decline sharply while difficult questions become more common, a pattern corroborated by rising code complexity. Data-rich topics and tags lose share of questions, while data-scarce ones gain ground. The two dimensions also interact: the decline in easy questions is concentrated specifically within data-rich domains, while difficult questions increase regardless of data availability. This pattern extends beyond Python across programming languages, with more prevalent languages showing sharper shifts. Together, our findings reveal that Gen AI's impact on collective knowledge is uneven, eroding easy, accessible knowledge first while more complex, less common knowledge persists.

</details>


### [617] [The Invisible Scheduler: Dragging a Sprite Can Change What a Scratch Program Does](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36147)
*Xinyue Feng,Hanyuan Shi,Yuan Si*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Scratch项目并发执行时脚本顺序由精灵 stacking order 决定，导致同一代码在不同屏幕表现不同；本文提出 StackSwap 工具，通过重排精灵启动顺序测试程序行为，发现约有 18-26% 的并发项目对顺序敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Scratch 中多精灵脚本并发执行，起点顺序由不可读取的 stacking order 决定，且随项目保存。作者屏幕正常但教师屏幕失败，同样代码结果不同，学习者、评分者与平台均缺乏对这类顺序敏感性与竞态的检测手段。

Method: StackSwap 利用"固定其余文件、重排有脚本精灵的栈序即可精确产生初始顺序的所有排列"这一观察，在固定输入与随机种子下运行未修改虚拟机。对 ≤5 个精灵枚举全部顺序，更多精灵时按冲突图每类取一，再对不可行情况采样；通过四种观察透镜比较运行结果，输出相邻交换改变结果的二元见证及共享资源候选原因，或给出穷尽/图条件鲁棒性证书，否则为未决。

Result: 在课程、在线评测与随机公开样本共 767 个真实程序中，有调度选择的程序在某种栈序下表现不同的比例为 26.4%（课程）与 18.2%（公开）。顺序敏感且所有顺序均能运行的程序，其保存顺序结果重现率中位数为 17%（课程）与 50%（公开）。脚本化测试中，427 份有调度选择的学生提交里有 5 份在同一需求断言下因顺序不同而一过一败。约一半敏感程序中，随机数流是竞争精灵对的最高优先级共享资源。

Conclusion: Scratch 并发程序的正确性普遍依赖未暴露的 stacking order，作者、教师与自动评分会产生分歧。StackSwap 提供了检测与定位此类竞态的可行方法，并为学习者、评分者与 Scratch 平台给出改进建议。

Abstract: Tens of millions of children program in Scratch, whose programs are concurrent: when the green flag is clicked, every sprite's scripts start together and share the project's state. Which script starts first is decided by the sprites' front-to-back stacking order, which no block reads. Dragging a sprite brings it to the front, and the order is saved with the project. Hence, a program can work on the author's screen and fail on the teacher's, with the same blocks. Our key observation is that, with the rest of the file fixed, rearranging the sprites that start scripts among their positions produces exactly the permutations of their initial stacking order. Under a fixed input and seed the unmodified virtual machine reproduces every one of them. StackSwap runs a project under these orders, all of them for up to five sprites, one per class of a conflict graph beyond, and a sample where neither is feasible, and compares the runs under four observation lenses. It returns a two-run witness naming an adjacent pair of sprites whose swap changes the outcome, with the resources they share as candidate causes; otherwise an exhaustive or graph-conditional robustness certificate, or an unresolved verdict. On 767 real programs from a course, an online judge, and a random public sample, 26.4% (course) and 18.2% (public) of those with a scheduling choice behave differently under some stacking order. Among the sensitive programs whose every order ran, the saved order's outcome recurs under a median 17% (course) and 50% (public) of the orders. Under scripted play, a predicate written from a stated requirement holds under one order and fails under another for 5 of 427 student submissions with a scheduling choice. For half of the sensitive programs the random stream is the racing pair's highest-priority shared resource. We close with recommendations for learners, graders, and the Scratch platform.

</details>


### [618] [Live Architecture Models for Cloud-Native Architecture-as-Code: Early Results from Kubernetes Conformance Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36148)
*Denis Mamatin,Andrey Salov*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究“活架构模型”，通过 Archer 原型将 Kubernetes 运行时事实映射为可编辑架构表示，并周期性检查模型与集群不一致，验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础设施漂移会使运行中的 Kubernetes 系统偏离文档化架构意图，需建立可编辑且连接运行时事实的架构模型。

Method: 采用 Archer 专用的 Kubernetes Deployment Language（KDL）子集，以及具备同步文本与图形视图的 VS Code 原型 Archer；通过快照恢复提取选定 Kubernetes 事实为 KDL，并进行周期性/按需只读一致性检查。

Result: 在三个特征选定的 Kubernetes 示例应用上，按作者定义协议评估快照恢复与选定不一致检测的精确率和召回率，结果支持在评估范围内可行。

Conclusion: 结果仅支持所评估 KDL 范围内的可行性，不证明比较优势、任意生产漂移检测、可扩展性或开发者收益；存储覆盖和 ingress-host 表示/默认处理仍有限制。

Abstract: Infrastructure drift can separate a running Kubernetes system from its documented architectural intent. This paper investigates live architecture models: editable architectural representations connected to selected runtime facts through explicit correspondences and recurring conformance checks. The approach is instantiated through an Archer-specific subset of Kubernetes Deployment Language (KDL) and Archer, a VS Code prototype with synchronized textual and graphical views. Snapshot recovery extracts selected Kubernetes facts into KDL; periodic and on-demand read-only checks report model-cluster inconsistencies without enforcing or repairing deployment state.
  We assess feasibility on three feature-selected Kubernetes example applications under an author-defined protocol, reporting precision and recall for snapshot recovery and selected inconsistency detection. Recovery scores can be reproduced from saved ground-truth and recovered models; detection uses a documented manual perturbation protocol. The results support feasibility within the evaluated KDL scope. They do not establish comparative superiority, detection of arbitrary production drift, scalability, or developer benefit. Storage coverage and ingress-host representation/default handling remain limitations.

</details>


### [619] [The Invisible Throttle: Running on Borrowed Time in Scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36152)
*Xinyue Feng,Hanyuan Shi,Yuan Si*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Scratch脚本速度被"每帧循环一次"的说法掩盖，实际由重绘门控决定；作者提出ThrottleCheck，揭示多数项目对速度敏感且评分受渲染器影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 官方说法称循环每帧迭代一次，但实际VM中帧会反复执行脚本，直到需要重绘、脚本结束或耗尽75%帧时间，导致不绘制图形的循环速度由可见元素与机器决定。该规则无文档说明，造成理解与评分偏差。

Method: 关键观察是重绘门控是整个运行时的一个标志，因此不改代码也能改变循环速度。ThrottleCheck在未修改的虚拟机上实现带预算语义（每帧轮数预算并模拟重绘门控），用不同开关运行项目，报告带见证的对速率敏感项目。

Result: 在500个热门公共游戏中，59%含永不绘制、永不等待的循环。静音绘制精灵的请求会改变24%游戏十秒后的状态，隐藏则18%，无渲染器且无门控则61%。固定时间后读取位置、分数或时钟的规则在解除节流后出现通过/失败反转：Whisker示例测试17%、某教程检查19%。
